words.enDefinition: a translation that correctly reproduces the meaning of the original

examples.en: The declaration described the attached English version as a true and accurate translation.
examples.zh: 声明把所附英文版描述为一份「忠实准确的译文」。

examples.en: I saw 'A true and accurate translation' in the statement printed above the signature.
examples.zh: 我在签名上方印着的声明里看到了「忠实准确的译文」。

collocations: confirm a true and accurate translation
a statement saying a true and accurate translation
describe it as a true and accurate translation

words.zhGloss: 英国签证语境的学业进阶
words.enDefinition: Advancement in study discussed in UK Student-route guidance
acceptedZhAnswers: 英国签证语境的学业进阶

examples.en: A UK student adviser explained the term academic progression during our document workshop.
examples.zh: 英国的学生顾问在文件工作坊里解释了「学业进阶」一词。

examples.en: I checked where academic progression appeared in the guidance about UK student permission.
examples.zh: 我看了英国学生居留许可指南在哪儿提到「学业进阶」。

words.enDefinition: A status saying a post office accepted the item

examples.en: The first update said “Accepted at post office” below the date and time.
examples.zh: 第一条更新在日期和时间下写着「邮局已收寄」。

examples.en: I saved the update marked “Accepted at post office” with my mailing receipt.
examples.zh: 我把标为「邮局已收寄」的更新和邮寄凭条一起保存了。

collocations: a status reading “Accepted at post office”

words.enDefinition: A status meaning an office has agreed to process a request

examples.en: The portal showed my file as accepted for processing after the initial checks.
examples.zh: 初步检查后，政务平台把我的案卷标为「已受理办理」。

examples.en: The clerk explained what accepted for processing meant for my file's stage.
examples.zh: 办事员解释了「已受理办理」表示我的案卷到了哪个阶段。

collocations: mark a request accepted for processing
notice that a file was accepted for processing

words.enDefinition: an appointment arranged so a person can use a service with the access they need

examples.en: I requested an accessible appointment because I needed a step-free entrance.
examples.zh: 我需要用无台阶的入口，所以申请了「有无障碍安排的预约」。

examples.en: The confirmation gave the location of my accessible appointment near the lift.
examples.zh: 确认信息写明，我的「有无障碍安排的预约」办理点在电梯附近。

words.enDefinition: a permit authorizing access to designated parking spaces or accommodations under local rules

examples.en: The office explained where the accessible parking permit information appeared in the form.
examples.zh: 办事处说明了表格哪个位置有「无障碍停车许可」的信息。

examples.en: I checked the named holder on the accessible parking permit in the example.
examples.zh: 我核对了示例「无障碍停车许可」上列出的持有人。

collocations: apply for an accessible parking permit

words.enDefinition: Confirmation that an office received documents, a submission, or correspondence

examples.en: The department sent an acknowledgment of receipt before posting any status update.
examples.zh: 部门在发布进度消息之前，先发了「收件确认」。

examples.en: I kept the acknowledgment of receipt with a copy of the original letter.
examples.zh: 我把「收件确认」与原信的副本放在一起保存。

words.enDefinition: A recipient's formal confirmation of receipt of an official document

examples.en: I checked the date on the acknowledgment of service before returning the form.
examples.zh: 我交回表格前，核对了「正式送达确认书」上的日期。

examples.en: The office kept the acknowledgment of service behind the envelope in my file.
examples.zh: 办事处把「正式送达确认书」放在案卷里的信封后。

words.enDefinition: introduces the official role in which someone performed an act

examples.en: The form used 'Acting in the capacity of' before the name of the official's role.
examples.zh: 表格在官员的职务名称前用了「以某种职务身份行事」的表述。

examples.en: I read 'Acting in the capacity of' on the line immediately below the signature details.
examples.zh: 我在签名资料正下方的一行看到了「以某种职务身份行事」。

collocations: acting in the capacity of a registrar
acting in the capacity of a notary
the words acting in the capacity of

words.enDefinition: to create one more field group or row for additional information

examples.en: I clicked add another entry to include my second address from last year.
examples.zh: 我点了「再添加一条记录」，补上去年第二个住址。

examples.en: The form asked whether I needed to add another entry before continuing.
examples.zh: 表格问我进入下一步前是否需要「再添加一条记录」。

collocations: ask if you need to add another entry
add another entry in the list

words.enDefinition: a further appointment arranged when one visit does not cover everything needed

examples.en: The clerk booked an additional appointment to review the document that was missing.
examples.zh: 办事员安排了「额外一次预约」，要查验目前还缺的材料。

examples.en: I asked whether I would need an additional appointment to collect the certificate.
examples.zh: 我问领证书需不需要「额外一次预约」。

words.enDefinition: To write the recipient's details on an envelope

examples.en: I asked how to address an envelope to the department named in the letter.
examples.zh: 我问寄给信上写的部门时，怎样「在信封上写地址」。

examples.en: My flatmate helped me address an envelope for the document I was mailing.
examples.zh: 室友帮我「在寄文件的信封上写了地址」。

collocations: address an envelope to an office
check how to address an envelope

words.enDefinition: a list of previous addresses and often the dates when someone lived at each

examples.en: The form requested an address history for the period stated on the page.
examples.zh: 表格要求提供页面所标期间的「历次住址记录」。

examples.en: I checked my address history against the old rental agreements in my folder.
examples.zh: 我用文件夹里的旧租约核对了「历次住址记录」。

words.enDefinition: A label showing where mail should be delivered

examples.en: I replaced the address label because the office name had changed since last term.
examples.zh: 办事处名称从上学期后就改了，所以我换了「地址贴签」。

examples.en: The postal clerk checked the address label before scanning the envelope at the counter.
examples.zh: 邮局柜台工作人员在柜台扫信封之前，先核对了「地址贴签」。

words.enDefinition: the first address field on a form, often used for street and building details

examples.en: The example puts the street and building number in address line one.
examples.zh: 示例把街道和楼号放在「地址第一行」。

examples.en: I corrected address line one after the website showed the wrong building number.
examples.zh: 网页显示的楼号不对，我更正了「地址第一行」。

collocations: enter the street in address line one

words.enDefinition: an additional address field often used for details such as a unit number

examples.en: I entered the flat number in address line two after reading the example.
examples.zh: 看过示例之后，我在「地址第二行」填了公寓房号。

examples.en: The form let me leave address line two blank when it was unnecessary.
examples.zh: 表格允许我在不需要填写时把「地址第二行」留空。

collocations: put the unit in address line two

words.enDefinition: A notice that the addressee could not be identified there

examples.en: The returned envelope had a stamp saying “Addressee unknown” beside the name.
examples.zh: 退回的信封在姓名旁盖了一个章，写着「无法确认收件人」。

examples.en: I asked the postal clerk what “Addressee unknown” meant in the delivery record.
examples.zh: 我问邮局柜台工作人员，投递记录里的「无法确认收件人」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: formally receive an oath from the person making it

examples.en: The note identified the person who had agreed to administer an oath during the appointment.
examples.zh: 备注列出了同意在这次会面中「主持他人宣誓」的人。

examples.en: I asked what administer an oath meant in the description of the officer's role.
examples.zh: 我问工作人员职责说明里，「主持他人宣誓」是什么意思。

collocations: be authorized to administer an oath
ask an officer to administer an oath

words.enDefinition: A mistake made while an office processes or records something

examples.en: The letter said an administrative error had affected the date recorded.
examples.zh: 信中说，「行政处理错误」影响了记录的日期。

examples.en: The clerk checked whether the discrepancy was an administrative error.
examples.zh: 办事员核对了这处不一致是否属于「行政处理错误」。

words.enDefinition: A formal review of a decision through an administrative process

examples.en: The UK guide listed administrative review under the decision section.
examples.zh: 英国指南把「行政复核」列在决定一节里。

examples.en: I asked which notice explained the meaning of administrative review here.
examples.zh: 我问哪份通知解释了这里的「行政复核」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: Closed by an administrative action without necessarily resolving the merits

examples.en: My copy said the case was administratively closed under that heading.
examples.zh: 我的副本在那个标题下写着案件「已作行政结案」。

examples.en: I asked which letter explained why the file was administratively closed.
examples.zh: 我问哪封信说明了案卷为何「已作行政结案」。

words.enDefinition: A U.S. I-94 field recording the authorized stay endpoint

examples.en: I found admit until date on the U.S. arrival record below my name.
examples.zh: 我在美国入境记录的姓名下方找到了「获准停留截止栏」。

examples.en: The adviser explained where the admit until date appeared in the example on screen.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了屏幕上的例子在哪里显示「美国获准停留截止栏」。

words.enDefinition: An official certificate recording an adoption in the authority's records

examples.en: The UK booklet showed where the adoption certificate was named.
examples.zh: 英国手册指明了在哪个位置提到「收养证明」。

examples.en: I asked which details an adoption certificate listed in the example.
examples.zh: 我问示例里的「收养证明」列了哪些信息。

collocations: a copy of an adoption certificate

words.enDefinition: A decision with an unfavorable outcome for a person affected

examples.en: The adviser explained how the guide defined an adverse decision.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了指南怎样定义「对当事人不利的决定」。

examples.en: The notice identified the office that issued the adverse decision.
examples.zh: 通知写明了哪个办事处作出了「对当事人不利的决定」。

words.enDefinition: To leave an earlier decision unchanged after reviewing it

examples.en: The Australian leaflet explained what it means to affirm the decision.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚的说明单解释了「维持该项决定」是什么意思。

examples.en: The written outcome showed that the tribunal chose to affirm the decision.
examples.zh: 书面结果显示审裁机构选择「维持该项决定」。

collocations: a tribunal may affirm the decision
state whether to affirm the decision

words.enDefinition: To attach a stamp or postage label

examples.en: The guide used affix postage when describing the space on the sample envelope.
examples.zh: 指南在说明样本信封上的位置时用了「贴上邮资凭证」一词。

examples.en: I asked where to affix postage on the envelope with the window.
examples.zh: 我问开窗信封的哪里可以「贴上邮资凭证」。

words.enDefinition: Letters or messages exchanged with a government body about official business

examples.en: I saved the agency correspondence in the same folder as my paperwork.
examples.zh: 我把「政务机构往来函件」和申请材料放在同一个文件夹。

examples.en: The adviser helped me put the agency correspondence in date order.
examples.zh: 顾问帮我按日期排好了「政务机构往来函件」。

words.enDefinition: Mail carried by air for part of its journey

examples.en: I noticed the word airmail printed on the envelope from the overseas university.
examples.zh: 我注意到海外大学寄来的信封上印着「航空邮件」。

examples.en: The example showed an airmail sticker beside the country name on the envelope.
examples.zh: 例图中，信封的国家名称旁贴着一张「航空邮件」贴纸。

words.enDefinition: a separate sheet joined to a document for an added certificate

examples.en: The handbook described an allonge as the separate sheet shown next to the certificate.
examples.zh: 手册把证书旁展示的那张单独的纸称为「附接文书的附页」。

examples.en: I found the certificate on an allonge at the back of the sample file.
examples.zh: 我在样本文件的背面找到了一张「附接文书的附页」，证书就在上面。

collocations: attach a certificate on an allonge
an allonge attached to a document

words.enDefinition: To decide in favor of all or part of an appeal

examples.en: The panel explained its decision to allow the appeal in the last paragraph.
examples.zh: 小组在最后一段解释了为什么决定「判申诉成立」。

examples.en: I read why the tribunal chose to allow the appeal after reviewing the papers.
examples.zh: 我读了审裁机构审查书面材料后决定「判申诉成立」的理由。

collocations: a tribunal may allow the appeal
an order to allow the appeal

words.enDefinition: characters that consist of letters or numerals rather than punctuation or symbols

examples.en: The reference field accepted alphanumeric characters but rejected the slash in my entry.
examples.zh: 查询编号字段接受「字母和数字字符」，但拒绝了我填的斜杠。

examples.en: The help note said the code used alphanumeric characters in that box.
examples.zh: 帮助说明说，那个框里的编号使用「字母和数字字符」。

words.enDefinition: a person who can be contacted if the main contact is unavailable

examples.en: The agency asked for an alternate contact in case it could not reach me.
examples.zh: 该机构要求提供一名「备用联系人」，以防联系不到我。

examples.en: I checked whether my alternate contact was still willing to receive the calls.
examples.zh: 我确认了「备用联系人」是否还愿意接听这些电话。

words.enDefinition: to change an answer that has already been entered or recorded

examples.en: I needed to amend an answer after finding the old letter at home.
examples.zh: 我在家找到旧信后，需要「修改一项答案」。

examples.en: The portal explained when I could amend an answer before final submission.
examples.zh: 门户网站说明了最终提交前，什么时候可以「修改一项答案」。

collocations: amend an answer on the form

words.enDefinition: An official decision changed after the original was issued

examples.en: The amended decision replaced one condition listed in the original.
examples.zh: 「修订后的决定」更改了原决定中所列的一项条件。

examples.en: I read the amended decision beside the earlier version of the decision.
examples.zh: 我把「修订后的决定」和较早的版本放在一起看。

words.enDefinition: a convention certificate authenticating the origin of a public document

examples.en: The apostille appeared on a separate sheet attached to the document I was reading.
examples.zh: 我读的那份文件附了一张单独的纸，上面是「附加证明书」。

examples.en: I asked which details the apostille recorded about the signature beneath the original statement.
examples.zh: 我问「附加证明书」记录了关于原声明下方签名的哪些信息。

collocations: an apostille attached to a document

words.enDefinition: an international convention providing for a standard form of document authentication
acceptedZhAnswers: 取消外国公文书认证要求的公约

examples.en: The booklet referred to the Apostille Convention in its section on the certificate's title.
examples.zh: 小册子介绍证书标题的章节提到了「海牙附加证明书公约」。

examples.en: I saw the name of the Apostille Convention under the form's main heading.
examples.zh: 我在表格主标题下方看到了「海牙附加证明书公约」的名称。

collocations: the text of the Apostille Convention

words.enDefinition: the identifier assigned to a particular apostille

examples.en: I compared the apostille number on the printed page with the one in the email.
examples.zh: 我把打印页上的「附加证明书编号」和邮件里的编号作了比对。

examples.en: The apostille number appeared in a small field near the end of the certificate.
examples.zh: 「附加证明书编号」在证书接近末尾的一个小栏里。

collocations: the field for an apostille number

words.enDefinition: a record of apostilles issued by a designated authority

examples.en: The guide showed where an apostille register entry appeared in the verification example.
examples.zh: 指南在查验样例里标出了「附加证明书登记册」的条目在哪里。

examples.en: I asked whether the date in the apostille register referred to the certificate's issue.
examples.zh: 我问「附加证明书登记册」里的日期是不是证书签发日期。

collocations: an entry in the apostille register

words.zhGloss: 附有附加证明书的文书
words.enDefinition: a document to which an apostille has been attached or linked
acceptedZhAnswers: 附有附加证明书的文书

examples.en: The office returned the apostilled document in the same envelope as my other records.
examples.zh: 办事处用装我其他档案的同一个信封退回了「附有附加证明书的文书」。

examples.en: I asked whether the attachment showed the entire apostilled document or just the certificate.
examples.zh: 我问附件显示的是整份「附有附加证明书的文书」，还是只有证明书。

collocations: a copy of an apostilled document

words.enDefinition: An independent body authorized to hear certain appeals

examples.en: The notice named the appeal tribunal at the top of the page.
examples.zh: 通知在页首列出了「申诉审裁机构」。

examples.en: I asked which appeal tribunal had issued the final order.
examples.zh: 我问最后的命令是哪家「申诉审裁机构」出具的。

collocations: a hearing before an appeal tribunal

words.enDefinition: A decision that may be challenged through a defined appeal procedure

examples.en: The adviser explained why the manual used the term appealable decision.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了手册为什么使用「可提出申诉的决定」这一术语。

examples.en: The sample labeled one of the outcomes an appealable decision.
examples.zh: 示例把其中一种结果标注为「可提出申诉的决定」。

collocations: a case involving an appealable decision

words.enDefinition: A status saying an application has ceased to be active

examples.en: The agency's letter showed the words application lapsed beside the reference.
examples.zh: 政务机构的信在编号旁写了「申请已失效」。

examples.en: I asked what application lapsed meant in that part of the portal.
examples.zh: 我问平台那一部分的「申请已失效」指什么。

words.enDefinition: an online or printed calendar showing booked appointments or bookable times

examples.en: I opened the appointment calendar to check which days had free slots.
examples.zh: 我打开「预约安排日历」，查看哪些日子还有空位。

examples.en: The appointment calendar showed another office had an opening before the break.
examples.zh: 「预约安排日历」显示，放假前另一家办事处有空位。

words.enDefinition: the act or result of withdrawing a previously booked time

examples.en: The portal confirmed my appointment cancellation after I chose a different office.
examples.zh: 我选择另一家办事处后，门户网站发来了「预约取消」通知。

examples.en: I called to confirm that the appointment cancellation had been recorded for Saturday.
examples.zh: 我打电话确认了周六那次「预约取消」是否已经登记。

words.enDefinition: a small card giving the date, time or location of an appointment

examples.en: The clerk handed me an appointment card with the office address written on it.
examples.zh: 办事员给我一张「预约卡」，上面写了办公地点的地址。

examples.en: I kept my appointment card with the paperwork I needed to bring.
examples.zh: 我把「预约卡」和要带的材料放在一起。

words.enDefinition: the process of telling an office that someone has arrived for their appointment

examples.en: The screen marked appointment check-in as complete when I entered my code.
examples.zh: 我输入编号后，屏幕显示「预约到场签到」已完成。

examples.en: I asked where the appointment check-in would take place for my visit.
examples.zh: 我问这次来办事需要在哪里「预约到场签到」。

collocations: a separate queue for appointment check-in

words.enDefinition: a person whose appointment has been booked under their name

examples.en: The notice asked each appointment holder to have their confirmation ready.
examples.zh: 通知请每位「已预约的人」准备好确认信息。

examples.en: The guard told us which door the appointment holder should go through.
examples.zh: 门卫告诉我们，「已预约的人」应该从哪个门进去。

words.enDefinition: the typical interval between asking to book and the appointment taking place

examples.en: The adviser gave an estimated appointment lead time for the office near campus.
examples.zh: 顾问说明，在学校附近那家办事处「从预约到办理」预计要等多久。

examples.en: I asked whether the appointment lead time changed during the summer holiday.
examples.zh: 我问暑假期间「从预约到办理的间隔」会不会变。

words.enDefinition: a service available only to people who have booked a time in advance

examples.en: The notice described passport collection there as an appointment-only service this week.
examples.zh: 通知说，该点本周领取护照是「仅限预约的服务」。

examples.en: I checked whether the appointment-only service operated from the same office upstairs.
examples.zh: 我查了「仅限预约的服务」是否仍在楼上同一间办公室办理。

collocations: a notice about an appointment-only service

words.enDefinition: a code used to identify a particular booking

examples.en: I entered the appointment reference number at the kiosk outside the service centre.
examples.zh: 我在公共服务中心外的自助终端输入了「预约编号」。

examples.en: The clerk found my booking after I read out the appointment reference number.
examples.zh: 我报出「预约编号」后，办事员找到了我的预约。

words.enDefinition: a notice stating that a service requires a booked appointment

examples.en: The door sign said “appointment required” for visitors collecting replacement documents.
examples.zh: 门上的牌子写着，来领取补发文件的人「须提前预约」。

examples.en: I saw “appointment required” beside the address in the office directory.
examples.zh: 我在办事机构名录里的地址旁看到了「须提前预约」。

words.enDefinition: The period during which an existing appointment can be moved to a different time.

examples.en: I checked the appointment rescheduling window before trying to move my visit to next Thursday.
examples.zh: 我先查看「可改约时段」，再尝试把办事时间改到下周四。

examples.en: The office marked the appointment rescheduling window next to the date in my confirmation email.
examples.zh: 办事处在确认邮件的日期旁注明了「可改约时段」。

collocations: change a booking within the appointment rescheduling window

words.enDefinition: the place where a booked appointment is to take place

examples.en: I confirmed the appointment venue by calling the number on the letter.
examples.zh: 我拨了信上的号码，核实「预约办理地点」。

examples.en: The office gave directions to the appointment venue when I asked by email.
examples.zh: 我发邮件询问后，办事处发来了去「预约办理地点」的路线说明。

words.enDefinition: a list of people waiting for an available appointment time

examples.en: I joined the appointment waitlist because no suitable dates appeared in the calendar.
examples.zh: 日历上没有合适的日期，我就加入了「预约候补名单」。

examples.en: The call centre checked my position on the appointment waitlist that morning.
examples.zh: 电话服务中心那天上午查了我在「预约候补名单」上的位置。

collocations: put someone on an appointment waitlist
remove an entry from the appointment waitlist

words.enDefinition: A preliminary approval indicating agreement before a process is finalized

examples.en: The guide used approval in principle for an earlier stage of the process.
examples.zh: 指南用「原则上批准」来表示流程中前面的一个阶段。

examples.en: The note labeled approval in principle appeared separately from the final letter.
examples.zh: 标为「原则上批准」的备注与最终信函是分开的。

collocations: a letter confirming approval in principle

words.enDefinition: Words introducing the conditions applying to a particular approval

examples.en: The letter said "Approved subject to the listed conditions" beneath the heading.
examples.zh: 信在标题下写着「获批但须满足所列条件」。

examples.en: I asked what "Approved subject to verification" meant on the sample notice.
examples.zh: 我问通知样本上的「获批但须完成核验」是什么意思。

collocations: approved subject to the listed conditions
approved subject to the terms stated

words.enDefinition: a group of digits identifying a geographic telephone area within a numbering system

examples.en: The form asked for the area code before the rest of my phone number.
examples.zh: 表格先要求填写「电话区号」，再填电话号码的其余部分。

examples.en: I checked whether the area code was already included in the number shown.
examples.zh: 我核实了显示的号码是否已经包含「电话区号」。

words.enDefinition: A case status indicating a particular officer has received responsibility

examples.en: The tracker showed my file was assigned to an officer the previous week.
examples.zh: 进度页面显示，我的案卷上星期就「已分派给办理人员」。

examples.en: I received a message saying the case had been assigned to an officer.
examples.zh: 我收到消息，说案件「已分派给办理人员」。

collocations: a case assigned to an officer
mark a file assigned to an officer
confirmation that a case was assigned to an officer

words.enDefinition: help for people who need support to use an online public service

examples.en: The library desk offered an assisted digital service for completing online government forms.
examples.zh: 图书馆服务台提供「数字办事协助服务」，帮助大家填写政府网上表格。

examples.en: I asked whether the assisted digital service required its own appointment at the office.
examples.zh: 我问办事处的「数字办事协助服务」是否需要单独预约。

words.zhGloss: 英国学术技术审批证书
words.enDefinition: A certificate under the UK's Academic Technology Approval Scheme
acceptedZhAnswers: 英国学术技术审批证书

examples.en: The British university's email mentioned an ATAS certificate in its document list.
examples.zh: 英国大学的邮件在材料清单上提到「学术技术审批证书」。

examples.en: I asked where the ATAS certificate number appeared on the sample my adviser showed me.
examples.zh: 我问顾问展示的样本上，「英国学术技术审批证书」的编号印在哪里。

collocations: a copy of an ATAS certificate

words.enDefinition: officially confirm that a particular signature is genuine

examples.en: The guide used 'Authenticate a signature' to explain one part of the certificate's wording.
examples.zh: 指南用「认证签名的真实性」来解释证书措辞的一部分。

examples.en: I asked what it meant to authenticate a signature on the attached public document.
examples.zh: 我问在附上的公文书上「认证签名的真实性」是什么意思。

collocations: be asked to authenticate a signature
an authority can authenticate a signature
a certificate used to authenticate a signature

words.enDefinition: a certificate confirming the origin of an official signature or seal

examples.en: The office attached an authentication certificate to the letter from the issuing agency.
examples.zh: 办事处在签发机构的信函后面附上了「文书认证书」。

examples.en: The clerk checked whether the authentication certificate named the official who had signed.
examples.zh: 办事员确认「文书认证书」上是否写明了签字官员的姓名。

words.enDefinition: a sequence of authentications recorded by different authorities

examples.en: The sample described the different recorded signatures as an authentication chain on the covering sheet.
examples.zh: 样本在封面页把不同环节记录的签名描述为「逐环节认证的记录」。

examples.en: I compared the two pages to see how the authentication chain was recorded in each.
examples.zh: 我对比了两页，看看各自是怎样记载「逐环节认证的记录」的。

collocations: the authentication chain for a document

words.enDefinition: a mark recording formal confirmation of a document's origin

examples.en: The authentication stamp was printed below a line naming the official whose signature was checked.
examples.zh: 「文书来源认证章」印在一行字下面，那行字列出了签名经查验的官员。

examples.en: I could see the authentication stamp more clearly on the second scan of the document.
examples.zh: 文件第二次扫描的版本上，我能更清楚地看见「文书来源认证章」。

words.enDefinition: an examination to help establish whether something is genuine

examples.en: The letter described an authenticity check of the seal printed on the attached statement.
examples.zh: 信里说，对所附声明上印的印章做了「真伪查验」。

examples.en: I asked which field on the record referred to the authenticity check of my certificate.
examples.zh: 我问记录里哪个栏位提到我的证书的「真伪查验」。

collocations: an authenticity check on a document

words.enDefinition: collection of an item by someone who has permission to act for the intended recipient

examples.en: The office explained its form for authorized collection of completed documents.
examples.zh: 办事处说明了办好的文件要「经授权代领」时用哪张表。

examples.en: I asked whether authorized collection was available at the smaller branch near campus.
examples.zh: 我问学校附近较小的办事点能不能办理「经授权代领」。

words.enDefinition: someone given permission to act or communicate for another person in a stated matter

examples.en: The form asked whether I wanted to name an authorized representative for this application.
examples.zh: 表格问我是否想为这项申请指定一名「经授权的代理人」。

examples.en: The clerk confirmed which letters would be copied to the authorized representative.
examples.zh: 办事员确认了哪些信件会抄送给「经授权的代理人」。

words.enDefinition: someone permitted to witness a particular document or declaration

examples.en: The letter named the authorized witness in a box beside the declaration on my copy.
examples.zh: 这封信在我那份声明旁边的框内写明了「获授权的见证人」。

examples.en: I asked what authorized witness referred to on the Australian sample we had received.
examples.zh: 我问收到的澳大利亚样本上，「获授权的见证人」指什么。

collocations: a statement by an authorized witness

words.enDefinition: a recorded system that directs callers according to the options they select

examples.en: The automated phone menu gave me a choice of several spoken languages.
examples.zh: 「电话语音菜单」让我从好几种语言中选择。

examples.en: I listened to the automated phone menu before choosing the document option.
examples.zh: 我先听了「电话语音菜单」，再选择文件业务选项。

collocations: listen to an automated phone menu

words.enDefinition: Waiting for information or confirmation from an outside organization or person

examples.en: The portal listed one item as awaiting third-party confirmation on the checklist.
examples.zh: 政务平台在清单上把一项内容列为「等待第三方确认」。

examples.en: My adviser explained that the phrase awaiting third-party confirmation described that step.
examples.zh: 顾问解释，那个步骤用「等待第三方确认」来描述。

collocations: show a file as awaiting third-party confirmation

words.zhGloss: 盖有某机构或人员的章
words.enDefinition: identifies whose seal appears on a document
acceptedZhAnswers: 盖有某机构或人员的章

examples.en: The sample says the page bears the seal of the office named underneath.
examples.zh: 样本说，那一页「盖有下方所列办公室的章」。

examples.en: I noticed bears the seal of in the line describing the attached document.
examples.zh: 我注意到，描述所附文件的那行写了「盖有某机构或人员的章」。

collocations: bears the seal of the registrar
bears the seal of the issuing office
the words bears the seal of

words.enDefinition: a document containing text in two languages

examples.en: The bilingual document placed the two versions of the statement in separate columns.
examples.zh: 「双语文件」把这份声明的两个语言版本放在不同的栏里。

examples.en: I checked both headings on the bilingual document before asking which version to read.
examples.zh: 我看了「双语文件」里的两个标题，再问该读哪个版本。

collocations: a bilingual document with two columns
a section of a bilingual document

words.enDefinition: a written record that identifies the parties and describes the transfer of a vehicle for payment

examples.en: I kept the bill of sale with the other documents after collecting the used car.
examples.zh: 我取到二手车后，把「车辆买卖凭据」和其他文件放在一起。

examples.en: The clerk showed me which line on the bill of sale stated the price.
examples.zh: 办事员指给我看，「车辆买卖凭据」上的哪一行写了价格。

collocations: keep a copy of the bill of sale

words.zhGloss: 加拿大生物信息采集指示函
words.enDefinition: A Canadian notice about providing biometric identifiers
acceptedZhAnswers: 加拿大生物信息采集指示函

examples.en: I located the reference number in the Canadian biometric instruction letter on my phone.
examples.zh: 我在手机上打开「加拿大生物信息采集指示函」，找到了编号。

examples.en: The adviser pointed to the heading biometric instruction letter in the sample file.
examples.zh: 顾问指着样本档案中「加拿大生物信息采集指示函」这个标题。

collocations: details in a biometric instruction letter

words.enDefinition: A passport containing a chip with digitally stored identifying information

examples.en: The passport office showed us the symbol for a biometric passport.
examples.zh: 护照办事处给我们看了「生物识别护照」的标志。

examples.en: In class we examined a diagram of a biometric passport cover.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们看了一张「生物识别护照」封面示意图。

words.zhGloss: 英国旧式生物识别居留卡
words.enDefinition: A former physical UK card recording immigration permission
acceptedZhAnswers: 英国旧式生物识别居留卡

examples.en: My old biometric residence permit was in the folder with my previous UK documents.
examples.zh: 我把「英国旧式生物识别居留卡」和以往的英国文件放在同一个文件夹里。

examples.en: The adviser showed a biometric residence permit as an example of an older document.
examples.zh: 顾问用一张「英国旧式生物识别居留卡」举例，说明以前的文件是什么样的。

collocations: a copy of a biometric residence permit

words.enDefinition: An appointment to collect identification data such as fingerprints

examples.en: I checked the location printed on my biometrics appointment notice before leaving campus.
examples.zh: 离开校园前，我查了「生物信息采集预约」通知上印的地点。

examples.en: The letter gave a reference number for the biometrics appointment on the first page.
examples.zh: 那封信在第一页给出了「生物信息采集预约」的编号。

words.enDefinition: An official document certifying information recorded about a person's birth

examples.en: I checked how my birthplace appeared on the birth certificate.
examples.zh: 我核对了「出生证明」上自己的出生地是怎样写的。

examples.en: The office asked which version of my birth certificate I had brought.
examples.zh: 办事处问我带来的是哪个版本的「出生证明」。

collocations: a copy of a birth certificate

words.enDefinition: An official notification to a local authority that a birth occurred

examples.en: The registrar distinguished a birth notification from the certificate issued later.
examples.zh: 登记员说明了「出生通知单」与后来签发的证书有什么区别。

examples.en: I asked which institution had sent the birth notification in the file.
examples.zh: 我问档案里的「出生通知单」是哪个机构发出的。

words.enDefinition: An official change fixing an error in a birth record

examples.en: I asked what the label birth record correction meant on the old entry.
examples.zh: 我问旧条目中「出生记录更正」的标记是什么意思。

examples.en: The office confirmed which date belonged to the birth record correction on file.
examples.zh: 办事处确认了档案中哪个日期对应「出生记录更正」。

collocations: a notice of birth record correction

words.enDefinition: An official collection of individual entries recording births in an area

examples.en: The registrar checked the birth register for the year I mentioned.
examples.zh: 登记员查了我提到的那一年的「出生登记簿」。

examples.en: I asked which town appeared in the birth register beside the date.
examples.zh: 我问「出生登记簿」上的日期旁写的是哪个城镇。

collocations: an entry in the birth register
record a birth in the birth register

words.enDefinition: The process of officially recording the details of a birth

examples.en: The office kept the birth registration and the certificate in separate sections.
examples.zh: 办事处把「出生登记」和证书放在不同的栏目。

examples.en: I asked which date was shown for my birth registration on the file.
examples.zh: 我问档案里我的「出生登记」日期写的是哪一天。

words.enDefinition: The date on which a birth was officially entered into records

examples.en: My birth registration date appeared on a different line from my birthday.
examples.zh: 我的「出生登记日期」与我的生日分别列在不同行上。

examples.en: The registrar explained which field contained the birth registration date in that entry.
examples.zh: 登记员解释了该条目哪一栏包含「出生登记日期」。

collocations: the birth registration date on file

words.enDefinition: a copy of a form on which no answers have yet been entered

examples.en: I asked for a blank form after spilling coffee on my first copy.
examples.zh: 我把咖啡洒在第一份表上，便又要了份「空白表格」。

examples.en: The receptionist kept a stack of blank form copies near the front desk.
examples.zh: 接待员在前台附近放了一叠「空白表格」。

words.enDefinition: A page in a passport without stamps or other added entries

examples.en: I saw a blank passport page near the middle of the booklet.
examples.zh: 我在本子中间附近看到一张「空白护照页」。

examples.en: The example showed the difference between a blank passport page and the data page.
examples.zh: 示例展示了「空白护照页」和资料页有什么区别。

collocations: check for a blank passport page
a blank passport page in the booklet

words.enDefinition: A small booklet containing several postage stamps

examples.en: I bought a book of stamps while I waited for the office to open.
examples.zh: 等办事处开门时，我买了「一本邮票」。

examples.en: The postal clerk showed me a book of stamps from the drawer below the counter.
examples.zh: 邮局柜台工作人员从柜台下的抽屉里拿出「一本邮票」给我看。

collocations: use a stamp from a book of stamps

words.enDefinition: an online service for booking and managing an appointment or reservation

examples.en: The email included a link to the booking portal for that office.
examples.zh: 邮件附了该办事处「预约网上入口」的链接。

examples.en: I used the booking portal to check the address of my appointment.
examples.zh: 我通过「预约网上入口」查看了赴约地点的地址。

collocations: log in to the booking portal

words.enDefinition: the front and reverse surfaces of the same document

examples.en: The note referred to both sides of the document while my copy only showed the front.
examples.zh: 备注提到了「文件的正反两面」，我的副本却只有正面。

examples.en: I turned the sheet over to see whether both sides of the document carried text.
examples.zh: 我把纸翻过来，看看「文件的正反两面」是不是都有文字。

collocations: show both sides of the document
read both sides of the document
include both sides of the document

words.enDefinition: Australian temporary permission used during certain immigration transitions

examples.en: The Australian information sheet explained the term bridging visa beside a sample notice.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚说明单在通知样本旁解释了「过桥签证」一词。

examples.en: I asked which bridging visa category the Australian document had named in the heading.
examples.zh: 我问澳大利亚文件的标题写的是哪种「过桥签证」。

words.enDefinition: An Australian bridging visa category with temporary travel permission

examples.en: The Australian guide gave Bridging Visa B its own heading below the general information.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚指南在总说明下为「B类过桥签证」设了一个独立标题。

examples.en: The adviser asked whether the Australian example was labelled Bridging Visa B.
examples.zh: 顾问问，那个澳大利亚例子是否标明为「B类过桥签证」。

collocations: conditions on a Bridging Visa B

words.enDefinition: a short account of something that gives its most relevant details

examples.en: The office asked for a brief description of the document that was missing.
examples.zh: 办事处要求「简要说明」缺的是哪份文件。

examples.en: I wrote a brief description before attaching the photograph to the form.
examples.zh: 把照片附到表格上之前，我写了「简要说明」。

words.enDefinition: to move a previously booked appointment to an earlier time or date

examples.en: The clerk offered to bring the appointment forward after another applicant cancelled.
examples.zh: 另一名申请人取消后，办事员提出可以「把预约提前」。

examples.en: I asked if they could bring the appointment forward to Tuesday morning.
examples.zh: 我问能不能「把预约提前」到周二上午。

collocations: ask to bring the appointment forward
offer to bring the appointment forward
bring the appointment forward by a day

words.enDefinition: an instruction to bring the original documents to an appointment

examples.en: The appointment letter ended with the reminder, “Please bring the originals with you.”
examples.zh: 信上写着，赴约时「请随身带上原件」。

examples.en: I read the note saying “bring the originals with you” before packing my folder.
examples.zh: 收拾文件夹之前，我看到了「请随身带上原件」的提醒。

collocations: please bring the originals with you
bring the originals with you for inspection
bring the originals with you to the appointment

words.enDefinition: the number assigned to an individual building on a street or site

examples.en: The clerk copied the building number from the first line of my address.
examples.zh: 办事员从地址第一行抄下了「楼号」。

examples.en: I corrected the building number because two nearby addresses looked very similar.
examples.zh: 附近有两个地址很像，我更正了「楼号」。

words.zhGloss: 美国邮政收件方付费回邮
words.enDefinition: A USPS service charging the recipient for replies
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国邮政收件方付费回邮

examples.en: The reply envelope was marked Business Reply Mail above the name of the U.S. office.
examples.zh: 回邮信封在美国办事处名称上方标着「美国邮政收件方付费回邮」。

examples.en: The postal guide showed Business Reply Mail on a sample envelope for an application form.
examples.zh: 邮政指南在申请表的信封样本上展示了「美国邮政收件方付费回邮」的标记。

collocations: return a letter by Business Reply Mail

words.enDefinition: official permission to perform music or another act in a public space

examples.en: The violinist kept a copy of her busking permit in the instrument case.
examples.zh: 小提琴手在琴盒里放了一份「街头表演许可证」的复印件。

examples.en: The busking permit listed two locations where the band could perform that month.
examples.zh: 「街头表演许可证」列出乐队当月可以演出的两个地点。

words.enDefinition: how long a caller waits before speaking to someone or being connected

examples.en: The recording gave an estimated call wait time before music started playing.
examples.zh: 开始播放音乐前，录音报了预计的「电话接通等待时间」。

examples.en: I checked the call wait time shown on the service page at lunch.
examples.zh: 午饭时，我看了服务页面显示的「电话接通等待时间」。

words.enDefinition: asked to come to a service desk when it is your turn

examples.en: I was called to the counter just after putting the forms in order.
examples.zh: 我刚把表格理好，就「被叫到柜台」。

examples.en: We put our phones away when we were called to the counter.
examples.zh: 我们「被叫到柜台」时，把手机收了起来。

collocations: wait to be called to the counter
after being called to the counter

words.enDefinition: The university office that handles mail

examples.en: I asked the campus mailroom whether the government letter had arrived for me.
examples.zh: 我问「校园邮件收发室」，寄给我的政府来信到了没有。

examples.en: The campus mailroom sent a message about a document envelope addressed to me.
examples.zh: 「校园邮件收发室」发来消息，说有一个写着我姓名的文件信封。

collocations: collect mail from the campus mailroom

words.zhGloss: 他人取消后释放的时段
words.enDefinition: an appointment time made available because an earlier booking was cancelled
acceptedZhAnswers: 他人取消后释放的时段

examples.en: I accepted a cancellation slot that opened after lunch on Thursday.
examples.zh: 我接受了周四午后空出的「他人取消后释放的时段」。

examples.en: The receptionist called me when a cancellation slot became available that afternoon.
examples.zh: 当天下午有「他人取消后释放的时段」时，前台打电话通知了我。

words.enDefinition: A passport made invalid by an official action before or after expiry

examples.en: The office marked the old document as a cancelled passport in my record.
examples.zh: 办事处在我的档案中把旧证件标为「已注销的护照」。

examples.en: The guide used a sample to illustrate a cancelled passport.
examples.zh: 指南用一份样本展示了「已注销的护照」。

words.enDefinition: Stiff cardboard placed behind paper for support

examples.en: The certificate arrived with cardboard backing inside the envelope to keep it flat.
examples.zh: 证书随信封寄来，里面垫了「硬纸板衬底」，使它保持平整。

examples.en: I cut a piece of cardboard backing to fit the document envelope I had bought.
examples.zh: 我裁了一块「硬纸板衬底」，让它能放进我买的文件信封。

collocations: mail a document with cardboard backing

words.enDefinition: A phrase routing mail through a named intermediary

examples.en: The adviser suggested writing care of before the campus mailroom's name on the envelope.
examples.zh: 顾问建议在信封上校园邮件收发室的名称前写「由该机构代收」。

examples.en: I asked what care of meant below my name on the official letter.
examples.zh: 我问官方来信上我姓名下方的「由……代收」是什么意思。

collocations: send mail care of an office
address a letter care of someone
write care of on the address line

words.zhGloss: 英国学习录取确认编号
words.enDefinition: The unique reference for a UK study sponsorship record
acceptedZhAnswers: 英国学习录取确认编号

examples.en: I found the CAS reference number in the message from my UK university.
examples.zh: 我在英国大学发来的消息里找到了「学习录取确认编号」。

examples.en: The adviser asked me to read out the CAS reference number shown in the email.
examples.zh: 顾问让我读出邮件里显示的「英国学习录取确认编号」。

collocations: a CAS reference number in an email

words.enDefinition: A message formally advising that an agency has closed a case

examples.en: I received a case closure notice after the status changed online.
examples.zh: 在线状态变更后，我收到了一份「案件结案通知」。

examples.en: The agency kept the case closure notice under the original case number.
examples.zh: 政务机构把「案件结案通知」归在原来的案件编号下。

collocations: a copy of the case closure notice

words.enDefinition: An online view displaying the latest information about a case

examples.en: My case dashboard showed a new message next to the latest status.
examples.zh: 「案件总览页面」在最新状态旁显示有新消息。

examples.en: I opened the case dashboard to see which reference matched the letter.
examples.zh: 我打开「案件总览页面」，看哪个编号与信件一致。

collocations: a link to the case dashboard

words.enDefinition: A notice label indicating a tribunal or authority dismissed a case

examples.en: The register showed case dismissed on the line below the hearing date.
examples.zh: 登记册在听证日期下一行显示「案件已驳回」。

examples.en: I checked which order accompanied the message case dismissed that morning.
examples.zh: 我核对了那天早上写有「案件已驳回」的消息附的是哪份命令。

words.enDefinition: The formal outcome or manner in which a case ends

examples.en: The US form listed case disposition as its final field.
examples.zh: 美国的表格把「案件处理结果」列为最后一栏。

examples.en: The clerk explained how the case disposition appeared in the register.
examples.zh: 办事员解释了「案件处理结果」在登记册中是怎样呈现的。

words.enDefinition: the process of receiving new requests and recording their initial details

examples.en: The sign labelled the first counter as case intake for newly submitted requests.
examples.zh: 牌子标明，第一个柜台办理新提交请求的「个案初次受理」。

examples.en: The office asked for a short description of the problem during case intake.
examples.zh: 「个案初次受理」时，办事处让申请人简要描述问题。

words.enDefinition: Words indicating that a case is still awaiting a decision

examples.en: The page said the case is pending under the file number.
examples.zh: 页面在案卷编号下显示「案件尚待处理」。

examples.en: I saved the message that said the case is pending this morning.
examples.zh: 我保存了今天上午那条写有「案件尚待处理」的消息。

collocations: a notice saying the case is pending

words.enDefinition: A meeting about organizing the steps of a case

examples.en: The letter listed a case management conference before the hearing information.
examples.zh: 信件先列了「案件程序协调会议」，再写听证信息。

examples.en: I checked which issue the case management conference was meant to discuss.
examples.zh: 我核对了「案件程序协调会议」要讨论哪个问题。

words.enDefinition: Formal instructions organizing the steps and handling of a case

examples.en: The case management directions set out the schedule in a separate paragraph.
examples.zh: 「案件程序指示」在单独一段中列明了安排。

examples.en: I asked which document contained the case management directions for that hearing.
examples.zh: 我问哪份文件包含那次听证的「案件程序指示」。

collocations: a copy of the case management directions

words.enDefinition: Brief records made by officials while handling an individual case

examples.en: The officer found my earlier message mentioned in the case notes.
examples.zh: 工作人员在「案件办理记录」里找到了对我先前那条消息的记载。

examples.en: The adviser explained which date appeared in the case notes.
examples.zh: 顾问说明了「案件办理记录」里显示的是哪个日期。

collocations: an entry in the case notes

words.enDefinition: An identifier an agency uses to track a particular case

examples.en: The clerk read back my case number before opening the file.
examples.zh: 办事员复述了我的「案件编号」，才打开档案。

examples.en: I checked whether both messages referred to the same case number.
examples.zh: 我核对了两条消息是不是提到了同一个「案件编号」。

collocations: a letter with your case number

words.enDefinition: an official assigned to review or decide an individual case or application

examples.en: The case officer reviewed the documents before asking about the missing date.
examples.zh: 「个案审核人员」先审查了文件，再问漏填的日期。

examples.en: I addressed my reply to the case officer listed at the top of the letter.
examples.zh: 我把回信写给了信件顶部列出的「个案审核人员」。

words.enDefinition: The staff group responsible for handling a case or filing

examples.en: The case processing team sent a short update before the letter arrived.
examples.zh: 信件到达前，「案件办理团队」发了一条简短的进度更新。

examples.en: I asked which case processing team handled the older applications from that region.
examples.zh: 我问该地区较早的申请由哪个「案件办理团队」负责。

collocations: an update from the case processing team
refer a file to the case processing team

words.enDefinition: treating uppercase and lowercase letters as different for checking or comparison

examples.en: The answer was rejected because the reference field was case sensitive.
examples.zh: 答案没通过，因为查询编号字段「区分字母大小写」。

examples.en: I checked whether the code on the form was case sensitive.
examples.zh: 我确认了表格上的代码是否「区分字母大小写」。

collocations: check whether something is case sensitive

words.enDefinition: A request asking a public agency about a case's progress

examples.en: I used a case status inquiry to confirm which office had my file.
examples.zh: 我发起「案件进度查询」，确认我的案卷在哪个办事处。

examples.en: The office acknowledged my case status inquiry in a separate message.
examples.zh: 办事处另发消息确认收到了我的「案件进度查询」。

collocations: respond to a case status inquiry

words.enDefinition: A message reporting the current position or progress of a case

examples.en: I received a case status update while waiting for the written notice.
examples.zh: 我在等书面通知时，收到了一条「案件状态更新」。

examples.en: The case status update identified the department currently holding my file.
examples.zh: 「案件状态更新」写明了目前是哪个部门在保管我的案卷。

words.enDefinition: A chronological account of key events in an official case

examples.en: The case timeline showed the dates of both messages in order.
examples.zh: 「案件进度时间线」按先后顺序显示了两条消息的日期。

examples.en: I compared my saved letter with the case timeline on the portal.
examples.zh: 我把保存的信件与平台上的「案件进度时间线」作了核对。

collocations: an entry on the case timeline

words.enDefinition: a worker assigned to help a person or family and coordinate their case

examples.en: My caseworker asked for a clearer copy of the paper I sent last week.
examples.zh: 我的「个案承办人员」要我把上周那份材料再发一份更清楚的副本。

examples.en: I left a message for the caseworker named on my appointment letter.
examples.zh: 我给预约信上写明的「个案承办人员」留了言。

words.enDefinition: an office that accepts payment methods other than cash for its services

examples.en: The sign informed visitors that the branch was a cashless office.
examples.zh: 牌子告知访客，该办事点是「不收现金的办事处」。

examples.en: I checked the listed ways to pay at the cashless office downtown.
examples.zh: 我查了市中心「不收现金的办事处」列出的支付方式。

collocations: a sign for a cashless office

words.enDefinition: An identifier printed on an officially issued certificate

examples.en: The clerk showed where the certificate number appeared on the sample.
examples.zh: 办事员指出了样本上「证书编号」的位置。

examples.en: I checked the certificate number before adding the document to my file.
examples.zh: 把文件加入档案之前，我核对了「证书编号」。

words.enDefinition: A US document confirming citizenship acquired without individual naturalization

examples.en: The US clerk compared a Certificate of Citizenship with a naturalization certificate.
examples.zh: 美国办事员比较了「美国公民身份凭证」与入籍证书。

examples.en: I checked which date appeared on the sample Certificate of Citizenship.
examples.zh: 我查看了「美国公民身份凭证」样本上写的是哪个日期。

collocations: details on a Certificate of Citizenship

words.enDefinition: A USPS document showing that an item was presented for mailing

examples.en: I asked for a certificate of mailing when I handed over the envelope.
examples.zh: 我交寄信封时，索要了一份「美国邮政交寄证明」。

examples.en: The clerk stamped the certificate of mailing with the date the letter was accepted.
examples.zh: 柜台工作人员在「美国邮政交寄证明」上盖了邮戳，注明信件收寄日期。

words.enDefinition: An official record confirming that someone acquired citizenship through naturalization

examples.en: The US sample showed where a certificate of naturalization recorded the person's name.
examples.zh: 美国的样本展示了「归化入籍证书」在哪里记录当事人的姓名。

examples.en: The clerk asked which date appeared on the certificate of naturalization.
examples.zh: 办事员问「归化入籍证书」上写的是哪个日期。

collocations: a copy of a certificate of naturalization

words.enDefinition: a marked area for the certification wording and related details

examples.en: The certification block was below the copied text and above the final page number.
examples.zh: 「认证栏」位于复印内容下方、最后一页的页码上方。

examples.en: I asked whether the certification block applied to the whole set of attached pages.
examples.zh: 我问「认证栏」是不是对应整套附页。

words.enDefinition: a note or requirement referring to confirmation on each page

examples.en: The notice referred to certification on every page of the copy in this case.
examples.zh: 通知提到，这一份副本需要「逐页认证」。

examples.en: I asked what certification on every page meant for the blank sheet at the end.
examples.zh: 我问「逐页认证」这句话是否也包括最后那张空白纸。

collocations: look for certification on every page
check for certification on every page
a note about certification on every page

words.enDefinition: a stamp used to mark formal confirmation on a document

examples.en: The certification stamp was faint near the edge of the page I received.
examples.zh: 我收到的那页文件边上，「认证章」的字迹很淡。

examples.en: I could see the certification stamp next to the note saying the copy was complete.
examples.zh: 我看到「认证章」就在说明副本完整的备注旁边。

words.enDefinition: the words used to say what has formally been confirmed

examples.en: I read the certification wording carefully because it mentioned only one side of the document.
examples.zh: 我仔细读了「认证用语」，因为它只提到了文件的一面。

examples.en: The officer pointed out the certification wording between the copied text and the signature.
examples.zh: 工作人员指给我看复印文字和签名之间的「认证用语」。

words.enDefinition: a verified reproduction of selected information from a longer record

examples.en: The office sent a certified extract showing only the entry I had asked about.
examples.zh: 办事处发了一份「经认证的节录件」，只列了我问的那条记录。

examples.en: The certified extract showed the entry on its own, with a seal at the bottom.
examples.zh: 「经认证的节录件」单独列出那条记录，底部有一枚印章。

collocations: a certified extract from a register

words.zhGloss: 美国邮政认证邮件服务
words.enDefinition: A USPS service recording mailing and delivery or attempted delivery
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国邮政认证邮件服务

examples.en: I recognized Certified Mail on the USPS receipt for the document I'd sent.
examples.zh: 我在已寄出文件的美国邮政凭条上认出了「认证邮件服务」这个字样。

examples.en: The clerk pointed to Certified Mail when I asked about the evidence of mailing.
examples.zh: 我问起交寄凭证时，工作人员指了指「美国邮政认证邮件服务」的选项。

collocations: send an item by Certified Mail

words.enDefinition: the identifier NAATI assigns to a certified language professional

examples.en: The Australian directory calls the identifier under the translator's name a Certified Practitioner Number.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚的名录把译员姓名下方的识别号码称为「认证从业人员编号」。

examples.en: I compared the Certified Practitioner Number on the stamp with the entry shown on screen.
examples.zh: 我把章上的「认证从业人员编号」和屏幕显示的条目作了比对。

collocations: a field for the Certified Practitioner Number

words.enDefinition: a translator with a credential recognized by a professional body or authority

examples.en: The Canadian guidance referred to a certified translator beside its examples of translation stamps.
examples.zh: 加拿大的指南在译员印章示例旁提到了「持认证资质的译员」。

examples.en: I read the note from the certified translator before comparing the two versions of the document.
examples.zh: 我先读了「持认证资质的译员」的备注，再对照文件的两个版本。

collocations: a translation by a certified translator

words.enDefinition: information identifying the person who certified a document

examples.en: The certifier's details appeared under a heading that was separate from the copied text.
examples.zh: 「认证人的资料」列在一个单独的标题下面，和复印内容分开。

examples.en: I asked whether the certifier's details on the bottom line were still readable.
examples.zh: 我问最下面一行的「认证人的资料」还能不能看清。

collocations: a box for the certifier's details

words.enDefinition: formally state that a copy matches the original

examples.en: The phrase used to certify as a true copy appeared below a handwritten note.
examples.zh: 用于「证明副本与原件相符」的措辞写在一条手写备注下面。

examples.en: I asked which page the officer had agreed to certify as a true copy.
examples.zh: 我问工作人员答应「证明哪一页副本与原件相符」。

collocations: which page to certify as a true copy
the document you want to certify as a true copy
the photocopy they agreed to certify as a true copy

words.enDefinition: an official who performs a specified certification on a document

examples.en: The certifying officer pointed to the line explaining which parts of the copy were checked.
examples.zh: 「负责认证的官员」指出了说明核对了副本哪些部分的那一行。

examples.en: I asked whether the printed title was that of the certifying officer named on the page.
examples.zh: 我问印出的职务是不是这一页写的那位「负责认证的官员」的。

collocations: a statement from the certifying officer

words.enDefinition: An official document confirming a registered change of someone's name

examples.en: The Australian office asked whether I brought my change of name certificate that day.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚办事处问我当天是否带了「更名证明」。

examples.en: I checked which names appeared on my change of name certificate before the appointment.
examples.zh: 赴约前，我核对了「更名证明」上写了哪些姓名。

collocations: request a change of name certificate
issue a change of name certificate
details on a change of name certificate

words.enDefinition: an update to the official record of the person who keeps a vehicle

examples.en: The letter confirmed the change of registered keeper on the vehicle record.
examples.zh: 信确认车辆记录已「变更车辆登记持有人」。

examples.en: I asked how the UK office labelled a change of registered keeper online.
examples.zh: 我问英国办事处在网上怎样标记「变更车辆登记持有人」。

collocations: record a change of registered keeper
confirm a change of registered keeper
a notice of change of registered keeper

words.enDefinition: A switch between U.S. nonimmigrant immigration categories

examples.en: I asked which words referred to change of status in the U.S. student guidance.
examples.zh: 我问美国学生指南里哪些字眼指的是「非移民身份转换」。

examples.en: The adviser pointed to change of status in the heading on the U.S. letter.
examples.zh: 顾问指出美国来信的标题里写着「非移民身份转换」。

collocations: a decision on change of status

words.enDefinition: an identifier recorded for a vehicle's chassis, sometimes used to identify the entire vehicle

examples.en: The older registration form asked for a chassis number instead of the newer identifier.
examples.zh: 旧版登记表要求填「底盘编号」，没有要求填较新的识别代码。

examples.en: I checked the chassis number written on the vehicle's inspection report.
examples.zh: 我核对了车辆查验报告上写的「底盘编号」。

words.enDefinition: an instruction to select every option that is true or relevant to your case

examples.en: The form said check all that apply before listing ways to contact me.
examples.zh: 表格在列出联系我的方式前写着「勾选所有符合的选项」。

examples.en: I read check all that apply and then chose two options for that question.
examples.zh: 我看到「勾选所有符合的选项」，于是为那道题选了两项。

collocations: an instruction to check all that apply

words.enDefinition: directions explaining how to register your arrival for a booking

examples.en: The check-in instructions explained which desk to visit when I reached the building.
examples.zh: 「到场签到说明」写明了到楼里后要去哪一个服务台。

examples.en: I saved the check-in instructions on my phone because the printed sign was small.
examples.zh: 现场标牌的字很小，我就把「到场签到说明」存到了手机里。

words.enDefinition: a control that can be selected or cleared independently of other options

examples.en: I checked the checkbox to ask for a printed copy of the notice.
examples.zh: 我勾了「复选框」，要求提供一份通知的打印件。

examples.en: The checkbox remained selected when I returned to the previous page.
examples.zh: 我回到上一页时，「复选框」还是勾着的。

words.enDefinition: A passport issued to a person classified as a child

examples.en: The officer explained where the guide discussed a child passport by name.
examples.zh: 工作人员指出指南哪里明确提到了「儿童护照」。

examples.en: I checked the spelling of my niece's name on her child passport.
examples.zh: 我核对了侄女的「儿童护照」上她姓名的拼写。

words.enDefinition: A Canadian certificate issued as official proof of citizenship

examples.en: I uploaded my Canadian citizenship certificate when the registrar requested proof of citizenship.
examples.zh: 教务处要求提供公民身份证明时，我上传了自己的「加拿大公民身份证书」。

examples.en: The clerk compared my name with the name printed on my citizenship certificate.
examples.zh: 办事员把我的姓名与「加拿大公民身份证书」上印的姓名进行了核对。

collocations: a copy of a citizenship certificate

words.enDefinition: a governing body responsible for decisions or public services in a city

examples.en: The city council posted an update about opening hours at the service centre.
examples.zh: 「市议会」发布了服务中心开放时间的更新。

examples.en: I sent a question to the city council about the form on its website.
examples.zh: 我向「市议会」发了消息，询问网站上那张表格的事。

words.enDefinition: a form label asking for the municipality or town used in an address

examples.en: The box marked city or town was just below my street address.
examples.zh: 标注「城市或城镇」的框就在街道地址下方。

examples.en: I asked what to enter under city or town for a rural address.
examples.zh: 我问农村地址在「城市或城镇」字段应该填什么。

collocations: an address field for city or town

words.enDefinition: a legally registered relationship available under the laws of some jurisdictions

examples.en: The form listed civil partnership separately from marriage in the relationship section.
examples.zh: 表格在关系一节里，把「民事伴侣关系」与婚姻分开列出。

examples.en: I read the information explaining which records showed a civil partnership in that country.
examples.zh: 我读了说明，了解该国哪些记录能显示「民事伴侣关系」。

words.enDefinition: An official document certifying a registered civil partnership

examples.en: The UK guide showed an example of a civil partnership certificate.
examples.zh: 英国指南展示了一份「民事伴侣关系证明」的样本。

examples.en: I asked where the civil partnership certificate was listed in the document request.
examples.zh: 我问文件申请的哪个位置列出了「民事伴侣关系证明」。

collocations: a copy of a civil partnership certificate

words.enDefinition: An official collection of entries for one or more life events

examples.en: The registrar found the entry in the civil register for that year.
examples.zh: 登记员在当年的「民事登记簿」里找到了这条记录。

examples.en: I asked which details the civil register showed about the marriage.
examples.zh: 我问「民事登记簿」记了哪些婚姻信息。

collocations: read an entry in the civil register
an extract from the civil register

words.enDefinition: Official recording of life events such as births or marriages

examples.en: The booklet explained what civil registration meant for official records.
examples.zh: 手册解释了官方记录中的「民事登记」是什么意思。

examples.en: I asked which agency maintained the civil registration register for that area.
examples.zh: 我问哪个机构负责保管当地的「民事登记」簿。

words.enDefinition: An office responsible for keeping records of civil life events

examples.en: I asked which civil registry office held our family's older document.
examples.zh: 我问我家的那份旧文件由哪个「民事登记处」保管。

examples.en: The letter named the civil registry office below the registrar's title.
examples.zh: 信里在登记员职称下方列出了「民事登记处」。

collocations: records held by the civil registry office

words.enDefinition: a person employed in the civil service to carry out government work

examples.en: The talk featured a civil servant who worked in a local records office.
examples.zh: 讲座请来了一位在地方档案办公室工作的「公务员」。

examples.en: A civil servant at the desk explained which department handled the form.
examples.zh: 柜台的「公务员」解释了这张表由哪个部门处理。

words.enDefinition: the body of government employees who administer policy and deliver public services

examples.en: The lecturer explained how the civil service supports public offices in that country.
examples.zh: 讲师介绍了该国「公务员体系」怎样支撑公共机构的日常工作。

examples.en: My course included a guest talk about careers in the civil service.
examples.zh: 我的课安排了一场介绍「公务员体系」内职业机会的讲座。

collocations: a career in the civil service

words.enDefinition: The immigration category recorded for admission to the United States

examples.en: I asked where the class of admission appeared on the U.S. Form I-94 sample.
examples.zh: 我问「美国准许入境类别」在 I-94 表样本上出现在哪里。

examples.en: The adviser checked the class of admission against the details in the U.S. student file.
examples.zh: 顾问对照美国留学生档案的信息核对了「准许入境类别」。

collocations: the class of admission on Form I-94

words.enDefinition: A change fixing a recording or typing error in an official record

examples.en: The office noted a clerical correction beside the corrected spelling.
examples.zh: 办事处在更正后的拼写旁标明已作「文书错误更正」。

examples.en: I asked whether the clerical correction had changed the original date.
examples.zh: 我问「文书错误更正」是否改动了原先的日期。

words.enDefinition: to go to a place and pick up something yourself

examples.en: The email said I could collect in person from the office near campus.
examples.zh: 邮件说，我可以到学校附近的办事处「本人到场领取」。

examples.en: I asked whether I needed to collect in person after receiving the notice.
examples.zh: 收到通知后，我问是否必须「本人到场领取」。

collocations: be able to collect in person
ask if you can collect in person

words.enDefinition: To collect a mailed item for another person

examples.en: Can I collect mail on behalf of my flatmate if the letter is in her name?
examples.zh: 如果信件上写的是室友的名字，我可以「代她领取邮件」吗？

examples.en: The notice explained who could collect mail on behalf of the person named on the envelope.
examples.zh: 通知解释了谁可以「代信封上写的人领取邮件」。

collocations: ask to collect mail on behalf of a friend
be allowed to collect mail on behalf of someone
collect mail on behalf of a recipient

words.enDefinition: to pick up an item for you instead of you collecting it personally

examples.en: The form asks who will collect on your behalf if you are away.
examples.zh: 表格问，如果你不在，谁会「代表你去领取」。

examples.en: The clerk explained that someone could collect on your behalf with recorded permission.
examples.zh: 办事员解释，经登记授权后，可以有人「代表你去领取」。

collocations: ask someone to collect on your behalf
allow another person to collect on your behalf
a person who can collect on your behalf

words.enDefinition: a booked time to collect an item or document that has been prepared

examples.en: I scheduled a collection appointment as soon as the office emailed me.
examples.zh: 办事处一发来邮件，我就预约了「领件时段」。

examples.en: The collection appointment was at a different entrance from my first visit.
examples.zh: 这次「领件预约」要从另一个入口进，和我第一次去时不同。

words.enDefinition: The latest date or time an item can be collected

examples.en: The card listed a collection deadline beside the name of the delivery office.
examples.zh: 通知卡在投递办事点名称旁列出了「领取截止日期」。

examples.en: I asked about the collection deadline because the listed branch opened after my first class.
examples.zh: 因为卡上那个网点在我第一节课结束后才开门，我问了「领取截止日期」。

words.enDefinition: a small document used to identify an item or prove a right to collect it

examples.en: The clerk gave me a collection slip after checking my application number.
examples.zh: 办事员核对我的申请编号后，给了我一张「领取凭条」。

examples.en: I took the collection slip with me when I went back on Friday.
examples.zh: 周五再去时，我带上了「领取凭条」。

words.enDefinition: an official authorized to receive oaths in a particular jurisdiction

examples.en: The Canadian sample used commissioner for oaths as the title underneath the official's name.
examples.zh: 加拿大的样本在官员姓名下面用了「监誓员」这个职务名称。

examples.en: I asked why the letter mentioned a commissioner for oaths beside the affidavit heading.
examples.zh: 我问为什么信里在宣誓书标题旁提到「监誓员」。

collocations: a statement before a commissioner for oaths

words.enDefinition: a body officially designated to issue apostilles for particular documents
acceptedZhAnswers: 附加证明书的主管机关

examples.en: The sample named the Competent Authority immediately below the title of the attached certificate.
examples.zh: 样本在所附证书标题的正下方写了「指定签发机关」的名称。

examples.en: I asked which name in the directory referred to the Competent Authority shown on my copy.
examples.zh: 我问目录里的哪个名称对应我这份副本上的「指定签发机关」。

collocations: a certificate from a Competent Authority

words.enDefinition: a service desk where people can report a problem or make a complaint

examples.en: I asked where the complaint desk was after receiving two different instructions.
examples.zh: 听到两种不同说法后，我问「投诉受理台」在哪里。

examples.en: The complaint desk asked for a copy of the letter I had received.
examples.zh: 「投诉受理台」请我提供收到的信件副本。

words.enDefinition: a reproduction containing all parts of the document

examples.en: I thought I had a complete copy until I noticed the printed schedule was missing.
examples.zh: 我以为自己拿的是「完整副本」，后来才发现少了印好的附表。

examples.en: The clerk labelled the pages as a complete copy, including the schedule at the end.
examples.zh: 工作人员把这些页标成「完整副本」，也包括末尾的附表。

words.enDefinition: a translation covering the entire text of the original

examples.en: The complete translation included the small line of text at the bottom of the receipt.
examples.zh: 「完整译文」连回执底部那行小字也译了。

examples.en: I compared the complete translation with the earlier version that had ended after two pages.
examples.zh: 我把「完整译文」和之前只到第二页的版本作了对照。

collocations: compare a complete translation with the source

words.zhGloss: 强制机动车第三方保险
words.enDefinition: legally required motor insurance against specified harm to other people or their property
acceptedZhAnswers: 强制机动车第三方保险

examples.en: The comparison chart listed compulsory third-party insurance separately from optional cover for the driver's car.
examples.zh: 对照表把「强制机动车第三方保险」与驾驶人可自选的本车保障分别列出。

examples.en: The guide explains what compulsory third-party insurance covers in each place on the list.
examples.zh: 指南分地区说明了「强制机动车第三方保险」的承保范围。

collocations: provide evidence of compulsory third-party insurance

words.enDefinition: A code identifying a specific immigration condition

examples.en: The Australian notice showed a condition code beside each description of a restriction.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚的通知为每项限制说明列了一个「许可条件代码」。

examples.en: I asked the adviser where I could find the text for the condition code.
examples.zh: 我问顾问，可以在哪里查到「许可条件代码」对应的正文。

words.enDefinition: An approval that depends on specified conditions being satisfied

examples.en: The letter stated conditional approval and referred us to the enclosed conditions.
examples.zh: 信件写明了「附条件批准」，并提示我们查看随函附上的条件。

examples.en: I asked which notice explained the details of my conditional approval.
examples.zh: 我问哪份通知详细说明了我的「附条件批准」。

words.enDefinition: a selectable box used to record acknowledgment, agreement or confirmation

examples.en: I selected the confirmation checkbox after reading all the information on the page.
examples.zh: 读完整页信息后，我勾选了「确认复选框」。

examples.en: The form flagged the confirmation checkbox because I had left it empty.
examples.zh: 我没勾选「确认复选框」，表格就把它标了出来。

words.zhGloss: 英国学习录取确认记录
words.enDefinition: An electronic sponsorship record for UK student immigration
acceptedZhAnswers: 英国学习录取确认记录

examples.en: The adviser showed me the course title on my Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies.
examples.zh: 顾问指给我看「英国学习录取确认记录」上的课程名称。

examples.en: I compared the Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies with the university's original offer.
examples.zh: 我把英国的「学习录取确认」和学校最初发的录取通知作了对照。

collocations: assign a Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies
issue a Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies
check your Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies

words.zhGloss: 澳大利亚入学注册确认书
words.enDefinition: An official Australian record confirming course enrolment
acceptedZhAnswers: 澳大利亚入学注册确认书

examples.en: My Australian university sent the Confirmation of Enrolment with my course details.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚大学发来了我的「入学注册确认书」，里面有课程信息。

examples.en: The adviser showed which date was printed on the Confirmation of Enrolment in our example.
examples.zh: 顾问指出，我们例子里「澳大利亚入学注册确认书」上印的是哪个日期。

words.enDefinition: to give permission for specified information to be passed to someone else

examples.en: The page asked whether I would consent to share information with another department.
examples.zh: 页面问我是否「同意与另一部门共享资料」。

examples.en: I read the list of recipients before choosing to consent to share information.
examples.zh: 选择「同意共享资料」前，我看了接收方的名单。

collocations: choose whether to consent to share information
be asked to consent to share information
consent to share information with an agency

words.enDefinition: authentication carried out by a consular office for use in another country

examples.en: The guide discussed consular legalization in a section separate from the notarial certificate examples.
examples.zh: 指南把「领事认证」单列成一节，和公证证明书样例分开。

examples.en: I asked which stamp in the scanned file referred to consular legalization for those papers.
examples.zh: 我问扫描档案里的哪枚章指的是这些文件的「领事认证」。

words.enDefinition: An official handling duties at a consulate

examples.en: The consular officer asked which institution was listed in my admission documents.
examples.zh: 「领事官员」问我的录取文件上列的是哪所学校。

examples.en: I asked the consular officer which number on the notice we were discussing.
examples.zh: 我问「领事官员」，我们说的是通知上的哪个号码。

collocations: a question from a consular officer

words.zhGloss: 美国海外出生领事证明
words.enDefinition: A US consular document recording citizenship or nationality acquired at birth abroad
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国海外出生领事证明

examples.en: My university listed a Consular Report of Birth Abroad among its examples of citizenship documents.
examples.zh: 我的大学把「美国海外出生领事证明」列为公民身份文件的示例。

examples.en: The officer pointed out the birth date field on a Consular Report of Birth Abroad.
examples.zh: 工作人员指出了「美国海外出生领事证明」上出生日期的位置。

collocations: request a Consular Report of Birth Abroad
a copy of a Consular Report of Birth Abroad
details on a Consular Report of Birth Abroad

words.enDefinition: the time allowed for affected people or the public to comment on a proposal

examples.en: The council extended the consultation period after residents asked for more time.
examples.zh: 居民希望有更多时间，市政部门于是延长了「意见征询期」。

examples.en: The dates of the consultation period were printed beneath the proposed parking changes.
examples.zh: 拟议停车调整方案的下方印着「意见征询期」的起止日期。

words.enDefinition: a person's preferred way of being contacted about a request or application

examples.en: I marked email as my contact preference when filling out the form.
examples.zh: 填表时，我把电子邮件选为自己的「联系渠道偏好」。

examples.en: The clerk checked my contact preference before sending a reminder the following week.
examples.zh: 办事员核对了我的「联系渠道偏好」，下一周才发提醒。

words.enDefinition: to get in touch with the office responsible for issuing a particular document

examples.en: The clerk told me to contact the issuing office about the printed date.
examples.zh: 办事员让我就印错的日期「联系签发机构」。

examples.en: I needed to contact the issuing office before requesting a corrected copy.
examples.zh: 申请更正版前，我得先「联系签发机构」。

collocations: contact the issuing office by email
know how to contact the issuing office
ask someone to contact the issuing office

words.enDefinition: an extra form page used to continue an answer or list of entries

examples.en: I attached a continuation sheet because the earlier addresses did not fit.
examples.zh: 之前的地址写不下，我附了一张「续填附页」。

examples.en: The continuation sheet had a space for the reference number at the top.
examples.zh: 「续填附页」顶部留了个位置填查询编号。

words.enDefinition: an instruction to proceed to the following page of a form

examples.en: The note said continue on the next page beneath the last question.
examples.zh: 最后一道题下面写着「请到下一页继续填写」。

examples.en: I saw continue on the next page just above the page number.
examples.zh: 我在页码上方看到了「请到下一页继续填写」。

collocations: an instruction to continue on the next page
please continue on the next page
ask applicants to continue on the next page

words.enDefinition: a state or jurisdiction that has agreed to be bound by a convention

examples.en: The guide used contracting party to describe a jurisdiction listed in the convention table.
examples.zh: 指南用「公约缔约方」描述公约表格上列出的一个司法管辖区。

examples.en: I asked what contracting party meant when I saw it below the convention title.
examples.zh: 我在公约标题下面看到了「公约缔约方」，就问这个词是什么意思。

collocations: a contracting party to the convention

words.enDefinition: formal confirmation that a copy reproduces the original document

examples.en: The clerk showed me where the copy certification appeared below the copied text.
examples.zh: 工作人员指给我看，「副本相符认证」写在复印文字下方的哪个位置。

examples.en: I counted three pages on the document that included the copy certification at the end.
examples.zh: 我数了一下，那份末尾有「副本相符认证」的文件一共三页。

words.enDefinition: says the reproduction does not include all parts of the document

examples.en: The clerk wrote that the copy is incomplete because two pages were missing from it.
examples.zh: 工作人员写道，这份「副本不完整」，因为少了两页。

examples.en: The note says the copy is incomplete and points to the last printed page.
examples.zh: 备注说这份「副本不完整」，并指明了最后一张印出的页码。

collocations: a message saying the copy is incomplete
explain why the copy is incomplete

words.enDefinition: a reproduction of one record contained in a register

examples.en: The archive sent a copy of an entry that listed my grandfather's former address.
examples.zh: 档案馆发了一份「登记条目的副本」，上面写了我祖父以前的地址。

examples.en: I asked how the copy of an entry differed from the short extract in my file.
examples.zh: 我问这份「登记条目的副本」和档案里的短节录有什么区别。

collocations: request a copy of an entry
read a copy of an entry
a copy of an entry in the register

words.enDefinition: A replacement notice fixing an error in a previously issued one

examples.en: The agency sent a corrected notice after checking the spelling.
examples.zh: 政务机构核对拼写后发来了「更正后的通知」。

examples.en: I kept the corrected notice with the original in my folder.
examples.zh: 我把「更正后的通知」与原通知一起放在文件夹里。

words.enDefinition: a revised version addressing errors in an earlier translation

examples.en: The corrected translation showed the revised name spelling on the first page of the record.
examples.zh: 「更正后的译文」在记录的第一页写了改过的姓名拼法。

examples.en: I compared the corrected translation with the earlier version before sending my reply to the office.
examples.zh: 我把「更正后的译文」和先前的版本作了比较，然后回复办事处。

collocations: a corrected translation of the record

words.enDefinition: A list of past letters or messages attached to a case

examples.en: The older notice was visible in my correspondence history on the portal.
examples.zh: 我可以在政务平台的「往来函件记录」里查看较早的通知。

examples.en: I checked the correspondence history to see which message had come first.
examples.zh: 我查看了「往来函件记录」，确认哪条消息先到。

collocations: an item in the correspondence history

words.enDefinition: an office where a local council handles its work and public services

examples.en: I went to the council office to ask about the notice outside my flat.
examples.zh: 我去「地方议会办公点」问公寓外那则通知是什么意思。

examples.en: The council office had moved its enquiries desk to the ground floor.
examples.zh: 「地方议会办公点」把咨询柜台搬到了一楼。

collocations: a council office near the library

words.enDefinition: a sign that a particular service desk is not currently receiving visitors

examples.en: The sign read counter closed, so I asked which desk would serve us.
examples.zh: 牌子写着「柜台暂停办理」，于是我问哪个柜台能接待我们。

examples.en: I saw counter closed on the window during the staff lunch break.
examples.zh: 工作人员午休时，我看到窗口上写着「柜台暂停办理」。

collocations: display counter closed at the window

words.enDefinition: the time periods during which an office counter is open to the public

examples.en: I checked the counter hours before taking the bus to the office.
examples.zh: 坐公交去办事处前，我查了「柜台办理时间」。

examples.en: The notice gave separate counter hours for document collection on Friday.
examples.zh: 通知单列了周五领文件的「柜台办理时间」。

words.enDefinition: a receipt handed to a person who makes a payment or submits something at a staffed desk

examples.en: I kept the counter receipt for the fee paid during the visit.
examples.zh: 我留着当天办理缴费的「柜台收据」。

examples.en: The clerk corrected the date on my counter receipt before I left.
examples.zh: 我离开前，办事员更正了「柜台收据」上的日期。

collocations: check the date on the counter receipt

words.enDefinition: a code identifying the country or numbering region used for an international phone number

examples.en: The phone field displayed the country calling code before the subscriber number.
examples.zh: 电话字段先显示「电话国际区号」，再显示用户号码。

examples.en: I chose my country calling code from the menu beside the phone field.
examples.zh: 我从电话字段旁的菜单里选了「电话国际区号」。

words.enDefinition: the country of which a person is a citizen

examples.en: I entered my country of citizenship on the first page of the form.
examples.zh: 我在表格第一页填了「国籍国」。

examples.en: The instructions explained what to enter as country of citizenship on this form.
examples.zh: 填写说明解释了这张表的「国籍国」一栏应填什么。

words.enDefinition: The country whose authorities issued a particular official document

examples.en: The form listed the country of issue separately from the place of birth.
examples.zh: 表格把「签发国家」与出生地分开列出。

examples.en: I checked where the country of issue appeared on the application summary.
examples.zh: 我核对了申请概要中「签发国家」写在哪儿。

words.enDefinition: the country in which a person lives for the purposes of a particular form

examples.en: The application asked for my country of residence beside my current postal address.
examples.zh: 申请表在我当前邮寄地址旁要求填写「居住国」。

examples.en: I checked how the instructions defined country of residence for that question.
examples.zh: 我查了这道题的填写说明怎么定义「居住国」。

words.enDefinition: A letter sent with other papers explaining what they contain

examples.en: The covering letter explained why the office had returned the certificate.
examples.zh: 「随件说明函」解释了办事处为什么把证书退了回来。

examples.en: The clerk asked which documents the covering letter referred to.
examples.zh: 办事员问「随件说明函」指的是哪些文件。

collocations: a copy of the covering letter

words.enDefinition: the address where a person currently lives for the purposes of the form

examples.en: I put my current address in the field below my full name.
examples.zh: 我在全名下面的字段填写了「现住址」。

examples.en: The clerk noticed my current address did not match the older record.
examples.zh: 办事员发现我填的「现住址」与原记录不一致。

words.enDefinition: An envelope that has been damaged or torn

examples.en: The mailroom told me a damaged envelope from the council was waiting for me.
examples.zh: 邮件收发室告诉我，议会寄来的一个「破损的信封」在等我领取。

examples.en: I photographed the damaged envelope before asking the office about the contents.
examples.zh: 我先拍了「破损的信封」，再向办事处询问里面装了什么。

collocations: a damaged envelope from the post

words.enDefinition: A passport with physical damage that may affect its usability

examples.en: I asked what the handbook meant by a damaged passport.
examples.zh: 我问手册里说的「受损护照」指什么。

examples.en: The clerk noted the condition of the damaged passport before returning it.
examples.zh: 办事员记下了「受损护照」的状况，然后把它还给我。

words.enDefinition: the date from which a driver first held the licence or driving entitlement being asked about

examples.en: The form's date first licensed field referred to my original licence.
examples.zh: 表格的「首次取得驾照日期」字段指的是我的第一本驾照。

examples.en: I compared the date first licensed with the issue date on my current card.
examples.zh: 我把「首次取得驾照日期」与现有驾照的签发日期作了对照。

collocations: a field for date first licensed

words.enDefinition: The recorded calendar date when a person was born

examples.en: I checked whether the date of birth matched the one in my file.
examples.zh: 我核对了「出生日期」与档案上的日期是否一致。

examples.en: The clerk showed where the date of birth was printed on the certificate.
examples.zh: 办事员指给我看证书的「出生日期」印在什么地方。

words.enDefinition: the date on which the certification was made

examples.en: The date of certification appeared in a smaller box beside the name of the reviewer.
examples.zh: 「认证日期」写在审核人姓名旁边一个较小的框里。

examples.en: I asked whether the date of certification referred to the copy or the original document.
examples.zh: 我问「认证日期」指的是副本的认证日期，还是原文件上的日期。
