words.enDefinition: The date a traveler left a country

examples.en: The adviser asked whether the date of departure was visible on the copy.
examples.zh: 顾问问副本上能不能看清「出境日期」。

examples.en: I checked the date of departure on the record before filing the document.
examples.zh: 归档文件前，我查看了记录里的「出境日期」。

words.enDefinition: The date a traveler entered a country

examples.en: I recorded the date of entry exactly as it appeared on the official document.
examples.zh: 我按官方文件上的原样记下了「入境日期」。

examples.en: The student office asked which date of entry applied to my current course.
examples.zh: 学生办公室问，哪个「入境日期」对应我现在读的课程。

words.enDefinition: The date when a document reaches the end of its validity

examples.en: The clerk asked me to check the date of expiry on my card.
examples.zh: 办事员请我查看卡上的「有效期截止日」。

examples.en: I found the date of expiry on the front of the document.
examples.zh: 我在证件正面找到了「有效期截止日」。

words.enDefinition: The date an official authority issued a specific document

examples.en: I compared the date of issue with the date in my file.
examples.zh: 我把「签发日期」与我档案里的日期作了比较。

examples.en: The booklet showed the date of issue beneath the holder's personal details.
examples.zh: 本子把「签发日期」印在持有人的个人信息下面。

words.enDefinition: an on-screen control for choosing a date, often from a small calendar

examples.en: I opened the date picker to select the day of my appointment.
examples.zh: 我打开「日期选择器」选择预约日期。

examples.en: The date picker let me move back to the previous month before choosing.
examples.zh: 「日期选择器」让我在选择前切回上个月。

collocations: choose a day in the date picker

words.enDefinition: The recorded date on which an office received something

examples.en: The form showed a date received for each of my letters.
examples.zh: 表格给我的每封信都标了「收件日期」。

examples.en: I compared the date received with the label on my tracking form.
examples.zh: 我把「收件日期」和跟踪表上的标记作了核对。

words.zhGloss: 白天可联系的电话号码
words.enDefinition: a phone number at which a person can normally be reached during the day
acceptedZhAnswers: 白天可联系的电话号码

examples.en: I entered a daytime phone number that I could answer between lectures.
examples.zh: 我填了一个课间能接听的「白天可联系的电话号码」。

examples.en: The office used the daytime phone number to confirm that my documents had arrived.
examples.zh: 办事处拨打了我填写的「白天可联系的电话号码」，确认文件已经送达。

words.enDefinition: An official document certifying the recorded details of a death

examples.en: I asked which office issued the death certificate for the record.
examples.zh: 我问这条记录的「死亡证明」由哪个办事处签发。

examples.en: The clerk checked the year shown on the death certificate.
examples.zh: 办事员核对了「死亡证明」上显示的年份。

collocations: a copy of a death certificate

words.enDefinition: The process of officially recording that a person has died

examples.en: I asked how the guide distinguished death registration from the printed certificate.
examples.zh: 我问指南是怎样区分「死亡登记」和印制的证明的。

examples.en: The record gave a separate date for the death registration.
examples.zh: 档案为「死亡登记」单独列了一个日期。

words.enDefinition: A status indicating a decision has been deliberately postponed

examples.en: The portal showed decision deferred under the most recent case entry.
examples.zh: 政务平台在最新案件条目下面显示「暂缓作出决定」。

examples.en: The adviser explained the wording decision deferred on the summary sheet.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了概要表上「暂缓作出决定」的措辞。

words.enDefinition: A status indicating that the agency has reached a decision

examples.en: The dashboard read "Decision has been made." The notice itself was posted later.
examples.zh: 案件总览先显示「决定已作出」，通知晚些时候才发布。

examples.en: I saw "Decision has been made" in the latest update on my file.
examples.zh: 我在案卷的最新进度中看到了「决定已作出」。

collocations: a status reading decision has been made
show that a decision has been made
a message saying decision has been made

words.enDefinition: A brief account of an official decision and its main points

examples.en: The decision summary introduced the key findings before the longer explanation.
examples.zh: 「决定概要」在详细说明前先列出了主要审理结论。

examples.en: I took note of the reference on the decision summary.
examples.zh: 我记下了「决定概要」上的编号。

words.enDefinition: A status indicating a later decision replaces an earlier one

examples.en: The earlier notice was marked decision superseded in the online record.
examples.zh: 在线记录把较早那份通知标记为「原决定已被取代」。

examples.en: I asked what decision superseded meant in the list of notices.
examples.zh: 我问通知列表里的「原决定已被取代」是什么意思。

collocations: show a record as decision superseded

words.enDefinition: a person making a formal statement or declaration

examples.en: The form asked the declarant to write their name at the bottom.
examples.zh: 表格要求「声明人」在底部填写姓名。

examples.en: I checked whether the declarant was the applicant or the person providing information.
examples.zh: 我确认「声明人」是申请人，还是提供资料的人。

words.enDefinition: a formal statement affirming that information supplied in a form is correct

examples.en: I read the declaration of accuracy before signing the final page.
examples.zh: 签最后一页之前，我读了「信息准确性声明」。

examples.en: The form placed the declaration of accuracy below the boxes for contact details.
examples.zh: 表格把「信息准确性声明」放在联系方式填写框下面。

words.enDefinition: to make a formal statement asserting that something is true

examples.en: The form asked me to declare that I had read the instructions.
examples.zh: 表格请我「正式声明」自己已经阅读说明。

examples.en: I was asked to declare that the attached documents belonged to me.
examples.zh: 有人请我「正式声明」附件里的文件属于我本人。

collocations: declare that the information is correct
declare that you meet a condition

words.enDefinition: records that someone made a formal declaration before the witness

examples.en: The Australian sample included 'Declared before me' immediately above the witness's printed name.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚样本在见证人印刷体姓名正上方写着「在本人面前声明」。

examples.en: The words 'Declared before me' were followed by the town where the meeting took place.
examples.zh: 「在本人面前声明」几个字后面写了会面所在的小镇。

collocations: a line reading declared before me
a note saying declared before me

words.enDefinition: a counter reserved for a particular group of visitors or kind of service

examples.en: The map showed a dedicated counter for people who had booked an appointment.
examples.zh: 地图标出了为预约人员设置的「专用业务柜台」。

examples.en: I waited at the dedicated counter with the papers the office requested.
examples.zh: 我带着办事处要求的材料，在「专用业务柜台」前等候。

words.enDefinition: A UK legal document declaring that someone adopts a new name

examples.en: The UK guide listed a deed poll among documents that show a name change.
examples.zh: 英国指南把「英国改名契据」列入能证明姓名变更的文件。

examples.en: I asked whether my old name appeared on the deed poll.
examples.zh: 我问「英国改名契据」上有没有写我的旧姓名。

collocations: change a name by deed poll
a copy of a deed poll

words.enDefinition: Treated by an authority as withdrawn under the applicable rules

examples.en: The clerk explained the words deemed withdrawn on the case page.
examples.zh: 办事员解释了案件页面上的「视为撤回」是什么意思。

examples.en: I checked which request the notice said was deemed withdrawn.
examples.zh: 我查了一下，通知说哪项申请被「视为撤回」。

collocations: record a case as deemed withdrawn

words.enDefinition: To deliver a mailed item into a numbered post office box

examples.en: I asked whether this service could deliver to a PO box in the city.
examples.zh: 我问这项服务能不能「投递到市区的邮政信箱」。

examples.en: The clerk checked whether the postal service could deliver to a PO box.
examples.zh: 工作人员核实了这项邮政服务能不能「投递到邮政信箱」。

collocations: arrange to deliver to a PO box
be able to deliver to a PO box
ask whether they deliver to a PO box

words.enDefinition: A status saying the item was handed to a representative

examples.en: I asked the mailroom what “Delivered to agent” meant on the U.S. tracking page.
examples.zh: 我问邮件收发室，美国追踪页面上的「已交给代收人」是什么意思。

examples.en: The clerk pointed to “Delivered to agent” on the record for that envelope.
examples.zh: 工作人员指着那个信封的记录里「已交给代收人」的字样。

words.enDefinition: A status saying the item was left in the mailbox

examples.en: The screen said “Delivered to mailbox,” so I checked the box for my flat.
examples.zh: 屏幕显示「已投进邮箱」，我就去看了我住处的邮箱。

examples.en: I saw “Delivered to mailbox” beside the date in the postal tracking record.
examples.zh: 我在邮政追踪记录的日期旁看到了「已投进邮箱」。

words.enDefinition: A status saying the item was handed to reception staff

examples.en: The update said “Delivered to reception” for the letter sent to my residence.
examples.zh: 寄给我宿舍那封信的更新显示「已交给接待处」。

examples.en: I showed the receptionist the “Delivered to reception” entry from the tracking page.
examples.zh: 我把追踪页面上「已交给接待处」的记录给接待员看了。

words.enDefinition: A correction to the address for a particular delivery

examples.en: The office noted a delivery address correction for the certificate envelope in my file.
examples.zh: 办事处在我的档案里记录了证书信封的「投递地址更正」。

examples.en: I asked whether the message about a delivery address correction referred to the same document.
examples.zh: 我问「投递地址更正」的消息是不是指同一份文件。

collocations: a message about a delivery address correction

words.enDefinition: An occasion when a carrier tries to deliver mail

examples.en: The record showed a delivery attempt before I had returned home from campus.
examples.zh: 记录显示，在我从学校回家之前有过「一次投递尝试」。

examples.en: I asked which date on the message referred to the delivery attempt.
examples.zh: 我问消息上的哪个日期对应那「一次投递尝试」。

words.enDefinition: A local UK postal office handling mail delivery

examples.en: The Royal Mail card named a delivery office near my university as the collection point.
examples.zh: 英国皇家邮政的通知卡写明，取件地点是学校附近的一个「邮政投递办事点」。

examples.en: I asked which entrance led to the delivery office printed on the card.
examples.zh: 我问去通知卡上写的「邮政投递办事点」要从哪个入口进。

collocations: collect mail from a delivery office

words.enDefinition: A recorded scan made when mail is delivered

examples.en: The delivery scan was the final entry on the tracking page for my letter.
examples.zh: 「送达扫描记录」是我那封信追踪页面上的最后一条记录。

examples.en: The office asked which date was shown beside the delivery scan for that envelope.
examples.zh: 办事处问那个信封的「送达扫描记录」旁显示的是哪个日期。

collocations: a delivery scan on the record

words.enDefinition: A signature recorded when an item is delivered

examples.en: The office asked me to check the delivery signature in the tracking record.
examples.zh: 办事处让我查看追踪记录中的「投递签名」。

examples.en: I could see the delivery signature beside the date on the screen.
examples.zh: 我在屏幕上看到「投递签名」就在日期旁边。

words.zhGloss: 美国州机动车管理部门
words.enDefinition: the name used in some US states for an agency handling drivers and vehicles
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国州机动车管理部门

examples.en: The California letter showed Department of Motor Vehicles at the top of the page.
examples.zh: 加州那封信的页首写着「美国州机动车管理部门」。

examples.en: I checked whether the Department of Motor Vehicles had updated my mailing address.
examples.zh: 我查了「美国州机动车管理部门」有没有更新我的邮寄地址。

collocations: contact the Department of Motor Vehicles
visit the Department of Motor Vehicles
a Department of Motor Vehicles notice

words.enDefinition: An official record of a person's departure

examples.en: The printed departure record listed a date below the name of the traveler.
examples.zh: 打印出来的「出境记录」在旅客姓名下面列了一个日期。

examples.en: I asked where the old departure record appeared in the online account.
examples.zh: 我问以前的「出境记录」在网上账户的哪里显示。

collocations: a copy of the departure record

words.enDefinition: people who rely on someone for material or financial support

examples.en: The form asked me to list any dependants in a separate table.
examples.zh: 表格要求我把所有「受抚养人」列在一个单独的表格里。

examples.en: I read how the instructions defined dependants before answering that question.
examples.zh: 回答那道题前，我读了说明对「受抚养人」的定义。

words.enDefinition: the person making the statement in an affidavit

examples.en: The name of the deponent appeared immediately below the heading of the sworn statement.
examples.zh: 宣誓声明的标题紧下面写着「宣誓书的陈述人」姓名。

examples.en: I asked whether the deponent was the person whose words were recorded in the affidavit.
examples.zh: 我问「宣誓书的陈述人」是不是宣誓书里记录其陈述的人。

words.enDefinition: A Canadian school approved to host international students

examples.en: The Canadian handout explained what designated learning institution meant in the admissions section.
examples.zh: 加拿大的讲义解释了录取部分里「指定学习机构」一词的含义。

examples.en: I checked which university the guide listed as a designated learning institution in Canada.
examples.zh: 我看了指南把加拿大的哪所大学列为「指定学习机构」。

collocations: a designated learning institution in Canada
the list of designated learning institutions

words.enDefinition: an office officially selected to handle a particular service or application

examples.en: The guide listed a designated office for applications from my neighbourhood.
examples.zh: 指南列出一家「指定办事处」，处理我们街区的申请。

examples.en: I brought my documents to the designated office shown on the confirmation.
examples.zh: 我把材料带到了确认信息所列的「指定办事处」。

collocations: submit documents to a designated office

words.zhGloss: 美国校方指定移民事务负责人
words.enDefinition: A school official managing U.S. student immigration records
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国校方指定移民事务负责人

examples.en: I asked the designated school official about a date on my U.S. student record.
examples.zh: 我向「美国校方指定移民事务负责人」询问学生记录上的一个日期。

examples.en: The designated school official compared the program details with the university's course record.
examples.zh: 「美国校方指定移民事务负责人」把项目详情和学校的课程记录作了核对。

collocations: speak to your designated school official
a designated school official at a university

words.enDefinition: a parking permit recorded electronically instead of on a physical display card

examples.en: The council showed my digital parking permit in the account linked to my address.
examples.zh: 地方议会在与我地址关联的账号里显示了「电子停车许可证」。

examples.en: I asked how the digital parking permit would be identified at that car park.
examples.zh: 我问那个停车场会怎样识别「电子停车许可证」。

words.enDefinition: A digital image intended for use in a passport application

examples.en: The clerk explained where the digital passport photo file was listed.
examples.zh: 办事员说明了「电子版护照照片」文件列在哪儿。

examples.en: I asked which page mentioned a digital passport photo in the guide.
examples.zh: 我问指南哪一页提到「电子版护照照片」。

words.expression: direct someone to the correct office
words.lemma: direct someone to the correct office
words.zhGloss: 指引某人去对口办事处
words.enDefinition: to tell a visitor where to go to reach the office responsible for their request
acceptedZhAnswers: 指引某人去对口办事处
acceptedEnVariants: direct someone to the correct office

examples.en: The reception team's job is to direct someone to the correct office for their enquiry.
examples.zh: 接待团队的工作是「指引访客去对口办事处」咨询。

examples.en: The guide helps volunteers direct someone to the correct office without making a second call.
examples.zh: 这份指南帮助志愿者「指引访客去对口办事处」，不用再打一通电话。

collocations: help direct someone to the correct office
ask staff to direct someone to the correct office
quickly direct someone to the correct office

words.enDefinition: A preliminary hearing to arrange how a case will proceed

examples.en: The tribunal described the directions hearing before explaining the final hearing.
examples.zh: 审裁机构先介绍了「程序安排听证会」，然后说明最终听证。

examples.en: I checked which case was listed for the directions hearing.
examples.zh: 我核对了「程序安排听证会」列的是哪个案件。

words.enDefinition: A review an authority may choose whether to undertake

examples.en: The guide explained what discretionary review meant in that type of case.
examples.zh: 指南解释了该类案件中的「酌情审查」指什么。

examples.en: I asked which panel handled discretionary review in the sample process.
examples.zh: 我问示例流程中的「酌情审查」由哪个小组负责。

words.enDefinition: To reject an appeal so it does not change the decision

examples.en: The decision letter explained why the tribunal would dismiss the appeal.
examples.zh: 决定函解释了审裁机构为什么会「驳回申诉」。

examples.en: I checked which panel had decided to dismiss the appeal in that case.
examples.zh: 我核对了是哪个小组决定「驳回申诉」的。

collocations: an order to dismiss the appeal

words.enDefinition: The date a letter or document was sent out

examples.en: The agency gave a dispatch date for the certificate in its reply to me.
examples.zh: 机构在回复中给出了证书的「寄出日期」。

examples.en: I compared the dispatch date in my email with the date on the envelope.
examples.zh: 我把邮件里的「寄出日期」和信封上的日期作了对照。

words.enDefinition: A message telling the recipient that something was sent

examples.en: I received a dispatch notification for the documents from the local office.
examples.zh: 我收到了地方办事处发来的文件「寄出通知」。

examples.en: The dispatch notification gave a reference for the envelope containing my certificate.
examples.zh: 「寄出通知」给出了装有我证书的那个信封的编号。

words.enDefinition: A court order formally ending a marriage under applicable law

examples.en: The divorce decree I brought showed the court name on the first page.
examples.zh: 我带来的「法院离婚判决书」第一页写有法院名称。

examples.en: I checked whether the divorce decree on file included the date.
examples.zh: 我核对了归档的「法院离婚判决书」上有没有写日期。

collocations: a copy of a divorce decree

words.zhGloss: 加拿大指定学习机构编号
words.enDefinition: The code identifying a designated Canadian learning institution
acceptedZhAnswers: 加拿大指定学习机构编号

examples.en: My Canadian university sent a message showing its DLI number below the letterhead.
examples.zh: 加拿大大学的消息在信头下方标出了它的「指定学习机构编号」。

examples.en: The adviser showed where the DLI number appeared on the sample permit form.
examples.zh: 顾问展示了「加拿大指定学习机构编号」在许可表样本上的位置。

words.expression: do not write below this line
words.lemma: do not write below this line
words.enDefinition: an instruction to keep all entries above a marked line on a page
acceptedEnVariants: do not write below this line

examples.en: The bottom of the page said do not write below this line.
examples.zh: 页面底部写着「请勿在此线下书写」。

examples.en: I noticed do not write below this line before adding the extra comment.
examples.zh: 加备注前，我注意到了「请勿在此线下书写」。

collocations: a notice saying do not write below this line
follow do not write below this line
print do not write below this line beside the rule

words.enDefinition: formal confirmation of a stated feature of a document

examples.en: The service desk explained which part of the letter referred to document certification.
examples.zh: 服务台说明了信里哪段说的是「文书认证」。

examples.en: The attached note described the scope of document certification beside the embossed seal.
examples.zh: 随附备注在凸纹印章旁说明了「文书认证」的范围。

words.enDefinition: a message telling a person that a document is ready to be picked up

examples.en: I received a document collection notice while I was away for the weekend.
examples.zh: 周末出门时，我收到了「文件领取通知」。

examples.en: The document collection notice showed which desk would have the completed forms.
examples.zh: 「文件领取通知」注明哪个柜台有办好的表格。

words.enDefinition: a secure container where people can leave documents for an office to collect later

examples.en: I used the document drop box because the service counter was closed.
examples.zh: 柜台关着，所以我用了「文件投递箱」。

examples.en: The building map showed the document drop box near the side entrance.
examples.zh: 大楼地图标出，「文件投递箱」在侧门附近。

collocations: leave papers in the document drop box

words.enDefinition: An envelope designed to hold papers or documents

examples.en: I put the certificate into a document envelope that was wide enough to close easily.
examples.zh: 我把证书放进了一个够宽、容易封口的「文件信封」。

examples.en: The envelope shelf had a document envelope large enough for my folded papers.
examples.zh: 信封货架上有一个足够装下我折好文件的「文件信封」。

words.enDefinition: The person to whom an official document belongs or was issued

examples.en: The sample described the name field for the document holder.
examples.zh: 样本介绍了「证件持有人」的姓名栏。

examples.en: I checked whether the letter had the correct document holder listed.
examples.zh: 我核对了信上列出的「证件持有人」对不对。

words.enDefinition: formal authentication of a document's origin for presentation in another country

examples.en: The British information sheet used document legalisation in the heading above the relevant section.
examples.zh: 英国的说明单在相关章节上方用了「文书境外使用认证」作标题。

examples.en: The service office filed the document legalisation notice separately from the copies of my records.
examples.zh: 服务处把「文书境外使用认证」通知与档案副本分开归档。

words.enDefinition: An identifier assigned to a particular official document when issued

examples.en: The form labeled the document number separately from the application reference.
examples.zh: 表格将「证件编号」与申请编号分开标注。

examples.en: I asked which section explained the document number shown on the sample.
examples.zh: 我问哪一部分解释了样本上的「证件编号」。

words.enDefinition: the arrangement for collecting documents after an office prepares them

examples.en: The email said document pickup would be available from the following Monday.
examples.zh: 邮件说，从下周一开始办理「证件或文件领取」。

examples.en: I checked the opening hours for document pickup before travelling across town.
examples.zh: 穿过市区之前，我先查了「证件或文件领取」的办理时间。

words.enDefinition: the source and recorded history of a document

examples.en: The archive included information about document provenance beside the copy of the original entry.
examples.zh: 档案馆在原登记条目的副本旁附上了「文书的来源与来历」信息。

examples.en: I asked what document provenance meant on the reference sheet about the collection.
examples.zh: 我问馆藏参考说明上，「文书的来源与来历」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: The category to which a particular record or identity document belongs

examples.en: I checked which document type the office had entered for my card.
examples.zh: 我核对了办事处给我的卡片登记的是哪种「证件类别」。

examples.en: The sample form displayed document type above the details of the holder.
examples.zh: 样表在持有人信息的上方显示了「证件类别」。

words.enDefinition: Mail sent within a single country

examples.en: The clerk showed which part of the form was marked for domestic mail.
examples.zh: 工作人员指给我看，表格哪一部分标明用于「国内邮件」。

examples.en: The sign above the counter listed options for domestic mail on the left.
examples.zh: 柜台上方的牌子在左边列出了「国内邮件」的寄送选项。

words.enDefinition: a printed copy with content reproduced on both sides of the sheet

examples.en: The double-sided copy had an annotation on the back that I'd missed at first.
examples.zh: 「双面复印件」背后有条批注，我起初没注意到。

examples.en: I checked whether the double-sided copy was the one listed on the receipt.
examples.zh: 我核对了一下，「双面复印件」是否就是回执上写的那份。

collocations: a double-sided copy of the statement

words.enDefinition: To save a local copy of a notice from an account

examples.en: I used the link to download the notice and saved it for reference.
examples.zh: 我用链接「下载通知」，保存下来供将来查阅。

examples.en: The clerk showed me where to download the notice on that screen.
examples.zh: 办事员指给我看，那个页面的什么位置可以「下载通知」。

collocations: a link to download the notice
ask how to download the notice

words.enDefinition: a form made available as a file that can be saved to a device

examples.en: I checked whether the agency had a downloadable form for that request.
examples.zh: 我查了该机构是否为这个请求提供「可下载的表格」。

examples.en: The page placed the downloadable form below the service instructions and contact details.
examples.zh: 页面把「可下载的表格」放在业务说明和联系方式下面。

collocations: a downloadable form on the website

words.enDefinition: an office that handles applications, renewals or records for drivers' licences

examples.en: I went to the driver licensing office after copying the appointment details.
examples.zh: 抄好预约信息后，我去了「驾驶证业务办理处」。

examples.en: The driver licensing office posted a separate schedule for document collection that week.
examples.zh: 「驾驶证业务办理处」单独公布了那周领证的时间安排。

collocations: an appointment at the driver licensing office

words.enDefinition: an identifier assigned to a driver in an official licensing system

examples.en: The UK online form asked for the driver number printed on the licence.
examples.zh: 英国在线表格要求填写驾照上印的「驾驶人识别号」。

examples.en: I asked which field on the sample card contained the driver number.
examples.zh: 我问样本卡上哪个字段放的是「驾驶人识别号」。

words.enDefinition: a Canadian official summary of a person's driving record

examples.en: I requested a driver's abstract before applying to drive the university's shuttle van.
examples.zh: 我先申请了一份「驾驶记录摘要」，再报名驾驶学校的接驳车。

examples.en: The office checked which years the driver's abstract covered before accepting it.
examples.zh: 办事处确认「驾驶记录摘要」涵盖的年份后才收下。

words.enDefinition: an official decision preventing someone from holding or using driving privileges for a period

examples.en: The driving disqualification was listed separately from the penalty points on the record.
examples.zh: 记录把「禁止驾驶」与交通违规记分分开列出。

examples.en: The adviser explained what driving disqualification meant on the notice shown in class.
examples.zh: 顾问讲解了课堂上出示的通知里「禁止驾驶」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: the official permission to drive a vehicle or category of vehicles

examples.en: The record showed my driving entitlement for the category listed on the left.
examples.zh: 记录显示了左侧车型类别对应的「获准驾驶的权限」。

examples.en: I asked whether the new document would show the same driving entitlement as before.
examples.zh: 我问新文件是否会显示与原来相同的「获准驾驶的权限」。

words.enDefinition: a request to a public authority for a licence to drive specified vehicles

examples.en: I saved a copy of my driving licence application before taking it to the office.
examples.zh: 去办事处之前，我留存了一份「驾驶执照申请」副本。

examples.en: The clerk marked a missing answer on the driving licence application I brought.
examples.zh: 办事员标出了我带来的「驾驶执照申请」里有一项没填。

words.enDefinition: a control that reveals a list of options when a user opens it

examples.en: I selected the correct office from the drop-down list before moving on.
examples.zh: 我从「下拉列表」里选了正确的办事处，接着填写。

examples.en: The drop-down list appeared after I clicked the arrow beside the field.
examples.zh: 我点击字段旁的箭头后，出现了「下拉列表」。

collocations: an option in the drop-down list

words.enDefinition: a service allowing people to leave items or documents without waiting for full processing

examples.en: The branch offered a drop-off service for applications submitted in sealed envelopes.
examples.zh: 该办事点为用密封信封提交的申请提供「材料投递服务」。

examples.en: I checked whether the drop-off service provided a receipt for documents left there.
examples.zh: 我确认了「材料投递服务」是否会对投递的文件开回执。

words.zhGloss: 补发的车辆所有权凭证
words.enDefinition: a replacement official title provided when the earlier one is unavailable
acceptedZhAnswers: 补发的车辆所有权凭证

examples.en: The agency told us where the request for a duplicate title would be recorded.
examples.zh: 该机构告诉我们，「补发的车辆所有权凭证」申请会记录在哪里。

examples.en: I found the duplicate title in an envelope from the registration authority.
examples.zh: 我在登记机关寄来的信封里找到了「补发的车辆所有权凭证」。

words.zhGloss: 美国按有效身份核定的停留期
words.enDefinition: U.S. admission tied to continued qualifying status
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国按有效身份核定的停留期

examples.en: The adviser showed me where duration of status was explained in the U.S. guide.
examples.zh: 顾问指给我看，美国指南在哪里解释了「按有效身份核定的停留期」。

examples.en: I asked what duration of status meant next to the sample admission record.
examples.zh: 我问入境准入记录样本旁的「美国按有效身份核定的停留期」是什么意思。

collocations: a guide to duration of status

words.enDefinition: an apostille issued in electronic form

examples.en: The screen showed an e-Apostille alongside the electronic document that it referred to.
examples.zh: 屏幕上并排显示了「电子附加证明书」和它对应的电子文件。

examples.en: I asked whether the verification link belonged to the e-Apostille or the original file.
examples.zh: 我问查验链接对应的是「电子附加证明书」还是原文件。

words.enDefinition: information presented in a format designed to support understanding, often with simple text and pictures

examples.en: The centre displayed easy-read information beside the official instructions for the service.
examples.zh: 服务中心在业务官方说明旁展示了「易读版信息」。

examples.en: I asked where to get easy-read information about changes to office hours.
examples.zh: 我问哪里能拿到关于办公时间变更的「易读版信息」。

words.enDefinition: a record of schools, courses or qualifications a person previously attended or obtained

examples.en: I entered my education history before checking which certificates the office needed.
examples.zh: 我先填了「教育经历记录」，再核实办事处需要哪些证书。

examples.en: The education history section gave space for more than one course of study.
examples.zh: 「教育经历记录」一栏留了空间，可以填写不止一个学习项目。

words.enDefinition: agreement or permission given using an electronic form or system

examples.en: The portal recorded my electronic consent after I read the notice.
examples.zh: 我看完通知后，门户网站记下了我的「电子授权」。

examples.en: I asked how the office would store the electronic consent from our form.
examples.zh: 我问办事处会如何存储表格里的「电子授权」。

words.enDefinition: Germany's chip-equipped card recording a residence permit

examples.en: The German university adviser showed us how the electronic residence permit looked in the example.
examples.zh: 德国大学的顾问给我们看了样本里「电子居留许可卡」的样子。

examples.en: I checked whether the number on my electronic residence permit matched the German notice.
examples.zh: 我核对了「德国电子居留许可卡」上的号码是否和通知一致。

collocations: the number on an electronic residence permit

words.enDefinition: an electronic mark associated with the organization issuing a digital document

examples.en: The electronic seal appeared next to the name of the issuing body in the viewer.
examples.zh: 查看器里，签发机构名称旁显示了「电子印章」。

examples.en: I asked what the electronic seal represented in the digital version of the certificate.
examples.zh: 我问证书的数字版里，「电子印章」代表什么。

collocations: a document bearing an electronic seal

words.enDefinition: Formal delivery of documents using an authorized electronic channel

examples.en: The agency explained how it recorded electronic service in its online system.
examples.zh: 政务机构说明了在线系统如何登记「电子送达」。

examples.en: The guide listed electronic service alongside the methods using paper documents.
examples.zh: 指南把「电子送达」与送达纸质文件的方式并列介绍。

words.enDefinition: a vehicle title maintained electronically instead of being issued on paper

examples.en: The agency displayed the electronic title in the account linked to my vehicle.
examples.zh: 该机构在与车辆关联的账号里显示了「电子车辆所有权凭证」。

examples.en: I asked whether the electronic title could be viewed by the new owner.
examples.zh: 我问新车主是否能查看「电子车辆所有权凭证」。

words.enDefinition: a question used to check whether someone meets a requirement for a service

examples.en: The eligibility question asked whether I currently lived in the service area.
examples.zh: 「资格条件问题」问我现在是否住在服务辖区内。

examples.en: I read the notes before choosing an answer to the eligibility question.
examples.zh: 选择「资格条件问题」的答案前，我看了填写说明。

words.enDefinition: a field asking users to enter their email address again to check it matches

examples.en: The email confirmation field showed an error after I mistyped one letter.
examples.zh: 我打错一个字母后，「电子邮箱确认栏」显示了错误。

examples.en: I corrected the email confirmation field before moving to the next page.
examples.zh: 进入下一页之前，我更正了「电子邮箱确认栏」。

collocations: fill in the email confirmation field

words.enDefinition: a seal pressed into paper so its design is raised

examples.en: The embossed seal was easy to feel but barely visible in the scanned image.
examples.zh: 「凸纹印章」摸得出来，在扫描图像里却几乎看不见。

examples.en: I asked whether the mark beside the text was an embossed seal or a printed design.
examples.zh: 我问文字旁边的标记是「凸纹印章」，还是印上去的图案。

collocations: an embossed seal on the page

words.enDefinition: A passport issued under a special process for urgent travel

examples.en: The consular officer explained what an emergency passport meant in that guide.
examples.zh: 领事工作人员解释了那份指南里的「紧急护照」是什么意思。

examples.en: The section on urgent travel gave a definition of emergency passport.
examples.zh: 紧急旅行一节给出了「紧急护照」的定义。

collocations: an application for an emergency passport

words.enDefinition: An official document issued to enable urgent travel in specified circumstances

examples.en: The guide explained what an emergency travel document was for that journey.
examples.zh: 指南说明了那趟行程中「紧急旅行证件」的用途。

examples.en: I asked which office handled questions about an emergency travel document overseas.
examples.zh: 我问在国外应该找哪个办公室咨询「紧急旅行证件」。

collocations: an application for an emergency travel document

words.enDefinition: a test measuring or checking pollutants released by a vehicle under applicable procedures

examples.en: The agency listed the emissions test separately from the general safety inspection.
examples.zh: 机构把「车辆尾气检测」和普通安全检查分开列出。

examples.en: The letter explained how the emissions test result appeared in the vehicle record.
examples.zh: 信上解释了「车辆尾气检测」结果在车辆记录中怎样显示。

words.enDefinition: a record of previous jobs or periods of employment, often with dates

examples.en: I checked my employment history against the letters from my previous employers.
examples.zh: 我用前雇主的来信核对了「工作经历记录」。

examples.en: The form asked for employment history in a different section from education.
examples.zh: 表格把「工作经历记录」和教育情况放在不同部分。

words.enDefinition: Items sent inside the envelope along with a letter

examples.en: The final line listed the enclosures included with the letter.
examples.zh: 信件最后一行列出了「随函附送文件」。

examples.en: I put the enclosures behind the main notice in my folder.
examples.zh: 我把「随函附送文件」放在文件夹里的主通知后面。

words.enDefinition: a code that identifies the type of motoring offence recorded on a UK driving record

examples.en: I checked which endorsement code the example showed beside the offence date.
examples.zh: 我查看了例子在违规日期旁显示的是哪个「驾照违章代码」。

examples.en: The guide explained how to read an endorsement code on this document.
examples.zh: 指南解释了怎样读懂这份文件上的「驾照违章代码」。

words.enDefinition: an official whose job is to check that particular rules are followed and act on violations

examples.en: An enforcement officer checked the temporary permit displayed on the delivery vehicle.
examples.zh: 一名「执法人员」查看了送货车上展示的临时许可证。

examples.en: The enforcement officer made a note of the stall's position on the street.
examples.zh: 「执法人员」记录了摊位在街上的位置。

words.enDefinition: a code identifying a particular engine, recorded independently of a vehicle's plate

examples.en: The service report listed the engine number beside the vehicle identification number.
examples.zh: 维修报告把「发动机编号」列在车辆识别代码旁。

examples.en: I asked which field in the document was meant for the engine number.
examples.zh: 我问文件中哪个字段用来填写「发动机编号」。

words.enDefinition: an email inbox used to receive questions about an organization's services

examples.en: I sent my message to the enquiries inbox listed in the appointment letter.
examples.zh: 我把消息发送到预约信上列出的「咨询邮件收件箱」。

examples.en: The office checks the enquiries inbox at several points during the working day.
examples.zh: 办事处会在工作日几个时段查看「咨询邮件收件箱」。

collocations: send a question to the enquiries inbox

words.enDefinition: a desk where people can ask questions and receive information

examples.en: I asked at the enquiry counter where I could make photocopies.
examples.zh: 我在「咨询柜台」问哪里能复印。

examples.en: The enquiry counter gave me a map showing the other offices nearby.
examples.zh: 「咨询柜台」给了我一张图，标出了附近其他办事处。

words.enDefinition: UK immigration clearance issued before travel

examples.en: The UK guide explained where entry clearance was shown on the sample document.
examples.zh: 英国指南指出了样本文件上「英国预先入境许可」显示的位置。

examples.en: I checked the wording next to entry clearance in the letter from the British office.
examples.zh: 我核对了那封英国办事处来信中「英国预先入境许可」旁的文字。

words.enDefinition: A border official's check of a person's entry documents

examples.en: The handout used entry inspection to describe the document check at the border.
examples.zh: 讲义用「入境查验」来指边境的文件检查。

examples.en: I asked where entry inspection was described in the information for arriving students.
examples.zh: 我问给抵达学生的资料在哪里介绍了「入境查验」。

collocations: an entry inspection at the border
a record of an entry inspection

words.enDefinition: An official record of a person's entry

examples.en: I checked the spelling of my name against the entry record in my file.
examples.zh: 我根据档案里的「入境记录」核对了自己姓名的拼写。

examples.en: The office asked which entry record corresponded to my arrival last autumn.
examples.zh: 办公室问哪份「入境记录」对应我去年秋天的抵达。

collocations: a copy of the entry record

words.enDefinition: A passport mark recording entry to a country

examples.en: The registration adviser checked the entry stamp on the page I had copied.
examples.zh: 负责注册的顾问核对了我复印的那一页上的「入境印章」。

examples.en: I found the entry stamp between two pages with older markings on them.
examples.zh: 我在两页带有较早标记的页面之间找到了「入境印章」。

collocations: the date on an entry stamp

words.enDefinition: a person or group responsible for planning and managing a public event

examples.en: The event organizer gave the council an updated contact number on Monday.
examples.zh: 「活动组织者」周一向市政部门提供了更新后的联系电话。

examples.en: The notice referred questions about the proposed parade route to the event organizer.
examples.zh: 通告说，有关拟定游行路线的问题可以向「活动组织者」咨询。

words.enDefinition: official permission to hold a particular event at a given place and time

examples.en: The organizer attached the event permit to the booking confirmation for volunteers.
examples.zh: 组织者将「活动许可」附在发给志愿者的预订确认函里。

examples.en: The event permit listed the time when the concert had to finish.
examples.zh: 「活动许可」写明了音乐会必须结束的时间。

words.enDefinition: Documents showing that a person holds citizenship of a country

examples.en: The clerk asked which folder held my evidence of citizenship for the file.
examples.zh: 办事员问，我要归档的「公民身份证明材料」放在哪个文件夹。

examples.en: The guide explained what it meant by evidence of citizenship in that section.
examples.zh: 指南解释了那一节里的「公民身份证明材料」指什么。

collocations: a document serving as evidence of citizenship

words.enDefinition: Evidence that an office has already recorded for a case

examples.en: The officer checked the evidence on file before asking about the other letter.
examples.zh: 工作人员先核查了「案卷内已有证据」，才问起另一封信。

examples.en: I asked which entry described the evidence on file on the portal.
examples.zh: 我问平台的哪个条目介绍了「案卷内已有证据」。

words.zhGloss: 英国电子移民身份记录
words.enDefinition: A digital record of UK immigration status
acceptedZhAnswers: 英国电子移民身份记录

examples.en: My eVisa showed the same spelling as the record at my British university.
examples.zh: 我的「英国电子移民身份记录」和英国大学的档案用了同样的姓名拼写。

examples.en: I asked where the dates appeared when I viewed my eVisa online.
examples.zh: 我在网上查看「英国电子移民身份记录」时，问日期显示在哪里。

words.zhGloss: 美国交流访问项目担保机构
words.enDefinition: An organization that sponsors U.S. exchange visitors
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国交流访问项目担保机构

examples.en: The U.S. guide showed where the exchange visitor program sponsor was identified on the form.
examples.zh: 美国指南标出了表格上哪里写了「交流访问项目担保机构」。

examples.en: I asked which organization was my exchange visitor program sponsor during the semester abroad.
examples.zh: 我问海外交换学期中，哪个组织是我的「美国交流访问项目担保机构」。

collocations: contact an exchange visitor program sponsor
name an exchange visitor program sponsor
a designated exchange visitor program sponsor

words.enDefinition: A passport mark recording departure from a country

examples.en: I asked whether the stamp beside the handwritten date was an exit stamp.
examples.zh: 我问手写日期旁边的章是不是「出境印章」。

examples.en: The adviser looked at the exit stamp while checking the travel dates in my file.
examples.zh: 顾问核对我档案里的出行日期时，看了「出境印章」。

collocations: an exit stamp in a passport
the date on an exit stamp

words.enDefinition: A passport that has passed its official expiry date

examples.en: I found my expired passport in a folder with older documents.
examples.zh: 我在装旧文件的文件夹里找到了「过期护照」。

examples.en: The clerk asked why I had brought an expired passport to the appointment.
examples.zh: 办事员问我为什么带了一本「过期护照」来赴约。

words.zhGloss: 澳大利亚邮政特快寄递
words.enDefinition: Australia Post's named expedited delivery service
acceptedZhAnswers: 澳大利亚邮政特快寄递

examples.en: The Australian postal counter displayed Express Post envelopes beside the ordinary mailing supplies.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚邮政柜台在普通邮寄用品旁摆了「特快寄递」信封。

examples.en: I checked the Australian receipt to see whether it said Express Post.
examples.zh: 我查看了澳大利亚的凭条，看看上面是否写着「特快寄递」。

collocations: an Australia Post Express Post envelope
send an item by Express Post

words.enDefinition: an option under which a provider aims to complete a service sooner than usual

examples.en: The booking page showed an express service option next to the standard one.
examples.zh: 预约页面在常规选项旁列出了「加急办理选项」。

examples.en: I asked whether the express service option was available at the smaller office.
examples.zh: 我问较小的办事处有没有「加急办理选项」。

words.enDefinition: A U.S. visa category for academic students

examples.en: I saw F-1 visa listed on the information sheet for academic students in the United States.
examples.zh: 我在发给赴美学术课程学生的说明单上看到了「F-1学术学生签证」。

examples.en: The adviser compared the heading F-1 visa with a separate heading for exchange visitors.
examples.zh: 顾问把「美国F-1学术学生签证」这一标题和交换访问者的专栏标题作了对比。

words.enDefinition: The part of a person's name identifying their family or surname

examples.en: I noticed one letter was missing from my family name.
examples.zh: 我发现自己的「姓」少了一个字母。

examples.en: The form asked for my family name before my given names.
examples.zh: 表格先让我填「姓」，再填名。

words.enDefinition: document authentication handled by a U.S. federal authority

examples.en: The sample showed federal authentication as a separate heading above the official's name.
examples.zh: 样本把「美国联邦级文书认证」作为单独标题，放在官员姓名的上方。

examples.en: I asked which line of the notice referred to federal authentication for that document.
examples.zh: 我问通知里哪一行说的是那份文件的「美国联邦级文书认证」。

words.enDefinition: A New Zealand student visa for fee-paying study

examples.en: I saw the title Fee Paying Student Visa in the New Zealand course guide.
examples.zh: 我在新西兰课程指南里看到了「自费学生签证」这个标题。

examples.en: The adviser drew a line under Fee Paying Student Visa in the sample notice.
examples.zh: 顾问在通知样本的「新西兰自费学生签证」下画了线。

collocations: a Fee Paying Student Visa notice
conditions on a Fee Paying Student Visa
details of a Fee Paying Student Visa

words.enDefinition: a formal request to be excused from a charge that would otherwise apply

examples.en: My fee waiver request was sent to a different team for review.
examples.zh: 我的「免缴费用申请」被转给另一组审核。

examples.en: The form states where to send a fee waiver request for that service.
examples.zh: 表格写明了这项服务的「免缴费用申请」要发到哪里。

words.enDefinition: short text explaining what information should be entered in a particular form field

examples.en: I opened the field description to see whether the service wanted my old address.
examples.zh: 我打开「字段填写说明」，看该业务是不是需要我以前的住址。

examples.en: The field description was visible only after I selected the information icon.
examples.zh: 我点击信息图标后，才显示「字段填写说明」。

words.enDefinition: an office away from an organization's headquarters that serves a particular area

examples.en: The central agency directed my enquiry to the field office near campus.
examples.zh: 中央机构把我的咨询转给了学校附近的「地方办事机构」。

examples.en: I checked the address of the field office before confirming my appointment.
examples.zh: 确认预约前，我查了「地方办事机构」的地址。

words.enDefinition: form fields carrying a star symbol, often to indicate that they are required

examples.en: The instruction said the fields marked with an asterisk needed an answer before submission.
examples.zh: 说明写着，「标星号的字段」必须填答后才能提交。

examples.en: I completed the fields marked with an asterisk before reviewing the optional questions.
examples.zh: 看选答题之前，我先填了「标星号的字段」。

collocations: complete the fields marked with an asterisk
check the fields marked with an asterisk
fill in the fields marked with an asterisk

words.enDefinition: to make a formal complaint about how a service was provided

examples.en: The clerk gave me a form to file a service complaint about the appointment.
examples.zh: 办事员给了我一张表，可以就预约办理过程「提交服务投诉」。

examples.en: I asked which office handles requests to file a service complaint in writing.
examples.zh: 我问写信「就办理服务提交投诉」该找哪个办事处。

collocations: file a service complaint in writing
decide whether to file a service complaint

words.enDefinition: a digital document with spaces users can type in or select on screen

examples.en: I used a fillable form so I could type before printing it.
examples.zh: 我用了一份「可电子填写的表格」，先输入内容，再打印。

examples.en: The office supplied a fillable form instead of the scanned copy we had.
examples.zh: 办事处提供了「可电子填写的表格」，替代我们手里的扫描件。

words.enDefinition: a form containing answers supplied by the person completing it

examples.en: I took my filled-in form to the counter after checking the last page.
examples.zh: 检查完最后一页后，我把「已填写的表格」带到了柜台。

examples.en: The clerk asked me to keep one copy of the filled-in form.
examples.zh: 办事员请我留一份「已填写的表格」副本。

words.enDefinition: official permission to film at a specific location for an approved period

examples.en: The student producer kept the filming permit with the location booking documents.
examples.zh: 学生制片人把「拍摄许可证」和场地预订文件放在一起。

examples.en: One condition of the filming permit was that the doorway remained clear.
examples.zh: 「拍摄许可证」有一项条件是保持门口畅通。

words.enDefinition: The concluding formal decision of a particular official process

examples.en: The agency sent its final determination in a separate written notice.
examples.zh: 政务机构单独发了书面通知告知「最终裁定」。

examples.en: I checked which reference the final determination listed for the case.
examples.zh: 我核对了「最终裁定」为这个案件列出的编号。

collocations: the date of a final determination

words.enDefinition: a person's situation concerning income, expenses, debts or resources at a specified time

examples.en: The form asked whether my financial circumstances had changed since the previous application.
examples.zh: 表格询问，自上次申请后我的「个人经济状况」有没有变。

examples.en: I checked which documents the office accepted to explain my financial circumstances.
examples.zh: 我核实办事处认可哪些文件来说明「个人经济状况」。

words.enDefinition: An adult passport being issued to a person for the first time

examples.en: I asked which heading referred to a first adult passport in the guide.
examples.zh: 我问指南哪个标题指的是「首次申领的成人护照」。

examples.en: The UK office labeled the form as an application for a first adult passport.
examples.zh: 英国办事处把这张表标成了「首次申领的成人护照」申请表。

collocations: apply for a first adult passport
documents for a first adult passport

words.zhGloss: 美国邮政一类邮件服务
words.enDefinition: A USPS service for letters and lightweight mail
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国邮政一类邮件服务

examples.en: The American postal guide included First-Class Mail in its section on letters.
examples.zh: 美国邮政指南在信函部分提到了「一类邮件服务」。

examples.en: I saw First-Class Mail printed below the barcode on the U.S. envelope.
examples.zh: 我看到美国信封的条形码下方印着「一类邮件服务」。

collocations: send a letter by First-Class Mail

words.enDefinition: Royal Mail's first-class service for UK mail

examples.en: The UK counter sign listed first-class post beside the other options for letters.
examples.zh: 英国柜台的牌子把「一类邮件服务」和其他寄信选项列在一起。

examples.en: I asked whether first-class post was the option shown on the British sample envelope.
examples.zh: 我问英国样本信封上标的是不是「一类邮件服务」。

collocations: send a letter by first-class post

words.enDefinition: The first recording of one's immigration permission in Ireland

examples.en: The Irish guide used first registration in the heading above the document examples.
examples.zh: 爱尔兰指南在文件例子上方的标题里用了「首次移民登记」。

examples.en: I checked which reference was listed on the Irish notice about first registration.
examples.zh: 我查看了爱尔兰「首次移民登记」通知上列的是哪个编号。

words.enDefinition: whether a person's health or functional ability is compatible with driving safely

examples.en: The handbook explains why the office may ask about fitness to drive.
examples.zh: 手册解释了办事处为什么可能会问「适合驾驶的身心状态」。

examples.en: I read the section on fitness to drive before asking about the form.
examples.zh: 咨询表格前，我读了「适合驾驶的身心状态」一节。

collocations: report a change affecting fitness to drive

words.enDefinition: indicates that a document is intended to be presented in another country

examples.en: The covering note described the attached statement as a document for use abroad.
examples.zh: 附函称，所附声明是一份「供境外使用」的文件。

examples.en: I noticed the words for use abroad next to the document title in the sample.
examples.zh: 我注意到样本的文件标题旁写着「供境外使用」。

collocations: prepare a certificate for use abroad

words.zhGloss: 德国外国人事务主管部门
words.enDefinition: A local German office for immigration matters
acceptedZhAnswers: 德国外国人事务主管部门

examples.en: I checked which foreigners authority was named in the German residence document example.
examples.zh: 我查看了德国居留文件样本上列的是哪个「外国人事务主管部门」。

examples.en: The German university guide mentioned the local foreigners authority in a section about student residence.
examples.zh: 德国大学指南在介绍学生居留的章节中提到了当地的「外国人事务主管部门」。

collocations: a notice from the foreigners authority

words.enDefinition: extra material attached to a form giving details, space or explanations

examples.en: The form appendix gave more space for details about previous addresses.
examples.zh: 「表格附录」给旧住址信息留了更多空间。

examples.en: I checked whether the form appendix belonged to the same version as my form.
examples.zh: 我核实了「表格附录」是不是和手里的表同一版本。

words.zhGloss: 美国在线非移民签证申请表
words.enDefinition: The U.S. online application form for nonimmigrant visas
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国在线非移民签证申请表

examples.en: The U.S. consular guide included a picture of the Form DS-160 confirmation page.
examples.zh: 美国领事指南里有一张「在线非移民签证申请表」确认页的图片。

examples.en: The adviser asked where Form DS-160 was mentioned in the appointment message.
examples.zh: 顾问问预约消息在哪儿提到了「美国在线非移民签证申请表」。

words.zhGloss: 美国交流访问资格证明表
words.enDefinition: A U.S. exchange visitor's certificate of eligibility
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国交流访问资格证明表
acceptedEnVariants: Certificate of Eligibility for Exchange Visitor Status

examples.en: The exchange adviser pointed out the sponsor name on the sample Form DS-2019.
examples.zh: 交流项目顾问指给我们看了「美国交流访问资格证明表」样本上的担保机构名称。

examples.en: I read the dates on Form DS-2019 beside the name of the exchange program.
examples.zh: 我在「美国交流访问资格证明表」的交流项目名称旁查看了日期。

words.enDefinition: a space or control for entering a specific item of information in a form

examples.en: I could not find the form field for the building number at first.
examples.zh: 一开始我没找到填写楼号的「表格字段」。

examples.en: The clerk showed me which form field should contain the reference from my letter.
examples.zh: 办事员指给我看，信上的编号应该填在哪个「表格字段」。

words.zhGloss: 美国学生身份资格证明表
words.enDefinition: A school-issued eligibility certificate for U.S. F or M students
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国学生身份资格证明表
acceptedEnVariants: Certificate of Eligibility for Nonimmigrant Student Status

examples.en: I checked the program name on my Form I-20 against the university email.
examples.zh: 我对照学校邮件核对了「美国学生身份资格证明表」上的项目名称。

examples.en: The adviser showed where the institution was named on the sample Form I-20.
examples.zh: 顾问指给我们看，「美国学生身份资格证明表」样本的哪儿写了学校名称。

collocations: the program dates on Form I-20

words.enDefinition: A U.S. arrival and departure record

examples.en: I read the admission information on Form I-94 during orientation at the U.S. university.
examples.zh: 参加美国大学的迎新活动时，我看了「美国出入境记录表」上的准入信息。

examples.en: The adviser checked which class of admission appeared on Form I-94 for this example.
examples.zh: 顾问核对了这个例子中「美国出入境记录表」显示的是哪种准入类别。

collocations: print a copy of Form I-94

words.enDefinition: a view showing how a form and its entered information will look before submission

examples.en: The form preview showed one blank box I had not noticed before.
examples.zh: 「表格预览」里有个空白框，我之前没注意到。

examples.en: I printed the form preview to check that the long address would fit.
examples.zh: 我打印了「表格预览」，确认那一长串地址放得下。

collocations: check the form preview before submitting

words.enDefinition: the date a particular version of a form was last revised for release

examples.en: The form revision date appeared in small print below the signature line.
examples.zh: 「表格修订日期」以小字印在签名线下。

examples.en: I checked the form revision date when comparing downloads from two different pages.
examples.zh: 比较两个页面下载的表格时，我查看了「表格修订日期」。

words.enDefinition: a part of a form grouping fields or questions about one subject

examples.en: I returned to the same form section after finding my old address.
examples.zh: 找到旧地址后，我回到同一个「表格分区」。

examples.en: The clerk said this form section was reserved for applicants living abroad.
examples.zh: 办事员说，这个「表格分区」留给住在国外的申请人填写。

words.enDefinition: a particular release of a form identified by a number, date or edition

examples.en: I compared the form version with the one named in the appointment email.
examples.zh: 我把「表格版本」和预约邮件里指定的版本作了对照。

examples.en: The clerk checked the form version printed near the bottom of the last page.
examples.zh: 办事员核对了印在最后一页底部附近的「表格版本」。

words.enDefinition: A name someone used before adopting their current name

examples.en: The clerk checked which year my former name appeared in the records.
examples.zh: 办事员查了我的「曾用名」在哪一年的档案中出现。

examples.en: My former name appeared in the older file with its original spelling.
examples.zh: 我的「曾用名」按原来的拼法记在旧档案里。

words.enDefinition: A request to send mail to another address

examples.en: I saved the confirmation for the forwarding request before leaving my old flat.
examples.zh: 离开旧住处之前，我保存了「邮件改寄申请」的确认信息。

examples.en: The postal operator gave me a reference for the forwarding request I had made.
examples.zh: 邮政运营机构给了我已经提交的「邮件改寄申请」编号。

collocations: a reference for a forwarding request

words.enDefinition: a form field for the start date of a period

examples.en: I checked the “From date” field against the first day listed on my record.
examples.zh: 我把「起始日期栏」里的日期和记录中的第一天作了对照。

examples.en: The guide shows where the “From date” field appears on the screen.
examples.zh: 指南显示了「起始日期栏」在屏幕上的位置。

collocations: date entered in the “From date” field

words.enDefinition: a copy made at the same size as the original

examples.en: The full-size copy showed the tiny print more clearly than the smaller image in my file.
examples.zh: 「按原尺寸复制的副本」上的小字比我档案里那张缩小的图片更清楚。

examples.en: I looked at a full-size copy when the margin note was difficult to read.
examples.zh: 页边的备注难以辨认时，我查看了「按原尺寸复制的副本」。

collocations: a full-size copy of the page

words.enDefinition: having no available places or times left to book

examples.en: The central office was fully booked, so I tried the regional office.
examples.zh: 中央办事处「已全部约满」，我就试着约地区办事处。

examples.en: I saw fully booked beside every afternoon in the appointment calendar that week.
examples.zh: 预约日历里，那周每天下午旁边都写着「已全部约满」。

words.enDefinition: A UK certificate providing legal recognition of a person's gender

examples.en: The UK guide used the term Gender Recognition Certificate in a separate chapter.
examples.zh: 英国指南在单独一章中使用了「英国性别承认证书」这个名称。

examples.en: I asked which section defined Gender Recognition Certificate in the official booklet.
examples.zh: 我问官方手册中哪一节解释了「英国性别承认证书」。

collocations: a copy of a Gender Recognition Certificate

words.zhGloss: 英格兰和威尔士总登记处
words.enDefinition: The authority holding central civil registration records for England and Wales
acceptedZhAnswers: 英格兰和威尔士总登记处

examples.en: The UK leaflet named the General Register Office beneath the main heading.
examples.zh: 英国这份说明单在主标题下列出了「英格兰和威尔士总登记处」。

examples.en: I asked which section came from the General Register Office in that guide.
examples.zh: 我问那份指南哪部分内容来自「英格兰和威尔士总登记处」。

collocations: records held by the General Register Office
guidance from the General Register Office

words.zhGloss: 澳大利亚真实学习目的要求
words.enDefinition: Australia's requirement concerning a genuine purpose to study
acceptedZhAnswers: 澳大利亚真实学习目的要求

examples.en: The Australian university guide had a heading called Genuine Student requirement on its visa page.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚大学指南的签证页面有个标题叫「真实学习目的要求」。

examples.en: I asked what Genuine Student requirement meant in the Australian government's description.
examples.zh: 我问澳大利亚政府说明里的「真实学习目的要求」是什么意思。

collocations: read about the Genuine Student requirement
an explanation of the Genuine Student requirement

words.enDefinition: A person's first and other personal names apart from the surname

examples.en: I copied my given names exactly as printed on the document.
examples.zh: 我照证件上印的写法填写了自己的「名」。

examples.en: The form placed the field for given names before my surname.
examples.zh: 表格的「名」一栏在我的姓氏栏之前。

words.enDefinition: to move to the particular service desk linked to your appointment or number

examples.en: The display asked me to go to the assigned counter on the ground floor.
examples.zh: 屏幕提示我「前往一楼的指定柜台」。

examples.en: The clerk told me to go to the assigned counter with my folder.
examples.zh: 办事员让我拿着文件夹「前往指定柜台」。

collocations: please go to the assigned counter
wait before you go to the assigned counter
go to the assigned counter when called

words.enDefinition: an organization within government responsible for a particular public function or service

examples.en: The letter named the government agency responsible for the application we discussed.
examples.zh: 信上写明了负责我们谈到那项申请的「政府机构」。

examples.en: I checked the government agency website before sending a copy of the certificate.
examples.zh: 寄出证书副本之前，我查了「政府机构」的网站。

words.enDefinition: A formal message from a public authority about official business

examples.en: The government notice identified the office responsible for my file.
examples.zh: 这份「政务通知」写明了负责我档案的办事处。

examples.en: My tutor used a sample government notice in our language workshop.
examples.zh: 导师在我们的语言课上用了一份「政务通知」的样本。

words.enDefinition: an office where a government body performs work or provides services to the public

examples.en: I took the form to the government office after my morning lecture.
examples.zh: 上完早课后，我把表格带到了「政府办事处」。

examples.en: The government office was in the building next to the public library.
examples.zh: 「政府办事处」在公共图书馆旁边的那栋楼里。

words.enDefinition: To formally allow an appeal to proceed to consideration

examples.en: The preliminary order explained whether the tribunal would grant permission to appeal.
examples.zh: 初步命令说明了审裁机构是否会「准许提出申诉」。

examples.en: I checked why the panel chose to grant permission to appeal that morning.
examples.zh: 我查看了小组那天上午选择「准许提出申诉」的原因。

collocations: decide to grant permission to appeal
a tribunal may grant permission to appeal
an order to grant permission to appeal

words.zhGloss: 新南威尔士州强制第三方人身险
words.enDefinition: in New South Wales, the name for compulsory third-party motor injury insurance
acceptedZhAnswers: 新南威尔士州强制第三方人身险

examples.en: The New South Wales insurer sent the green slip details to the vehicle owner.
examples.zh: 新南威尔士州的保险公司向车主发送了「强制第三方人身险」的信息。

examples.en: Our New South Wales registration reminder included a reference to the green slip.
examples.zh: 我们收到的新南威尔士州车辆登记提醒中提到了「强制第三方人身险」。

words.zhGloss: 英国民事登记索引编号
words.enDefinition: A reference identifying an indexed entry in English and Welsh civil records
acceptedZhAnswers: 英国民事登记索引编号

examples.en: The UK guide explained what a GRO index reference was used for.
examples.zh: 英国指南解释了「英国民事登记索引编号」的用途。

examples.en: I asked where the sample displayed its GRO index reference for registration.
examples.zh: 我问样本把用于登记查询的「英国民事登记索引编号」显示在哪里。

collocations: look up a GRO index reference

words.enDefinition: The stated reasons or basis for refusing a request

examples.en: The agency set out its grounds for refusal under three separate headings.
examples.zh: 政务机构用三个标题列明了「拒绝理由」。

examples.en: I read the grounds for refusal before comparing them with the case summary.
examples.zh: 我先读了「拒绝理由」，再拿它们和案情概要作比较。

collocations: grounds for refusal in a notice

words.enDefinition: additional information that explains what a form asks for and how it is used

examples.en: I read the guidance notes to see which address I should enter.
examples.zh: 我读了「填写指导说明」，确认应该填哪个地址。

examples.en: The guidance notes gave an example for the date requested in that section.
examples.zh: 「填写指导说明」举例说明了那一节要求填写的日期。

words.enDefinition: A letter brought directly to its destination by someone

examples.en: The office kept a record of the hand-delivered letter beside the posted documents.
examples.zh: 办事处在已邮寄文件旁保留了「专人送达的信件」记录。

examples.en: The reception desk signed for the hand-delivered letter from the nearby municipal office.
examples.zh: 接待处签收了附近市政办事处「专人送达的信件」。

collocations: a hand-delivered letter from an office

words.enDefinition: to give forms or documents to a person who will receive or process them

examples.en: I went upstairs to hand in paperwork after checking with the receptionist.
examples.zh: 向接待人员确认后，我上楼「交上书面材料」。

examples.en: The clerk showed me where to hand in paperwork for the application.
examples.zh: 办事员指给我看，这项申请要去哪里「交上书面材料」。

collocations: hand in paperwork for an application
hand in paperwork before the deadline

words.enDefinition: Transferred to the organization carrying the item

examples.en: The agency's record listed “Handed to carrier” after the envelope was prepared.
examples.zh: 机构的记录显示，信封准备好后便「已交给承运方」。

examples.en: I saw “Handed to carrier” in the status column for my document envelope.
examples.zh: 我在文件信封的状态栏里看到了「已交给承运方」。

words.enDefinition: a form whose answers have been written by hand rather than typed

examples.en: The clerk scanned my handwritten form after checking that the pages were in order.
examples.zh: 办事员确认各页顺序无误后，扫描了我「手写填写的表格」。

examples.en: I kept a photograph of the handwritten form for my own records.
examples.zh: 我保留了「手写填写的表格」的照片留档。

words.enDefinition: A status indicating a hearing has been postponed or paused

examples.en: The online record showed hearing adjourned beside the original hearing date.
examples.zh: 在线记录在原听证日期旁显示「听证延期」。

examples.en: We received a short notice stating hearing adjourned later that afternoon.
examples.zh: 当天下午晚些时候，我们收到一份写着「听证延期」的简短通知。

words.enDefinition: A written message giving information about an upcoming formal hearing

examples.en: The hearing notice listed the hearing location on its first page.
examples.zh: 「听证会通知」在第一页列出了听证地点。

examples.en: I kept the hearing notice in the file with my other letters.
examples.zh: 我把「听证会通知」和其他信件放在同一份案卷里。

words.enDefinition: Kept at a location for the recipient to collect

examples.en: The tracking status changed to “Held for pickup” after the delivery attempt.
examples.zh: 尝试投递后，追踪状态变成了「已留存待领取」。

examples.en: I asked which counter handled letters marked “Held for pickup” at this branch.
examples.zh: 我问这个网点哪个柜台处理标为「已留存待领取」的信件。

collocations: mark mail as held for pickup

words.enDefinition: The signature of the person named on an official document

examples.en: The sample card had a box for the holder's signature.
examples.zh: 卡片样本上有一个填写「持有人签名」的方框。

examples.en: I asked where the holder's signature was printed on the form.
examples.zh: 我问表格上「持有人签名」一栏印在哪里。

words.enDefinition: a person living as part of a specified household

examples.en: The form asked for the age range of each household member.
examples.zh: 表格问每位「家庭住户成员」属于哪个年龄段。

examples.en: I called to ask whether a temporary visitor counted as a household member.
examples.zh: 我打电话问，临时来访的人是否算「家庭住户成员」。

words.enDefinition: An I-901 payment associated with U.S. student or exchange records

examples.en: The U.S. information sheet listed the I-901 SEVIS Fee in a separate section.
examples.zh: 美国的说明单单独设了一栏，列出「I-901 SEVIS系统费用」。

examples.en: I asked which payment receipt showed the I-901 SEVIS Fee in my file.
examples.zh: 我问档案里的哪张付款凭据显示了「美国I-901 SEVIS系统费用」。

collocations: review information about the I-901 SEVIS Fee

words.enDefinition: Details used to distinguish a particular person in official records

examples.en: The clerk explained which section contained my identifying information on the form.
examples.zh: 办事员说明了表格哪一栏包含我的「身份识别信息」。

examples.en: I checked whether my identifying information matched the information on file.
examples.zh: 我核对了「身份识别信息」和档案上的信息是否一致。

words.enDefinition: An official card or document used to show who someone is

examples.en: The clerk asked which identity document was listed in my file.
examples.zh: 办事员问我的档案里列的是哪份「身份证明文件」。

examples.en: I compared the two names on a sample identity document at the office.
examples.zh: 我在办事处比较了「身份证明文件」样本上的两个姓名。

words.enDefinition: An official entry containing information used to identify a person

examples.en: The officer found one identity record in the older register.
examples.zh: 工作人员在较早的登记册里找到一条「身份登记记录」。

examples.en: I asked when my identity record was last amended by the office.
examples.zh: 我问办事处上一次修订我的「身份登记记录」是什么时候。

collocations: an identity record held by the office

words.enDefinition: used to show that an instruction applies only when it fits a person's situation

examples.en: The words if applicable appeared next to the box for a second address.
examples.zh: 第二个地址的填写框旁写着「如适用」。

examples.en: I read if applicable and checked whether the question was relevant to me.
examples.zh: 我看到「如适用」，便确认那道题和我是否有关。

collocations: include a second address if applicable

words.enDefinition: an instruction to describe your answer when you choose the option labelled other

examples.en: The form displayed “If other, please specify” below the contact preference options.
examples.zh: 联系方式偏好选项下面，说明显示「如选择其他请注明」。

examples.en: I saw “If other, please specify” before entering a method not listed.
examples.zh: 我看到了「如选择其他请注明」，就填上了一种表中没列的方式。

collocations: a field labelled “If other, please specify”
an instruction saying “If other, please specify”

words.enDefinition: a stamped marking too unclear for its wording to be read

examples.en: The translator added a note about the illegible stamp at the bottom of the scan.
examples.zh: 译员对扫描页底部「字迹难辨的印章」加了一条注释。

examples.en: I found another image of the page with the illegible stamp in my old files.
examples.zh: 我在旧文件里找到了有那枚「字迹难辨的印章」的另一张页面图片。

collocations: a note about an illegible stamp

words.zhGloss: 澳大利亚移民在线账户

acceptedZhAnswers: 澳大利亚移民在线账户

examples.zh: 我登录「澳大利亚移民在线账户」，阅读澳大利亚办事处发来的消息。

examples.en: The Australian student guide showed where the reference number appeared in ImmiAccount.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚学生指南展示了编号在「移民在线账户」里的什么位置。

words.enDefinition: The Dutch agency that handles immigration and nationality matters

examples.en: The Dutch notice showed Immigration and Naturalisation Service at the top of the first page.
examples.zh: 荷兰通知第一页顶部写着「移民及归化局」的名称。

examples.en: I recognized Immigration and Naturalisation Service from the documents in the university's Dutch arrival guide.
examples.zh: 我从荷兰大学抵达指南的文件里认出了「移民及归化局」这个名称。

collocations: a letter from the Immigration and Naturalisation Service
contact the Immigration and Naturalisation Service

words.enDefinition: An official who administers immigration controls

examples.en: The immigration officer asked which university was named on my documents.
examples.zh: 「移民官员」问文件上写的是哪所大学。

examples.en: I asked the immigration officer where the reference number appeared on the notice.
examples.zh: 我问「移民官员」，编号印在通知的什么位置。

collocations: an immigration officer at the border
a question from an immigration officer

words.enDefinition: Permission to stay as recorded by Irish immigration officials

examples.en: I asked where immigration permission was described in the Irish registration guide.
examples.zh: 我问爱尔兰登记指南在哪儿介绍了「移民居留许可」。

examples.en: The Irish university's adviser explained the term immigration permission during our document workshop.
examples.zh: 爱尔兰大学的顾问在文件工作坊里解释了「移民居留许可」一词。

words.zhGloss: 加拿大移民难民及公民部
words.enDefinition: The Canadian department responsible for immigration services
acceptedZhAnswers: 加拿大移民难民及公民部

examples.en: The document was issued by Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada according to its letterhead.
examples.zh: 按信头所示，文件由「加拿大移民难民及公民部」签发。

examples.en: I saw Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada listed on the notice beside the example.
examples.zh: 我在示例旁的告示上看到了「加拿大移民难民及公民部」的名称。

words.enDefinition: Official recording of a person's immigration permission

examples.en: The university guide had a separate page explaining the term immigration registration.
examples.zh: 学校指南用单独一页来解释「移民身份登记」这个词。

examples.en: I asked which office was named for immigration registration in the notice.
examples.zh: 我问通知上说的是哪个办公室负责「移民身份登记」。

words.enDefinition: The Irish government service administering immigration permission

examples.en: The Irish notice named Immigration Service Delivery at the top of the first page.
examples.zh: 爱尔兰通知在第一页顶部写有「移民服务部门」的名称。

examples.en: The university guide included a section on documents issued by Immigration Service Delivery.
examples.zh: 学校指南有一个章节介绍「爱尔兰移民服务部门」出具的文件。

collocations: a notice from Immigration Service Delivery

words.enDefinition: A person's legal position under immigration rules

examples.en: The adviser asked whether my immigration status had changed since the previous semester.
examples.zh: 顾问问，从上学期以来，我的「移民身份」有没有变化。

examples.en: I opened the document to find the section that showed my immigration status.
examples.zh: 我打开文件，找显示我的「移民身份」的那一栏。

words.enDefinition: a person who is physically present to interpret speech between people

examples.en: The office arranged an in-person interpreter for the Tuesday afternoon group appointment.
examples.zh: 办事处给周二下午的集体预约安排了一位「现场口译员」。

examples.en: I asked where the in-person interpreter would meet us before the appointment.
examples.zh: 我问预约前，「现场口译员」会在哪里和我们碰面。

words.enDefinition: a service that takes place with the customer and worker physically present

examples.en: I asked whether an in-person service was available for the original document check.
examples.zh: 我问查验文件原件能不能用「现场办理服务」。

examples.en: The branch switched to in-person service after its telephone booking system changed.
examples.zh: 电话预约系统改动后，该办事点换成了「现场办理服务」。

words.enDefinition: a receipt handed over when documents are submitted at a counter

examples.en: The clerk stamped my in-person submission receipt before handing it back across the counter.
examples.zh: 办事员在我的「现场递交回执」上盖了章，再隔着柜台还给我。

examples.en: I kept the in-person submission receipt with the papers I carried home.
examples.zh: 我把「现场递交回执」与带回家的材料放在一起。

words.enDefinition: says that someone was present when an act happened

examples.en: The statement says it was signed in the presence of the person named underneath.
examples.zh: 声明写着，签署是在下方所列「那个人在场时」完成的。

examples.en: I highlighted 'In the presence of' because the words described who observed the signing.
examples.zh: 我标出了「在场时」这个说法，因为它说明了谁见证了签署。

collocations: sign in the presence of a witness
made in the presence of an officer
done in the presence of both people

words.enDefinition: On the way between sender and destination

examples.en: The document was still in transit when I checked the tracking page after class.
examples.zh: 我下课查看追踪页面时，文件还在「运输途中」。

examples.en: The office message said the envelope was in transit and gave the tracking reference.
examples.zh: 办事处的消息说信封在「运输途中」，并给出了追踪编号。

words.enDefinition: Mail arriving at an office or address

examples.en: The receptionist was sorting incoming mail when I asked about my document envelope.
examples.zh: 我问起文件信封时，接待员正在整理「收到的邮件」。

examples.en: I checked the folder for incoming mail from the agency that handles registration.
examples.zh: 我查看了归档「收到的邮件」的文件夹，找负责登记的机构寄来的信。

words.enDefinition: An address missing information needed for delivery

examples.en: The postal record showed “Incomplete address” beside the reference for my envelope.
examples.zh: 邮政记录在我信封的编号旁标了「地址不完整」。

examples.en: I asked which detail was missing from the incomplete address on the returned letter.
examples.zh: 我问退回信件上那处「不完整的地址」缺了哪项信息。

collocations: a letter with an incomplete address

words.enDefinition: a form missing answers or other information that should be included

examples.en: The office asked me to review the incomplete form before the appointment.
examples.zh: 办事处请我赴约前检查一下「未填完整的表格」。

examples.en: I accidentally brought an incomplete form because I printed the wrong file.
examples.zh: 我打印错了文件，不小心带来一份「未填完整的表格」。

words.enDefinition: a witness with no personal stake in the matter

examples.en: The template mentioned an independent witness, and I asked what that phrase meant.
examples.zh: 模板提到了「独立见证人」，我问这个词是什么意思。

examples.en: I found a line for the independent witness under the main section of the statement.
examples.zh: 我在声明正文下面找到了「独立见证人」一栏。

collocations: a statement by an independent witness

words.zhGloss: 在更正处旁签姓名缩写
words.enDefinition: to write your initials beside a correction to indicate that you made or approved it
acceptedZhAnswers: 在更正处旁签姓名缩写

examples.en: The form explained when staff might ask an applicant to initial a correction.
examples.zh: 表格说明了工作人员什么时候可能让申请人「在更正处旁签姓名缩写」。

examples.en: I asked the clerk where I should initial a correction on this page.
examples.zh: 我问办事员，应该在这页哪里「在更正处旁签姓名缩写」。

collocations: ask someone to initial a correction
initial a correction on a paper form
be required to initial a correction

words.enDefinition: an inked marking pressed onto paper by a stamp

examples.en: The ink stamp was blue and covered part of a handwritten date near the edge.
examples.zh: 「油墨印章」是蓝色的，盖住了边上手写日期的一部分。

examples.en: I noticed an ink stamp at the bottom of the copy beside the officer's title.
examples.zh: 我注意到副本底部的官员职务旁边有枚「油墨印章」。

collocations: an ink stamp on the reverse

words.enDefinition: the date by which a required inspection is due under the relevant schedule

examples.en: The vehicle record showed an inspection due date after the registration expiry date.
examples.zh: 车辆记录显示，「应接受检查的截止日」在登记到期日之后。

examples.en: I checked the inspection due date while reviewing the calendar on the portal.
examples.zh: 我查看门户网站日历时，核对了「应接受检查的截止日」。

collocations: a change to the inspection due date

words.enDefinition: a code that identifies a particular inspection, booking, or related record

examples.en: The clerk used the inspection reference to find the report on the system.
examples.zh: 办事员用「检验查询编号」在系统里找到了报告。

examples.en: The inspection reference was printed beside the vehicle number on the appointment confirmation.
examples.zh: 「检验查询编号」印在预约确认单的车辆编号旁边。

words.enDefinition: Postage that falls short of the required amount

examples.en: The returned envelope carried a note saying insufficient postage next to the label.
examples.zh: 退回的信封在标签旁贴了张条，写着「邮资不足」。

examples.en: The postal clerk explained what insufficient postage meant on the sample notice.
examples.zh: 邮局柜台工作人员解释了样本通知上的「邮资不足」是什么意思。

collocations: mark an envelope as having insufficient postage

words.enDefinition: a staff member who receives new cases and checks their initial information

examples.en: The intake officer checked the cover sheet before sending my papers upstairs.
examples.zh: 「初始受理员」检查了封面页，才把材料送到楼上。

examples.en: I explained the purpose of my visit to the intake officer at reception.
examples.zh: 我向接待处的「初始受理员」说明了来意。

collocations: an intake officer at the front desk

words.enDefinition: the country where someone plans to present the document

examples.en: The cover sheet asked for the intended country of use of the attached papers.
examples.zh: 封面页询问所附文件的「拟使用国家」。

examples.en: I asked what intended country of use meant in the letter from the service office.
examples.zh: 我问服务处的信里，「文件拟使用的国家」是什么意思。

collocations: state the intended country of use
ask about the intended country of use
a box for the intended country of use

words.enDefinition: Checking official information through records held by another public body

examples.en: The notice listed interagency verification separately from the main document check.
examples.zh: 通知把「跨机构核验」与主要文件审查分开列出。

examples.en: I asked what information the interagency verification section referred to.
examples.zh: 我问「跨机构核验」一节指的是哪些信息。

words.enDefinition: A formal decision made while a case is still ongoing

examples.en: The tribunal sent an interim decision before the case had concluded.
examples.zh: 案件结束前，审裁机构发出了一项「阶段性决定」。

examples.en: I read the interim decision together with the later final determination.
examples.zh: 我把「阶段性决定」和后来作出的最终裁定放在一起读。

words.enDefinition: New Zealand's temporary permission while another visa is considered

examples.en: The New Zealand guide explained the Interim Visa in its section on temporary immigration records.
examples.zh: 新西兰指南在临时移民记录部分解释了「过渡签证」。

examples.en: I asked where the Interim Visa details appeared in the New Zealand example on screen.
examples.zh: 我问屏幕上的新西兰样例在哪儿显示了「过渡签证」详情。

collocations: an Interim Visa in New Zealand

words.enDefinition: A review conducted within the body that made the original decision

examples.en: The agency listed internal review as a separate type of review.
examples.zh: 政务机构把「机构内部复核」单列为一种复核方式。

examples.en: The letter identified the team responsible for the internal review.
examples.zh: 信件写明了负责「机构内部复核」的团队。

words.enDefinition: Mail sent from one country to another

examples.en: I asked which counter handled international mail before taking out my document envelope.
examples.zh: 拿出文件信封前，我问哪个柜台办理「国际邮件」。

examples.en: The postal guide listed international mail separately from services within the country.
examples.zh: 邮政指南把「国际邮件」和国内服务分开列出。

words.enDefinition: An explanation of what an official decision or its wording means

examples.en: The office sent an interpretation of the decision in a separate letter.
examples.zh: 办事处另发了一封信，提供了「对决定的解释」。

examples.en: I used the guide to check the interpretation of the decision we received.
examples.zh: 我用指南核对了我们收到的「对决定的解释」。

collocations: ask for an interpretation of the decision
give an interpretation of the decision
a written interpretation of the decision

words.enDefinition: information entered in a form that does not meet the field's rules

examples.en: The portal showed invalid entry when the address exceeded the available space.
examples.zh: 地址超过可用长度时，门户网站显示「无效输入项」。

examples.en: I corrected the invalid entry before trying to open the next section.
examples.zh: 我先改了「无效输入项」，再尝试打开下一部分。

words.enDefinition: A formal request giving someone an opportunity to express their views

examples.en: The invitation to comment listed the points the agency wanted us to address.
examples.zh: 「邀请陈述意见」列出了政务机构希望我们回应的要点。

examples.en: I asked which letter contained the invitation to comment for that review.
examples.zh: 我问哪封信包含那次复核的「邀请陈述意见」。

collocations: respond to an invitation to comment
an invitation to comment on the findings

words.enDefinition: A card recording a person's Irish immigration permission

examples.en: I compared the name on my Irish Residence Permit with the university's record.
examples.zh: 我对照学校档案核对了「爱尔兰居留许可卡」上的姓名。

examples.en: The adviser showed me where the stamp number appeared on the Irish Residence Permit.
examples.zh: 顾问指给我看，印章编号印在「爱尔兰居留许可卡」的什么位置。

collocations: details on an Irish Residence Permit

words.enDefinition: The agency or official body that issued a particular document

examples.en: I asked which name on the certificate was the issuing authority.
examples.zh: 我问证书上哪个名称指的是「签发机构」。

examples.en: The office showed the issuing authority on a sample card.
examples.zh: 办事处指出了卡片样本上的「签发机构」。

words.enDefinition: the official who formally issues a particular document or certificate

examples.en: The issuing official was named on the line below the date of the certificate.
examples.zh: 证书日期的下一行列了「签发文件的官员」的姓名。

examples.en: I checked whether the title on the attached sheet referred to the same issuing official.
examples.zh: 我确认附页上的职务是否指同一位「签发文件的官员」。

collocations: a signature from the issuing official

words.enDefinition: A U.S. visa category for exchange visitors

examples.en: The university's U.S. exchange guide listed J-1 visa beside the program information.
examples.zh: 美国大学的交流项目指南在项目信息旁列出了「J-1交流访问签证」。

examples.en: I asked which document in the example referred to the J-1 visa.
examples.zh: 我问样例中的哪份文件提到了「美国J-1交流访问签证」。

words.enDefinition: a person applying together with one or more other people under the same request

examples.en: The joint applicant completed the section on the second page of the form.
examples.zh: 「共同申请人」填了表格第二页的那一节。

examples.en: I asked whether the joint applicant needed a copy of the same notice.
examples.zh: 我问「共同申请人」需不需要同一份通知的副本。

words.zhGloss: 新西兰院校联合支持信
words.enDefinition: A letter jointly issued by New Zealand pathway providers
acceptedZhAnswers: 新西兰院校联合支持信

examples.en: The guide showed a sample joint letter of support from two New Zealand schools.
examples.zh: 指南展示了一封由两所新西兰学校共同出具的「院校联合支持信」样本。

examples.en: I checked whether both providers were listed on the joint letter of support.
examples.zh: 我查看了「新西兰院校联合支持信」上是否列出了两家办学机构。

collocations: a joint letter of support from two providers
issue a joint letter of support
review the joint letter of support

words.enDefinition: A court's examination of whether an official decision was lawful

examples.en: The booklet explained the role of the court in judicial review.
examples.zh: 手册解释了法院在「司法审查」中的作用。

examples.en: The notice used the phrase judicial review in a separate section.
examples.zh: 通知在单独一节使用了「司法审查」这个说法。
