words.enDefinition: a certificate recording that someone signed and swore or affirmed a statement

examples.en: The American sample included a jurat on the last page of the sworn statement.
examples.zh: 美国样本在宣誓声明的最后一页附有「宣誓签署公证证明」。

examples.en: I asked what a jurat recorded because it had its own heading above the seal.
examples.zh: 它在印章上方有自己的标题，所以我问「宣誓签署公证证明」记录了什么。

collocations: a jurat attached to a statement

words.enDefinition: an appointed public official whose duties vary by jurisdiction

examples.en: The New South Wales notice listed a justice of the peace for document witnessing.
examples.zh: 新南威尔士州的通知上列了一位负责文件见证的「太平绅士」。

examples.en: The justice of the peace pointed out the witness section on my Australian form.
examples.zh: 「太平绅士」指给我看了澳大利亚表格上的见证人一栏。

collocations: meet a justice of the peace
the title justice of the peace
a record witnessed by a justice of the peace

words.enDefinition: A tracking update that the shipping label exists

examples.en: The tracking page showed “Label created” after the office prepared the document envelope.
examples.zh: 办事处准备好文件信封后，追踪页面显示「邮寄标签已创建」。

examples.en: I saw “Label created” next to the reference in the office's first message.
examples.zh: 我在办事处发来的第一条消息里看到编号旁写着「邮寄标签已创建」。

words.enDefinition: support such as interpretation or translation that helps people understand or use a service

examples.en: The sign listed language assistance beside information about the office's opening hours.
examples.zh: 标牌在办公时间信息旁列出了「语言协助」。

examples.en: I asked whether language assistance was available during the appointment on Friday.
examples.zh: 我问周五赴约时是否能得到「语言协助」。

collocations: provide language assistance at the desk

words.enDefinition: the two languages involved in a translation assignment

examples.en: The translator listed the language pair below the heading on the first page.
examples.zh: 译员在第一页标题下面列了「翻译语种组合」。

examples.en: I asked whether the language pair on the stamp referred to this particular translation.
examples.zh: 我问印章上的「语种组合」是不是指这份翻译。

collocations: work with a particular language pair

words.enDefinition: vehicle registration that has ended because it was not renewed in time

examples.en: The notice gave the date from which the record showed lapsed registration.
examples.zh: 通知写明，从哪天起记录就显示为「已经失效的车辆登记」。

examples.en: The clerk explained how the portal labelled lapsed registration in our example.
examples.zh: 办事员说明了门户网站怎样标记例子里的「已经失效的车辆登记」。

words.enDefinition: The final pickup of posted mail that day

examples.en: The last collection was listed on a small sign beside the postbox.
examples.zh: 邮筒旁的小牌子上写着「当天最后收信时间」。

examples.en: I asked whether the last collection had already happened at that branch.
examples.zh: 我问那个网点当日是否已经进行了「最后一次收信」。

collocations: check the time of the last collection

words.enDefinition: A label introducing the date an online record last changed

examples.en: I found "Last updated on" beneath the status heading on the page.
examples.zh: 我在页面的状态标题下方找到了「上次更新于」。

examples.en: The page read "Last updated on Monday," so I checked the dates.
examples.zh: 页面显示「上次更新于星期一」，我便核对了几份通知。

collocations: last updated on the date shown
a label reading last updated on
look for the last updated on label

words.enDefinition: Recording a birth after the usual registration period has passed

examples.en: I asked what the leaflet meant by late birth registration for older records.
examples.zh: 我问说明单在旧记录部分提到的「逾期出生登记」是什么意思。

examples.en: The office described late birth registration in a separate section of its guide.
examples.zh: 办事处在指南中用单独一节介绍了「逾期出生登记」。

collocations: a record of late birth registration

words.enDefinition: A stay permitted under immigration rules

examples.en: The adviser asked which document recorded my period of lawful stay during the exchange.
examples.zh: 顾问问，哪份文件记录了我交换期间的「合法停留」时间。

examples.en: I asked the adviser what lawful stay meant in the letter I'd received.
examples.zh: 我问顾问，我收到的信里「合法停留」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: an instruction not to put any information in a specified part of a form

examples.en: The instructions said to leave this section blank when applying on your own.
examples.zh: 说明上写着，如果是个人申请，要「将此部分留空」。

examples.en: I read leave this section blank before skipping to the next page.
examples.zh: 我看到「请将此部分留空」，于是直接翻到下一页。

collocations: be asked to leave this section blank
allow applicants to leave this section blank

words.enDefinition: UK immigration permission to stay in the country

examples.en: The UK letter used leave to remain in the section showing my permission dates.
examples.zh: 英国的信在列出许可日期的部分用了「在英停留许可」一词。

examples.en: I asked where leave to remain was shown on the sample from the British university.
examples.zh: 我问那所英国大学提供的样本在哪儿显示了「在英停留许可」。

words.enDefinition: A status saying mail was left in a sheltered or designated spot

examples.en: The delivery note said “Left in a safe place” for the envelope from campus.
examples.zh: 学校寄来的信封在投递说明里显示「已放在安全处」。

examples.en: I checked which location the “Left in a safe place” update referred to.
examples.zh: 我查看了「已放在安全处」这条更新说的是哪个位置。

collocations: a “Left in a safe place” note
mark an item as left in a safe place
a delivery left in a safe place

words.enDefinition: A notice saying delivery was made to a neighbour

examples.en: The delivery card said “Left with neighbour” and showed which door to ask at.
examples.zh: 投递通知卡写着「已由邻居代收」，并标出了该去敲哪扇门。

examples.en: I saw “Left with neighbour” in the tracking details after coming home from campus.
examples.zh: 我从学校回家后，在追踪详情里看到了「已由邻居代收」。

words.enDefinition: a person with legally recognized responsibility for someone who needs guardianship

examples.en: The office asked whether a legal guardian would attend the appointment with the applicant.
examples.zh: 办事处问，赴约时是否有「法定监护人」陪同申请人。

examples.en: I checked where the legal guardian was expected to sign on the form.
examples.zh: 我确认了「法定监护人」需要在表格哪里签名。

collocations: a form for a legal guardian

words.enDefinition: An officially recognized change from one legal name to another

examples.en: I asked which document recorded the legal name change for that person.
examples.zh: 我问哪份文件记录了当事人的「法定姓名变更」。

examples.en: The clerk explained how the legal name change differed from a spelling correction.
examples.zh: 办事员解释了「法定姓名变更」与拼写更正有什么区别。

collocations: documents for a legal name change

words.enDefinition: handwritten text clear enough for another person to read without difficulty

examples.en: The clerk asked for legible handwriting in the boxes containing contact details.
examples.zh: 办事员请大家填写联系方式时用「清晰易认的字迹」。

examples.en: The photocopy was faint, so I filled in a fresh form with legible handwriting.
examples.zh: 复印件太淡，所以我用「清晰易认的字迹」重填了一份表格。

words.enDefinition: A guide used to check the size of postal letters

examples.en: The postal clerk put my envelope against the letter size guide at the counter.
examples.zh: 邮局柜台工作人员把我的信封贴到柜台的「信函尺寸测量板」上。

examples.en: The post office kept a letter size guide beside the display of stamps.
examples.zh: 邮局在邮票展示台旁放了一块「信函尺寸测量板」。

collocations: a letter size guide at the counter
check an envelope against a letter size guide

words.enDefinition: A narrow opening through which letters are delivered

examples.en: The official envelope was waiting beneath the letter slot when I came home.
examples.zh: 我回家时，官方信封已经放在「投信口」下面。

examples.en: A volunteer showed me the letter slot in the office's outside door.
examples.zh: 志愿者指给我看办公室外门上的「投信口」。

collocations: a letter slot in a door
push mail through a letter slot

words.enDefinition: an update to the address recorded on a driving licence or its official record

examples.en: I checked whether the licence address change had appeared in my online record.
examples.zh: 我查了「驾照住址变更」是否已经显示在网上记录中。

examples.en: The office issued a receipt after recording my licence address change on Friday.
examples.zh: 办事处在周五登记了我的「驾照住址变更」，之后出了一张回执。

collocations: confirmation of a licence address change

words.enDefinition: a requirement listed on a driving licence that applies to use of the permissions it gives

examples.en: The card showed a licence condition requiring corrective lenses during driving.
examples.zh: 驾照标了一项「驾驶执照附带条件」，注明驾驶时须佩戴视力矫正镜片。

examples.en: I asked the office what the licence condition printed beside the code meant.
examples.zh: 我问办事处，代码旁印的「驾驶执照附带条件」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: an entry on a UK driving record recording a motoring offence

examples.en: The licence endorsement on my UK driving record shows the date of the offence.
examples.zh: 我的「英国驾照违章记录」上写着违规日期。

examples.en: The adviser explained how the licence endorsement appeared on the official UK driving record.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了「英国驾照违章记录」在英国官方驾驶记录上是怎样显示的。

words.enDefinition: a charge for issuing, renewing or otherwise processing a driving licence

examples.en: The office listed the licence fee separately from the photograph charge.
examples.zh: 办事处把「驾照办理费」和拍照费用分开列出。

examples.en: I asked where the current licence fee was shown on the application page.
examples.zh: 我问申请页面在哪里显示了当前的「驾照办理费」。

words.enDefinition: officially restoring driving privileges after a licence has been suspended or otherwise made inactive

examples.en: The office sent a letter showing the effective date of the licence reinstatement.
examples.zh: 办事处发了封信，写明「恢复驾照效力」的生效日期。

examples.en: The caseworker explained which entry referred to licence reinstatement on the sample record.
examples.zh: 承办人员解释了样本记录中哪一条指「恢复驾照效力」。

words.enDefinition: a temporary loss of the permission to drive under a licence

examples.en: The notice explained when the licence suspension would begin in the sample case.
examples.zh: 通知说明了例子中的「暂停驾照效力」从何时开始。

examples.en: I read the letter about the licence suspension before contacting the licensing office.
examples.zh: 联系驾驶证业务办理处前，我读了关于「暂停驾照效力」的信。

words.enDefinition: a text in another language giving information from a driving licence

examples.en: The desk asked whether the licence translation included both sides of the card.
examples.zh: 柜台问，「驾驶证翻译件」有没有涵盖证件的正反两面。

examples.en: I saved the licence translation with the rest of my documents for the appointment.
examples.zh: 我把「驾驶证翻译件」和赴约要带的其他材料放在了一起。

words.enDefinition: a letter from an authority confirming information about a driving licence

examples.en: The office asked whether my licence verification letter came from the issuing authority.
examples.zh: 办事处问，我的「驾驶证核验函」是不是签发机关开的。

examples.en: I placed the licence verification letter beside the translated copy of my original card.
examples.zh: 我把「驾驶证核验函」和原证件的翻译件放在一起。

collocations: a licence verification letter from the issuing authority

words.enDefinition: an official website for checking the details or validity of a licence

examples.en: We entered the number in the licence verification portal to check the spelling.
examples.zh: 我们把编号输入「许可证核验平台」，用来核对拼写。

examples.en: The licence verification portal displayed the original issue date beneath the holder's name.
examples.zh: 「许可证核验平台」在持证人姓名下方显示了首次签发日期。

words.enDefinition: a public body responsible for issuing or overseeing licences of a stated kind

examples.en: I asked which licensing authority had issued the permit shown in the leaflet.
examples.zh: 我问宣传单上的许可是哪个「许可签发机关」发的。

examples.en: The form gave the address of the licensing authority at the bottom.
examples.zh: 表格底部写了「许可签发机关」的地址。

words.enDefinition: an official who processes licence applications or checks compliance with licensing rules

examples.en: A licensing officer contacted us to confirm the name on the application.
examples.zh: 一名「许可事务专员」联系我们核实申请上的姓名。

examples.en: The licensing officer explained which parts of the permit were still under review.
examples.zh: 「许可事务专员」说明了许可中哪些部分还在审核。

words.enDefinition: A passport issued with a shorter validity period than usual

examples.en: The US guide used the label limited-validity passport in a separate section.
examples.zh: 美国指南在单独一节使用了「限有效期护照」这个名称。

examples.en: I asked where the validity dates appeared on the limited-validity passport.
examples.zh: 我问「限有效期护照」的有效期日期印在什么地方。

words.enDefinition: an organization responsible for administering public services in a local area

examples.en: I asked which local authority was responsible for the neighbourhood's parking permits.
examples.zh: 我问，负责这个街区停车许可证的是哪个「地方主管机关」。

examples.en: The local authority sent a leaflet explaining where to direct public enquiries.
examples.zh: 「地方主管机关」发了宣传单，说明公众咨询应该发到哪里。

collocations: services run by a local authority

words.enDefinition: A birth certificate containing more details than an abbreviated version

examples.en: The clerk explained what the office meant by a long-form birth certificate.
examples.zh: 办事员解释了办事处说的「详版出生证明」是什么意思。

examples.en: I compared the fields on the long-form birth certificate with the other version.
examples.zh: 我比较了「详版出生证明」和另一个版本上的字段。

collocations: details on a long-form birth certificate

words.enDefinition: A visa for a longer period of stay

examples.en: The French university guide used long-stay visa in its section on immigration documents.
examples.zh: 法国大学指南在移民文件章节中用了「长期停留签证」一词。

examples.en: I asked whether the sample notice named the long-stay visa above the reference number.
examples.zh: 我问通知样本有没有在编号上方写明「长期停留签证」。

words.expression: long-stay visa equivalent to a residence permit
words.lemma: long-stay visa equivalent to a residence permit
words.zhGloss: 法国等同居留许可的长期签证
words.enDefinition: A French long-stay visa that can serve as residence permission
acceptedZhAnswers: 法国等同居留许可的长期签证
acceptedEnVariants: long-stay visa equivalent to a residence permit

examples.en: The French guide showed a long-stay visa equivalent to a residence permit in the sample passport.
examples.zh: 法国指南在护照样本中展示了「等同居留许可的长期签证」。

examples.en: I asked what long-stay visa equivalent to a residence permit meant on the French page.
examples.zh: 我问法国网页上的「等同居留许可的长期签证」是什么意思。

collocations: the category shown on a VLS-TS

words.zhGloss: 美国M-1职业教育学生签证
words.enDefinition: A U.S. visa category for vocational students
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国M-1职业教育学生签证

examples.en: The guide showed M-1 visa as a heading for certain U.S. vocational courses.
examples.zh: 指南用「美国M-1职业教育学生签证」作部分职业课程的栏目标题。

examples.en: My classmate asked which sample visa page showed the words M-1 visa.
examples.zh: 同学问，哪一页签证样本标出了「美国M-1职业教育学生签证」。

words.enDefinition: A passport bearing information in a standardized form machines can read

examples.en: The office explained the term machine-readable passport beside a sample document.
examples.zh: 办事处用一份证件样本解释了「机读护照」这个词。

examples.en: The sample machine-readable passport appeared beside a picture of an older document.
examples.zh: 「机读护照」样本放在一张旧证件的图片旁边。

collocations: an example of a machine-readable passport

words.enDefinition: A person who delivers letters and other mail

examples.en: The mail carrier brought an envelope from the local administration office that morning.
examples.zh: 那天早上，「邮递员」送来一个地方行政办公室寄出的信封。

examples.en: I met the mail carrier at the entrance to our student residence.
examples.zh: 我在学生宿舍入口遇到了「邮递员」。

collocations: a letter delivered by a mail carrier

words.enDefinition: The time when deposited mail is picked up

examples.en: The postbox had a plate showing the mail collection time for weekdays.
examples.zh: 邮筒上有一块牌子，写着工作日的「邮筒收信时间」。

examples.en: I checked the mail collection time before deciding where to post the form.
examples.zh: 决定到哪里寄表格之前，我查看了「邮筒收信时间」。

words.enDefinition: A service that temporarily keeps mail instead of delivering it

examples.en: I read the section on mail hold before leaving the residence for the holidays.
examples.zh: 放假离开宿舍之前，我读了有关「邮件暂存服务」的部分。

examples.en: The postal operator sent a confirmation for the mail hold I had requested.
examples.zh: 邮政运营机构发来确认，说明收到了我提出的「邮件暂存服务」申请。

words.enDefinition: A facility where mail is sorted for delivery

examples.en: The tracking record showed that my letter had reached a mail sorting centre.
examples.zh: 追踪记录显示，我的信已到达「邮件分拣中心」。

examples.en: I wrote down the mail sorting centre named in the update from the operator.
examples.zh: 我记下了邮政运营机构更新中提到的「邮件分拣中心」。

collocations: pass through a mail sorting centre

words.enDefinition: To send the original papers through the mail

examples.en: The adviser showed me which section discussed whether to mail the original documents.
examples.zh: 顾问指给我看，哪一节讨论是否要「邮寄文件原件」。

examples.en: I asked whether I should mail the original documents or bring them to the appointment.
examples.zh: 我问是要「邮寄文件原件」，还是预约办理时带过去。

collocations: ask whether to mail the original documents
mail the original documents to an office
instructions about when to mail the original documents

words.enDefinition: Directions for sending an item through the mail

examples.en: I read the mailing instructions before choosing an envelope for the signed documents.
examples.zh: 为已签署的文件挑信封之前，我读了「邮寄说明」。

examples.en: The mailing instructions on the last page named the office responsible for receiving documents.
examples.zh: 通知最后一页的「邮寄说明」写明了负责收件的办事处。

words.enDefinition: A long tube used to mail rolled items

examples.en: I put my exhibition poster into a mailing tube before going to the post office.
examples.zh: 去邮局之前，我把展览海报装进了「邮寄纸筒」。

examples.en: The postal clerk asked whether the cap was attached to my mailing tube.
examples.zh: 邮局柜台工作人员问，我的「邮寄纸筒」有没有装好盖子。

collocations: send a poster in a mailing tube

words.enDefinition: An individual item handled as mail

examples.en: The U.S. postal guide used mailpiece when describing the identifier on each envelope.
examples.zh: 美国邮政指南在介绍每个信封上的标识时，用了「单件邮寄物品」一词。

examples.en: The clerk asked which mailpiece the reference number belonged to in the tracking record.
examples.zh: 工作人员问，追踪记录中这个编号对应哪件「邮寄物品」。

words.enDefinition: to send or state a question through an organization's official channels

examples.en: I decided to make a formal enquiry about the address on the notice.
examples.zh: 我决定就通知上的地址「提出正式咨询」。

examples.en: The clerk explained where I could make a formal enquiry about that service.
examples.zh: 办事员解释了就那项服务去哪里「提出正式咨询」。

collocations: make a formal enquiry in writing
call to make a formal enquiry
make a formal enquiry about a service

words.enDefinition: the manufacturer's name and the particular model of a vehicle

examples.en: The form asked for the make and model before asking for the plate number.
examples.zh: 表格先要求填写「厂牌和车型」，再问车牌号。

examples.en: I checked the make and model against the details on the registration document.
examples.zh: 我用登记文件的详细信息核对了「厂牌和车型」。

collocations: give a vehicle's make and model

words.zhGloss: 英国福利决定重新审议
words.enDefinition: A UK process for reconsidering certain benefits decisions within the department
acceptedZhAnswers: 英国福利决定重新审议

examples.en: The UK leaflet used mandatory reconsideration in the section on benefits.
examples.zh: 英国说明单在福利一节用了「英国福利决定重新审议」这一术语。

examples.en: I asked which part of the guide described mandatory reconsideration.
examples.zh: 我问指南哪一部分介绍了「英国福利决定重新审议」。

words.zhGloss: 英国福利重审结果通知
words.enDefinition: A UK notice giving the outcome of a benefits reconsideration
acceptedZhAnswers: 英国福利重审结果通知

examples.en: The UK example showed a mandatory reconsideration notice with the result at the top.
examples.zh: 英国示例的「英国福利重审结果通知」把结果印在顶部。

examples.en: I checked which decision was named in the mandatory reconsideration notice.
examples.zh: 我核对了「英国福利重审结果通知」提到的是哪项决定。

collocations: a copy of a mandatory reconsideration notice

words.enDefinition: a part of a form that must be completed under the instructions

examples.en: The instructions marked the contact information as a mandatory section for this application.
examples.zh: 说明把联系方式标为这项申请的「必填部分」。

examples.en: I went back to the mandatory section after the portal flagged a missing answer.
examples.zh: 门户网站提示漏答一项，我返回了「必填部分」。

words.enDefinition: the official category describing whether a person is single, married or otherwise in a recognized status

examples.en: I checked the marital status options before entering the other details on the form.
examples.zh: 填其他信息前，我查看了「婚姻状况」有哪些选项。

examples.en: The officer asked whether my marital status had changed since the earlier application.
examples.zh: 办事员问，自之前的申请以来，我的「婚姻状况」有没有变化。

words.enDefinition: permission from a market authority or local government to operate a stall at a market

examples.en: The baker received a market stall permit for the Saturday craft market.
examples.zh: 这位烘焙师拿到了周六手工艺市集的「市集摊位许可证」。

examples.en: Did your market stall permit specify which entrance to use on Sunday?
examples.zh: 你的「市集摊位许可证」有没有写明周日从哪个入口进？

collocations: apply for a market stall permit

words.enDefinition: An official document confirming that a marriage was recorded

examples.en: The clerk asked which office issued the marriage certificate I had brought.
examples.zh: 办事员问我带来的「结婚证明」是哪个办事处签发的。

examples.en: I checked how the two names appeared on the marriage certificate.
examples.zh: 我核对了「结婚证明」上两个人的姓名是怎样写的。

collocations: a copy of a marriage certificate

words.enDefinition: An official document granting permission for a marriage to take place

examples.en: The clerk explained how a marriage licence differed from a certificate.
examples.zh: 办事员解释了「结婚许可文件」和结婚证明有什么区别。

examples.en: I checked which authority was printed on the sample marriage licence.
examples.zh: 我核对了「结婚许可文件」样本上印的是哪个机构。

words.enDefinition: An official collection of entries recording marriages in an area

examples.en: Our search began with the marriage register listed for that year.
examples.zh: 我们从那一年对应的「婚姻登记簿」查起。

examples.en: I asked whether the marriage register included entries from neighboring towns.
examples.zh: 我问「婚姻登记簿」是否包括邻近城镇的登记记录。

collocations: an entry in the marriage register

words.enDefinition: agree with the details recorded in an official register

examples.en: The clerk checked that the date and reference on my copy match the registry entry.
examples.zh: 工作人员核对了我的副本日期和参考编号，确认它们「与登记记录相符」。

examples.en: The published name did not match the registry entry, so I asked about the difference.
examples.zh: 公示的名称「与登记记录不符」，所以我询问了这个差异。

collocations: check that details match the registry entry
an identifier can match the registry entry
the dates match the registry entry

words.enDefinition: says a copy agrees with the document it reproduces

examples.en: The note says this page matches the original and refers to the copy underneath.
examples.zh: 备注说这一页「与原件相符」，指的是下面那份副本。

examples.en: I asked whether the scan matches the original after noticing a faint line near the edge.
examples.zh: 我看到边上有条淡淡的线，就问扫描件是否「与原件相符」。

collocations: verify that it matches the original
confirm that the copy matches the original
check whether it matches the original

words.enDefinition: a statement giving health information that a driving authority asks a driver to provide

examples.en: The form listed a medical declaration for drivers under the supporting documents section.
examples.zh: 表格在证明材料一节列出了「驾驶人健康申报」。

examples.en: I asked who should sign the medical declaration for drivers in this example.
examples.zh: 我问在这个例子里，「驾驶人健康申报」该由谁签名。

collocations: complete a medical declaration for drivers
request a medical declaration for drivers
review a medical declaration for drivers

words.enDefinition: Reconsideration of a decision's facts, law, and merits by a reviewer

examples.en: The Australian guide explained the purpose of merits review in plain language.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚指南用通俗语言解释了「实质复核」的目的。

examples.en: I asked what the term merits review meant in the tribunal's notice.
examples.zh: 我问审裁机构通知中的「实质复核」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: The means used to officially deliver a notice or document

examples.en: The form listed the method of service next to the recipient's address.
examples.zh: 表格在收件人地址旁列明了「正式送达方式」。

examples.en: I checked whether the method of service was described in the case file.
examples.zh: 我查看了案卷里是否说明了「正式送达方式」。

words.enDefinition: A personal name appearing between the first name and surname

examples.en: I checked whether my middle name appeared in the old record.
examples.zh: 我核对了旧档案里有没有我的「中间名」。

examples.en: The clerk asked which field was used for a middle name.
examples.zh: 办事员问哪个字段用来填写「中间名」。

words.enDefinition: A notice left after an unsuccessful delivery attempt

examples.en: I found a missed delivery notice inside the door when I came home.
examples.zh: 我回家时，在门内发现了一张「未能送达通知」。

examples.en: The missed delivery notice named the office where the envelope was being held.
examples.zh: 「未能送达通知」写明了信封暂存在什么办事点。

collocations: details on a missed delivery notice

words.zhGloss: 美国邮政遗失邮件查找
words.enDefinition: A USPS request to look for missing mail
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国邮政遗失邮件查找

examples.en: The U.S. postal page listed Missing Mail Search in a section about delayed items.
examples.zh: 美国邮政页面在延迟邮件栏目中列出了「遗失邮件查找」。

examples.en: I wrote down which details the Missing Mail Search screen asked me to provide.
examples.zh: 我记下了「美国邮政遗失邮件查找」页面要求提供哪些信息。

words.enDefinition: a manufacturer's designated year for a vehicle model or version

examples.en: The agency recorded the model year in a separate box from the purchase date.
examples.zh: 机构把「车型年份」放在与购买日期不同的方框里。

examples.en: I checked which model year appeared in the example on the agency's website.
examples.zh: 我查看了机构网站上的示例显示的是哪个「车型年份」。

words.enDefinition: a UK certificate documenting that a vehicle passed an MOT inspection

examples.en: I checked the dates on the MOT certificate before sending the document copy.
examples.zh: 寄文件副本之前，我核对了「英国机动车检测证书」上的日期。

examples.en: The registration file showed where to find the latest MOT certificate online.
examples.zh: 登记档案标明了网上哪里可以查到最新的「英国机动车检测证书」。

collocations: a copy of the MOT certificate

words.enDefinition: a UK vehicle inspection assessing specified safety and environmental standards

examples.en: The UK adviser described the MOT test when we reviewed the registration documents.
examples.zh: 我们查看登记文件时，英国顾问介绍了「英国机动车定期检测」。

examples.en: I checked the date shown for the next MOT test in the vehicle record.
examples.zh: 我查了车辆记录中列出的下次「英国机动车定期检测」日期。

words.enDefinition: A request to USCIS alleging it applied law or policy incorrectly

examples.en: The adviser explained how the guide defined a motion to reconsider.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了指南怎样定义「申请复议的动议」。

examples.en: I found the motion to reconsider heading in the US reference booklet.
examples.zh: 我在美国参考手册中找到了「申请复议的动议」这个标题。

collocations: a ruling on a motion to reconsider

words.enDefinition: A request to USCIS to reopen a case using new facts

examples.en: The US guide put motion to reopen and reconsideration in separate sections.
examples.zh: 美国指南把「申请重开案件的动议」和重新考虑分开介绍。

examples.en: I asked what a motion to reopen meant in the sample notice.
examples.zh: 我问通知样本中的「申请重开案件的动议」指什么。

collocations: a decision on a motion to reopen

words.enDefinition: a formal certificate recording details of insurance coverage for a motor vehicle

examples.en: The letter enclosed a motor insurance certificate for the vehicle named in the policy.
examples.zh: 信中附有保单所列车辆的「机动车保险证明」。

examples.en: I compared the motor insurance certificate with the copy saved by the office.
examples.zh: 我把「机动车保险证明」和办事处留存的副本作了对照。

words.enDefinition: temporary permission to reserve street space for a moving truck

examples.en: Our moving truck permit listed the spaces we could use on Tuesday.
examples.zh: 我们的「搬家车辆临停许可」列出了周二可以使用的车位。

examples.en: I asked the housing office for help reading the moving truck permit.
examples.zh: 我请住宿办公室帮我看懂「搬家车辆临停许可」。

collocations: apply for a moving truck permit

words.enDefinition: Citizenship of more than one country held by one person

examples.en: I asked what the form meant by multiple citizenships in that section.
examples.zh: 我问表格那一节提到的「多重公民身份」是什么意思。

examples.en: The guide discussed multiple citizenships separately from the name on a passport.
examples.zh: 指南把「多重公民身份」与护照上的姓名分开介绍。

words.enDefinition: A visa designated for more than one entry

examples.en: The sample showed multiple-entry visa under the heading for the number of entries.
examples.zh: 样本在入境次数的栏目下标出了「多次入境签证」。

examples.en: I asked the adviser where a multiple-entry visa was identified on the record.
examples.zh: 我问顾问，记录在哪里标明了「多次入境签证」。

collocations: the validity of a multiple-entry visa

words.enDefinition: a division of a city or town government responsible for a particular public service

examples.en: The portal asked me to choose a municipal department before sending my enquiry.
examples.zh: 门户网站让我先选一个「市政部门」，再发送咨询。

examples.en: I found the municipal department responsible for public facilities in the office directory.
examples.zh: 我在机构名录里找到了负责公共设施的「市政部门」。

words.enDefinition: introduces the date on which the notary's appointment ends

examples.en: The sample stamp read 'My commission expires' above a handwritten date at the bottom.
examples.zh: 样本印章底部的手写日期上方写着「本人的任期到期日」。

examples.en: I noticed 'My commission expires' beside the other fields on the American notary form.
examples.zh: 我在美国公证表格的其他栏位旁看到了「本人的任期到期日」。

collocations: a field marked my commission expires
a stamp reading my commission expires

words.enDefinition: a translator holding an Australian NAATI translation credential

examples.en: The Australian form referred to a NAATI-certified translator in the section about language services.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚表格在语言服务一栏提到了「澳大利亚NAATI认证译员」。

examples.en: I compared the name of the NAATI-certified translator with the name printed on the stamp.
examples.zh: 我核对了「澳大利亚NAATI认证译员」姓名和印章上印的姓名。

collocations: a statement from a NAATI-certified translator
a translation by a NAATI-certified translator

words.enDefinition: a stamp displaying a translator's NAATI credential information

examples.en: The NAATI stamp appeared at the bottom of the Australian translation beside the date.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚翻译件底部的日期旁边有「澳大利亚NAATI译员印章」。

examples.en: I enlarged the page because the smaller text on the NAATI stamp was hard to read.
examples.zh: 我放大了这一页，因为「澳大利亚NAATI译员印章」上的小字很难看清。

words.enDefinition: The name recorded for someone when their birth was registered

examples.en: The form asked for my name at birth and my current name.
examples.zh: 表格要求填写「出生时登记的姓名」和现在的姓名。

examples.en: I checked my name at birth against the entry in the register.
examples.zh: 我把「出生时登记的姓名」与登记册中的条目作了核对。

words.enDefinition: A court order approving or formally recording a change of name

examples.en: The US clerk asked which court appeared on the name change order.
examples.zh: 美国的办事员问「法院更名令」上写的是哪个法院。

examples.en: I checked the date shown at the bottom of the name change order.
examples.zh: 我核对了「法院更名令」底部显示的日期。

collocations: a copy of a name change order

words.enDefinition: An amendment fixing a mistake in a recorded name

examples.en: I asked whether the office had recorded the name correction on my card.
examples.zh: 我问办事处是否已登记我卡片上的「姓名更正」。

examples.en: The updated record showed a name correction under the previous entry.
examples.zh: 更新后的档案在原条目下面显示了「姓名更正」。

words.enDefinition: A difference between the names or spellings shown in records

examples.en: I noticed a name discrepancy between the old record and my card.
examples.zh: 我发现旧记录与我的卡片存在「姓名不一致」。

examples.en: The clerk explained which two records showed the name discrepancy on file.
examples.zh: 办事员说明了档案中哪两份记录显示「姓名不一致」。

words.enDefinition: A designation, such as Junior, placed after a person's name

examples.en: I asked whether the final word counted as a name suffix.
examples.zh: 我问最后一个词算不算「姓名后缀」。

examples.en: The example printed the name suffix just below the surname field.
examples.zh: 示例把「姓名后缀」印在姓氏栏的正下方。

words.enDefinition: An identity card issued under a country's national identification system

examples.en: The form listed a national identity card separately from a passport booklet.
examples.zh: 表格把「国家身份证」与护照本分开列出。

examples.en: I checked the year printed on my national identity card for the record.
examples.zh: 我核对了「国家身份证」上印的年份，以便查档。

words.enDefinition: A UK identifier linking someone to their tax and contribution records

examples.en: The UK clerk explained where National Insurance number appeared on the sample.
examples.zh: 英国办事员说明了样本上的「英国国民保险号码」写在哪里。

examples.en: The payslip listed a field for my National Insurance number under my name.
examples.zh: 工资单在我姓名下面列有「英国国民保险号码」一栏。

words.enDefinition: A UK record of someone's National Insurance contributions and credits

examples.en: The UK guide said where National Insurance record was listed by name.
examples.zh: 英国指南说了哪里会明确列出「英国国民保险记录」这个名称。

examples.en: I asked what period the National Insurance record shown on the sample covered.
examples.zh: 我问样本上的「英国国民保险记录」涵盖哪段时间。

collocations: details on a National Insurance record

words.enDefinition: The part of a form that records someone's nationality

examples.en: The clerk pointed to the nationality field near the document details.
examples.zh: 办事员指了指证件详情附近的「国籍栏」。

examples.en: I asked whether the nationality field was the same on both forms.
examples.zh: 我问两张表上的「国籍栏」是不是一样的。

words.enDefinition: the part of a UK V5C given to the vehicle's new registered keeper

examples.en: The seller gave me the new keeper slip when I collected the car.
examples.zh: 我取车时，卖家把「新登记持有人联」交给了我。

examples.en: I kept the new keeper slip with the other documents from the sale.
examples.zh: 我把「新登记持有人联」与购车的其他文件一起保管。

words.enDefinition: the first staff member who becomes free to serve another visitor

examples.en: I waited for the next available clerk after reaching the front of the line.
examples.zh: 排到队首后，我等「下一位空闲的办事员」。

examples.en: The notice asked applicants to take their paperwork to the next available clerk.
examples.zh: 通知请申请人把材料交给「下一位空闲的办事员」。

collocations: wait for the next available clerk
speak to the next available clerk
direct someone to the next available clerk

words.enDefinition: A notice that a delivery location could not be reached

examples.en: The carrier recorded “No access” when the main door to the residence was locked.
examples.zh: 学生宿舍的大门锁着，邮递员记下「无法进入投递地点」。

examples.en: I saw “No access” beside the attempted delivery date on the online record.
examples.zh: 我在网上记录的尝试投递日期旁边看到了「无法进入投递地点」。

words.enDefinition: No new address is available for forwarding the item

examples.en: The returned mail had “No forwarding address” printed beside the old delivery details.
examples.zh: 退件在旧的投递信息旁边印着「没有改寄地址」。

examples.en: I asked how the office had recorded “No forwarding address” in the case file.
examples.zh: 我问办事处在本次事务档案里是怎么记录「没有改寄地址」的。

collocations: report that there is no forwarding address

words.enDefinition: A notice saying no signature is expected for delivery

examples.en: The label said “No signature required” on one of the two sample envelopes.
examples.zh: 两份样本信封中的一份标着「无须签收」。

examples.en: I checked whether “No signature required” appeared in the delivery details for my letter.
examples.zh: 我查了信件的投递详情里是否显示「无须签收」。

collocations: a service listed as no signature required

words.enDefinition: An agency label for a notification that did not arrive

examples.en: The US portal listed non-delivery of notice as a separate inquiry category.
examples.zh: 美国政务平台把「未收到通知」单列为一种咨询类别。

examples.en: I asked which letter the non-delivery of notice message referred to.
examples.zh: 我问「未收到通知」的消息指的是哪封信。

collocations: an inquiry about non-delivery of notice

words.enDefinition: used to show that a question, field or requirement is irrelevant to the case

examples.en: I selected not applicable because the question did not cover my situation.
examples.zh: 这道题和我的情况无关，所以我选了「不适用」。

examples.en: The guide asked us to write not applicable instead of leaving blanks.
examples.zh: 指南要求填「不适用」，不用留空。

collocations: select not applicable from the list

words.enDefinition: a notarial record that a person acknowledged signing a document

examples.en: The sample notarial acknowledgment referred to the signature on the document I had read.
examples.zh: 样本的「签名确认公证」提到了我看过的那份文件上的签名。

examples.en: I asked why the notarial acknowledgment appeared on a separate page in the document packet.
examples.zh: 我问文件包里的「签名确认公证」为什么在单独一页上。

words.enDefinition: a particular formal action carried out by a notary

examples.en: The heading described the notarial act as an acknowledgment of the signature on the statement.
examples.zh: 标题说，这项「公证行为」是确认声明上的签名。

examples.en: I asked how the notarial act was identified in the sample we had been given.
examples.zh: 我问发给我们的样本里，怎样辨认是哪项「公证行为」。

words.enDefinition: a document recording a particular act performed by a notary

examples.en: The notarial certificate identified the act performed and referred to the attached statement.
examples.zh: 「公证证明书」列明了所作的公证行为，并提到所附的声明。

examples.en: I kept the notarial certificate with the other papers so I could identify the right copy.
examples.zh: 我把「公证证明书」和其他文件放在一起，方便辨认是哪一份副本。

words.enDefinition: the official mark used by a notary on a document

examples.en: The notarial seal appeared on the separate page underneath the account of the meeting.
examples.zh: 「公证印章」出现在单独那一页上，位于会面记录下面。

examples.en: I asked whether the faint mark at the bottom was the notarial seal.
examples.zh: 我问底部那枚淡淡的标记是不是「公证印章」。

words.enDefinition: the part of a certificate identifying where the notarial act took place

examples.en: The county appeared in the notarial venue at the top of the American sample.
examples.zh: 美国样本顶端的「公证行为发生地栏」里写明了县名。

examples.en: I checked whether the city mentioned in the notes matched the notarial venue on the page.
examples.zh: 我核对了备注里提到的城市，看看是否和该页「公证行为发生地栏」一致。

collocations: a line for the notarial venue

words.enDefinition: the formal performance of a notarial service on a document

examples.en: I asked which page referred to notarization because the file included two separate statements.
examples.zh: 文件里有两份单独的声明，我问哪一页提到了「公证办理」。

examples.en: The receipt listed notarization as a separate item below the copying charge on my form.
examples.zh: 我的表格回执在复印费下单列了一项「公证办理」。

words.enDefinition: a copy whose correspondence with the original has been certified by a notary

examples.en: The officer asked whether the attached page was a notarized copy of my statement.
examples.zh: 工作人员问，附件那一页是不是声明的「公证副本」。

examples.en: I found the notary's note at the bottom of the notarized copy in my folder.
examples.zh: 我在文件夹里那份「经公证的副本」底部找到了公证人写的备注。

words.enDefinition: a translation accompanied by a notarial act, often concerning the translator's signature

examples.en: The packet contained a notarized translation with a separate certificate about the translator's signature.
examples.zh: 文件包里有一份「附有公证的译文」，另有关于译员签名的证明书。

examples.en: I asked which part of the notarized translation the notarial certificate referred to.
examples.zh: 我问公证证明书指的是「附有公证的译文」里的哪一部分。

collocations: request information about a notarized translation
a notarized translation of the statement

words.enDefinition: the official appointment authorizing someone to serve as a notary

examples.en: The American sample referred to the notary commission beside the name of the officer.
examples.zh: 美国的样本在官员姓名旁提到了「公证人任命」。

examples.en: I saw the notary commission mentioned on a letter issued by the state office.
examples.zh: 我在州政府办公室签发的信里看到了「公证人任命」的表述。

collocations: a record of a notary commission

words.enDefinition: a record kept by a notary of their notarial acts

examples.en: The example showed how a notary journal was different from the certificate attached to a document.
examples.zh: 样本展示了「公证业务日志」和文件随附的公证证明书有什么区别。

examples.en: I asked what the notary journal entry referred to in the state office's example.
examples.zh: 我问州政府办公室的样例里，「公证业务日志」那一条记录指的是什么。

collocations: an entry in a notary journal
record an act in the notary journal

words.enDefinition: a person authorized to carry out specified notarial acts

examples.en: I asked the notary public what the heading on the attached certificate meant.
examples.zh: 我问「公证人」，所附证明上的标题是什么意思。

examples.en: The notice listed a notary public as the person who signed the separate page.
examples.zh: 通知把一位「公证人」列为单独那一页的签署人。

collocations: a certificate from a notary public

words.enDefinition: A status indicating that a notice can be viewed online

examples.en: My account showed "Notice available online" above the link to the letter.
examples.zh: 我的账户在信件链接上方显示「可在线查看通知」。

examples.en: I saw "Notice available online" beside the entry for my latest decision.
examples.zh: 我在最新决定的条目旁看见了「可在线查看通知」。

collocations: a message saying notice available online
a status marked notice available online

words.enDefinition: The date shown on an official notice, generally indicating its issue

examples.en: The notice date was different from the day the envelope arrived.
examples.zh: 「通知日期」与收到信封的那一天不同。

examples.en: I circled the notice date on my printout before the meeting.
examples.zh: 见面前，我在打印件上圈出了「通知日期」。

words.enDefinition: An identifier assigned to a particular official notice by its issuer

examples.en: I used the notice number to find the matching letter online.
examples.zh: 我用「通知编号」在网上找到了对应的信件。

examples.en: The notice number appeared above the heading on the second page.
examples.zh: 「通知编号」印在第二页的标题上方。

words.enDefinition: A USCIS notice communicating action or information about a filing

examples.en: The US guide showed a blank Notice of Action for reference.
examples.zh: 美国指南展示了一份空白的「美国移民局办理通知」供参考。

examples.en: I checked which case was named on the Notice of Action.
examples.zh: 我核对了「美国移民局办理通知」上写的是哪个案件。

collocations: a Notice of Action from USCIS
details on a Notice of Action

words.enDefinition: A formal document notifying the relevant body that an appeal is made

examples.en: The clerk placed the notice of appeal beside the original decision letters.
examples.zh: 办事员把「申诉通知书」放在原决定函旁边。

examples.en: I checked which case number appeared on the notice of appeal.
examples.zh: 我核对了「申诉通知书」上写的是哪个案件编号。

collocations: a copy of a notice of appeal

words.enDefinition: An official notice confirming an authority approved a request

examples.en: The agency listed a separate reference on the notice of approval.
examples.zh: 政务机构在「批准通知书」上另列了一个编号。

examples.en: I saved the notice of approval beside the copy of my original paperwork.
examples.zh: 我把「批准通知书」和原申请材料的副本放在一起。

collocations: a copy of the notice of approval

words.enDefinition: A formal notification explaining the outcome of an official decision

examples.en: The notice of decision listed the decision and its date on the front.
examples.zh: 「决定通知书」正面写了决定及其日期。

examples.en: I compared the notice of decision with the outcome shown on the portal.
examples.zh: 我把「决定通知书」与政务平台上显示的结果核对了一下。

collocations: the date on a notice of decision

words.enDefinition: A formal notice that a party is ending its proceeding

examples.en: The clerk added the notice of discontinuance to the case record.
examples.zh: 办事员把「终止程序通知书」放进了案件记录。

examples.en: I checked which request was identified on the notice of discontinuance.
examples.zh: 我核对了「终止程序通知书」指的是哪项请求。

collocations: a copy of a notice of discontinuance

words.zhGloss: 车辆已出售或转让通知
words.enDefinition: in NSW, a notice that a vehicle has changed hands, given to the road authority
acceptedZhAnswers: 车辆已出售或转让通知

examples.en: The NSW portal recorded the notice of disposal in the seller's account.
examples.zh: 新南威尔士州门户网站在卖家账号里记录了「车辆已出售或转让通知」。

examples.en: I checked whether the notice of disposal showed the correct vehicle information.
examples.zh: 我核对了「车辆已出售或转让通知」上是否显示了正确的车辆信息。

collocations: a notice of disposal for a sold car

words.enDefinition: A USCIS notice stating that the agency proposes denying a request

examples.en: The US guide distinguishes a Notice of Intent to Deny from a final decision.
examples.zh: 美国指南区分了「美国移民局拟拒通知」和最终决定。

examples.en: The adviser pointed out the heading on the sample Notice of Intent to Deny.
examples.zh: 顾问指了指「美国移民局拟拒通知」样本上的标题。

collocations: issue a Notice of Intent to Deny
receive a Notice of Intent to Deny
a response to a Notice of Intent to Deny

words.enDefinition: An official notification that an authority refused a request

examples.en: The notice of refusal included a summary of the reasons below the heading.
examples.zh: 「拒绝通知书」在标题下方概括了拒绝的理由。

examples.en: I checked the file number shown on the notice of refusal before calling.
examples.zh: 打电话咨询前，我核对了「拒绝通知书」上显示的案卷编号。

collocations: reasons in a notice of refusal

words.enDefinition: A notice explaining rights to seek review of a decision

examples.en: The decision packet included a notice of review rights after the main letter.
examples.zh: 决定材料包在主函后附了一份「复核权告知书」。

examples.en: My adviser pointed out the notice of review rights at the end of the packet.
examples.zh: 顾问指给我看材料包末尾的「复核权告知书」。

collocations: receive a notice of review rights
include a notice of review rights
read a notice of review rights

words.enDefinition: Obtaining a copy of a notice already held in a system

examples.en: The portal had a separate option for notice retrieval after signing in.
examples.zh: 登录后，平台有一个单独的「调取通知」选项。

examples.en: I asked whether the office could help with notice retrieval for older files.
examples.zh: 我问办事处能否协助从旧档案中「调取通知」。

words.enDefinition: a formal UK notice about an unpaid parking penalty sent to the person believed responsible

examples.en: The notice to owner arrived at the address on the vehicle record.
examples.zh: 「未缴停车罚款通知书」寄到了车辆档案上的地址。

examples.en: The reference on the notice to owner matched the original penalty charge notice.
examples.zh: 「未缴停车罚款通知书」上的编号和最初的罚款通知单一致。

words.enDefinition: A formal notice asking someone for more information about a case

examples.en: I checked which request the notice to provide further information referred to in the file.
examples.zh: 我核对了案卷里的「要求补充信息的通知」指哪项申请。

examples.en: The notice to provide further information listed a separate contact address for questions.
examples.zh: 「要求补充信息的通知」另外列了一个咨询地址。

collocations: issue a notice to provide further information
read a notice to provide further information
details in a notice to provide further information

words.enDefinition: Words indicating that an authority has formally released a notice

examples.en: The online record said the notice was issued earlier that morning.
examples.zh: 在线记录上写着，那天早上「通知已经发出」。

examples.en: The clerk confirmed the notice was issued after my file was reviewed.
examples.zh: 办事员确认，案卷审核后「通知已经发出」。

collocations: the notice was issued by the agency
the notice was issued on the date shown

words.enDefinition: Words indicating that an authority withdrew a previous notice

examples.en: The portal showed notice withdrawn next to the outdated correspondence.
examples.zh: 政务平台在旧函件旁显示「通知已撤回」。

examples.en: I asked which notice the label notice withdrawn referred to.
examples.zh: 我问「通知已撤回」这个标签指哪份通知。

collocations: confirm that the notice was withdrawn

words.enDefinition: To formally inform everyone directly involved in a proceeding

examples.en: The clerk explained when the tribunal would notify the parties after the hearing.
examples.zh: 办事员解释了听证后审裁机构会在什么时候「通知各方当事人」。

examples.en: The office said it would notify the parties through its message centre.
examples.zh: 办事处说，会通过消息中心「通知各方当事人」。

collocations: notify the parties of the decision

words.enDefinition: a sign or label identifying the queue number currently being called for service

examples.en: The screen showed “now serving” above the number for the first window.
examples.zh: 屏幕在第一个窗口的号码上方显示「当前办理号码」。

examples.en: I compared my ticket with the number beside “now serving” on the board.
examples.zh: 我把号码票与牌子上「当前办理号码」旁显示的数字作了对照。

collocations: check the number under now serving

words.enDefinition: The entries specified by a visa field

examples.en: I checked the number of entries shown next to the expiry date on the visa.
examples.zh: 我看了签证到期日旁边标明的「允许入境次数」。

examples.en: The adviser pointed to the number of entries field on the sample visa label.
examples.zh: 顾问指给我看签证贴纸样本上的「允许入境次数」栏。

words.enDefinition: a statement reporting a vehicle's recorded mileage at a transfer or sale

examples.en: The dealer completed the odometer disclosure while I checked the vehicle's identification details.
examples.zh: 我核对车辆识别信息时，经销商填完了「里程读数披露」。

examples.en: I compared the odometer disclosure with the mileage printed on the sale page.
examples.zh: 我把「里程读数披露」和买卖文件印的里程作了对照。

words.zhGloss: 新西兰院校入学录取通知
words.enDefinition: A New Zealand educator's document offering a course place
acceptedZhAnswers: 新西兰院校入学录取通知

examples.en: My New Zealand university sent an offer of place with the course title and dates.
examples.zh: 新西兰大学发来了「入学录取通知」，里面有课程名称和时间。

examples.en: I checked whether the offer of place listed the same campus as my student record.
examples.zh: 我查看了「新西兰院校入学录取通知」和我的学生记录上写的是不是同一个校区。

collocations: an offer of place from a university

words.enDefinition: a list of offices with information such as their locations or contact details

examples.en: I used the office directory to find the branch closest to my residence.
examples.zh: 我用「办事机构名录」找到了离住处最近的办事点。

examples.en: The office directory listed a different address for the appointment centre.
examples.zh: 「办事机构名录」上列的预约中心是另一个地址。

collocations: look up a branch in the office directory

words.enDefinition: the standard steps an office follows to provide or manage its services

examples.en: The leaflet explained office procedures for visitors bringing documents for collection.
examples.zh: 宣传单解释了带材料来领件时适用的「办事处操作流程」。

examples.en: I read about office procedures while waiting for my number to appear.
examples.zh: 我一边等叫号，一边查看「办事处操作流程」。

words.enDefinition: the transfer of an office from one address to another

examples.en: I learned about the office relocation after checking the address in my confirmation.
examples.zh: 我核对确认单中的地址后，才知道「办公地点搬迁」了。

examples.en: The notice explained that the office relocation would begin during the university break.
examples.zh: 通知说，「办公地点搬迁」会在学校放假期间开始。

words.enDefinition: a label indicating that a part of a form is reserved for staff

examples.en: I skipped the shaded box because it was marked office use only.
examples.zh: 灰底框标有「仅供办事机构填写」，我就跳过了。

examples.en: The clerk wrote the approval date in the office use only section.
examples.zh: 办事员把批准日期写在「仅供办事机构填写」的部分。

collocations: a section marked office use only

words.enDefinition: Notes recording why an official reached a particular decision

examples.en: The Canadian guide described officer decision notes separately from the refusal letter.
examples.zh: 加拿大指南把「审理人员决定记录」与拒绝通知分开介绍。

examples.en: I compared the officer decision notes with the summary at the top.
examples.zh: 我把「审理人员决定记录」与顶部的概要作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Written communication sent by or to an authority

examples.en: The student office kept official correspondence in a separate section of my file.
examples.zh: 学生办公室在我的档案里单设一栏存放「官方往来函件」。

examples.en: I checked whether the envelope came from the address used for official correspondence.
examples.zh: 我查看了信封是不是从收发「官方往来函件」的地址寄出的。

words.enDefinition: printed information identifying an organization at the top of a letter

examples.en: The name at the top of the official letterhead matched the name in the assessment notes.
examples.zh: 「机构正式信头」顶端的名称和审核备注里的名称一致。

examples.en: I asked whether the statement on official letterhead was the same one attached to our file.
examples.zh: 我问用「机构正式信头」出具的声明是不是我们档案附的那份。

words.enDefinition: source wording that was left out of the translation

examples.en: The omitted text was a label printed beside the stamp on the original document.
examples.zh: 「漏译的文字」是原件印章旁边一个印出来的标签。

examples.en: I marked the omitted text after comparing the translation with my copy of the original.
examples.zh: 我把翻译件和原件副本对照后，标出了「漏译的文字」。

words.zhGloss: 每次预约办理一份申请
words.enDefinition: a condition limiting each booked session to a single application
acceptedZhAnswers: 每次预约办理一份申请

examples.en: The booking page displayed one application per appointment above the calendar.
examples.zh: 预约页面在日历上方注明「每次预约办理一份申请」。

examples.en: I read the note saying one application per appointment before booking for both of us.
examples.zh: 给我们两个人预约前，我看到了「每次预约办理一份申请」的说明。

collocations: limit bookings to one application per appointment
a notice stating one application per appointment

words.enDefinition: a form completed through a website or another online service

examples.en: I opened the online form after confirming which service I needed that morning.
examples.zh: 那天上午确认需要办理什么业务后，我打开了「在线表格」。

examples.en: The online form saved my answers when I moved to the next page.
examples.zh: 我进入下一页时，「在线表格」保存了答案。

words.enDefinition: a permit condition setting the hours during which an activity or business may operate

examples.en: The operating hours condition allowed the stall to open from nine on Saturdays.
examples.zh: 「营业时段限制条款」允许摊位每周六从九点开始营业。

examples.en: The owner requested a change to the operating hours condition for summer evenings.
examples.zh: 经营者申请调整夏季晚间的「营业时段限制条款」。

collocations: comply with an operating hours condition

words.enDefinition: extra comments that a person may choose to provide but does not have to

examples.en: The form gave space for optional remarks below the last requested date.
examples.zh: 表格在要求填写的最后一个日期下方，留了「选填备注」。

examples.en: I used optional remarks to explain why one line had no street number.
examples.zh: 我用「选填备注」解释了其中一行为什么没有门牌号。

words.enDefinition: Arguments or explanations given aloud to a decision-making body

examples.en: The notice mentioned oral submissions separately from the written papers.
examples.zh: 通知把「口头陈述意见」和书面文件分开提及。

examples.en: The clerk checked when the oral submissions had been recorded.
examples.zh: 办事员核对了「口头陈述意见」是什么时候记入记录的。

words.enDefinition: A passport issued for general travel outside official or diplomatic categories

examples.en: The form listed ordinary passport as one category of travel document.
examples.zh: 表格把「普通护照」列为旅行证件的一种。

examples.en: The sample ordinary passport belonged to the section on personal travel.
examples.zh: 「普通护照」样本放在个人旅行那一节。

words.enDefinition: a note saying the original can be viewed for comparison

examples.en: The copy was marked 'Original available for inspection,' with a separate note about the archive.
examples.zh: 副本上标着「原件可供查验」，另外还有一条关于档案的备注。

examples.en: I asked where the original available for inspection was kept after reading the office letter.
examples.zh: 读了办事处的信后，我问「可供查验的原件」存放在哪里。

collocations: a note saying original available for inspection
the words original available for inspection

words.enDefinition: The person or body that issued the initial decision

examples.en: The notice named the original decision-maker and the new reviewer separately.
examples.zh: 通知把「作出原决定的人」和新的复核人员分开列出。

examples.en: I asked which office the original decision-maker had worked in.
examples.zh: 我问「作出原决定的人」当时在哪个办事处工作。

collocations: the name of the original decision-maker

words.enDefinition: The actual identity document issued by an authority rather than a reproduction

examples.en: I asked whether the clerk meant the original identity document in that notice.
examples.zh: 我问办事员，告示说的是不是「身份证明文件原件」。

examples.en: The office returned my original identity document along with the paperwork.
examples.zh: 办事处把「身份证明文件原件」连同其他文件一起还给了我。

words.enDefinition: the version of the document in the language first used

examples.en: The file included an original-language version as well as the English text on another page.
examples.zh: 文件里有「原文语种版本」，另一页还有英文版。

examples.en: I referred to the original-language version to see how the town's name was written.
examples.zh: 我看了「原文语种版本」，确认小镇的名字怎么写。

collocations: compare the original-language version with the translation

words.enDefinition: a note indicating that the person writing it did not see the original

examples.en: The sheet was marked 'Original not seen,' and the explanation referred to a scan.
examples.zh: 那张纸标着「未见原件」，附带说明提到一份扫描件。

examples.en: I spotted 'Original not seen' above the signature on the scanned copy I received.
examples.zh: 我在收到的副本扫描件上看到，签名上面写着「未见原件」。

collocations: a note saying original not seen

words.enDefinition: a note indicating that the person recording it saw the original

examples.en: The clerk showed me the 'Original sighted' note at the bottom of the copy.
examples.zh: 工作人员指给我看副本底端的「已查验原件」备注。

examples.en: The words 'Original sighted' appeared beside the date on the sample we were reading.
examples.zh: 我们在读的样本上，日期旁写着「已查验原件」几个字。

words.enDefinition: A status showing an item is on its delivery round

examples.en: The envelope was marked “Out for delivery” when I left for my lecture.
examples.zh: 我出门上课时，信封的状态标为「正在派送」。

examples.en: I saw “Out for delivery” under the address details on the tracking page.
examples.zh: 我在追踪页面的地址详情下方看到了「正在派送」。

words.enDefinition: a person applying for a service handled by an office outside their usual service area

examples.en: The booking page asked whether I was an out-of-area applicant for that office.
examples.zh: 预约页面问，对这家办事处而言我是不是「非本辖区申请人」。

examples.en: I checked which address an out-of-area applicant should enter on the local form.
examples.zh: 我查了「非本辖区申请人」在当地表格上应该填写哪个地址。

words.enDefinition: Mail collected for sending from a location

examples.en: I asked which tray was for outgoing mail at the student services office.
examples.zh: 我问学生服务办公室哪个托盘放的是「待寄出的邮件」。

examples.en: The campus mailroom collects outgoing mail from the department's front desk each afternoon.
examples.zh: 校园邮件收发室每天下午从系里的前台收取「待寄出的邮件」。

words.enDefinition: A request made earlier that still needs a response

examples.en: I asked which outstanding request was mentioned in the status message.
examples.zh: 我问状态消息里提到的是哪项「尚未答复的请求」。

examples.en: The officer linked the outstanding request to an earlier notice on file.
examples.zh: 工作人员把「尚未答复的请求」关联到案卷中较早的通知。

words.enDefinition: An envelope lined with cushioning material

examples.en: I bought a padded envelope to protect the small card I was mailing.
examples.zh: 我买了一个「缓冲信封」，用来保护要寄的小卡片。

examples.en: The postal clerk handed me a padded envelope from the shelf behind her.
examples.zh: 邮局柜台工作人员从身后的架子上拿了一个「缓冲信封」给我。

collocations: send something in a padded envelope

words.enDefinition: the area at the bottom of a page containing information repeated across pages

examples.en: The page footer showed the form number beside a small revision date.
examples.zh: 「页脚」在一个小的修订日期旁标出了表格编号。

examples.en: I noticed that the page footer had disappeared from my printed copy.
examples.zh: 我发现打印件上的「页脚」不见了。

words.enDefinition: an apostille issued as a physical certificate

examples.en: The folder contained a paper apostille attached to the last page of the record.
examples.zh: 文件夹里有份「纸质附加证明书」，附在记录的最后一页。

examples.en: I asked whether the picture in the email was a scan of the paper apostille.
examples.zh: 我问邮件里的图片是不是「纸质附加证明书」的扫描件。

collocations: a scan of a paper apostille

words.enDefinition: Written communications sent on paper

examples.en: The portal asked whether I wanted paper correspondence from the office about this request.
examples.zh: 门户问我是否希望收到办事处就这件事寄来的「纸质往来函件」。

examples.en: I filed the paper correspondence beside the printout of the tracking record.
examples.zh: 我把「纸质往来函件」和追踪记录的打印件放在一起归档。

words.enDefinition: a form filled out or submitted on paper rather than entirely online

examples.en: I asked for a paper form because the online page would not load.
examples.zh: 网上页面一直打不开，我就要了一份「纸质表格」。

examples.en: The clerk showed me which part of the paper form needed my address.
examples.zh: 办事员指给我看，「纸质表格」哪一栏要填地址。

words.enDefinition: An official notification issued in printed form

examples.en: I compared the paper notice with the version in the portal.
examples.zh: 我把「纸质通知」与平台里的版本作了比较。

examples.en: The clerk asked which line appeared on my paper notice.
examples.zh: 办事员问我的「纸质通知」上是哪一行写着这项内容。

collocations: a copy of a paper notice

words.enDefinition: A document recording a parent's formal permission for a specified action

examples.en: The passport office showed which page included the parental consent form.
examples.zh: 护照办事处指出哪一页包含「家长同意书」。

examples.en: The clerk explained the title on the parental consent form in the packet.
examples.zh: 办事员解释了资料包里的「家长同意书」标题。

collocations: ask about a parental consent form

words.enDefinition: a booking that sets aside a particular facility or space within a public park

examples.en: Our park reservation confirmed that the covered picnic area was available from noon.
examples.zh: 我们的「公园场地预约」确认了有顶的野餐区从中午起可以使用。

examples.en: I brought the park reservation confirmation to show the ranger at the entrance.
examples.zh: 我带了「公园场地预约」确认单，准备在入口给公园管理员看。

words.enDefinition: a formal request for an authority to review or overturn a parking penalty

examples.en: He included the parking receipt as evidence in his parking appeal last week.
examples.zh: 他上周提交「停车处罚申诉」时附上了停车收据作为证据。

examples.en: The council acknowledged his parking appeal in an email with a reference number.
examples.zh: 市政部门发邮件确认收到了他的「停车处罚申诉」，并附上编号。

words.enDefinition: an official period during which a particular parking space is withdrawn from ordinary use

examples.en: The sign showed a parking bay suspension next to our student residence.
examples.zh: 学生公寓旁的标识显示要「临时停用停车位」。

examples.en: I checked which dates the parking bay suspension covered for the repair project.
examples.zh: 我查了这次维修项目的「临时停用停车位」会涉及哪些日期。

words.enDefinition: the extension or reissue of a parking permit for another period

examples.en: The portal displayed my parking permit renewal after I signed in again.
examples.zh: 我重新登录后，门户网站显示了「停车许可续期」。

examples.en: I asked where the parking permit renewal date appeared on the account.
examples.zh: 我问账号里哪里显示「停车许可续期」日期。

words.enDefinition: the area where a particular parking permit can be used

examples.en: The map showed the parking permit zone as a shaded area around the residence.
examples.zh: 地图用阴影标出了公寓周围的「停车许可适用区域」。

examples.en: I checked whether the new address lay inside the same parking permit zone.
examples.zh: 我查了新地址是否还在同一个「停车许可适用区域」。

collocations: park within a parking permit zone
a change to the parking permit zone

words.enDefinition: a notice explaining when and where ordinary parking is temporarily suspended

examples.en: I read the parking suspension notice before arranging delivery to our building.
examples.zh: 安排向我们楼配送之前，我读了「停车位停用通知」。

examples.en: The parking suspension notice listed the first and last affected spaces on the street.
examples.zh: 「停车位停用通知」列了这条街受影响范围的首尾车位。

words.enDefinition: a translation of only part of a source text

examples.en: The file name described it as a partial translation covering only the handwritten note.
examples.zh: 文件名说明这是「部分译文」，只译了手写备注。

examples.en: I used a partial translation to understand the heading before reading the whole document.
examples.zh: 我用「部分译文」弄懂标题，再读整份文件。

words.enDefinition: A formal request to an authority for a new passport

examples.en: The clerk asked which documents accompanied my passport application for review.
examples.zh: 办事员问我的「护照申请」随附了哪些文件供审核。

examples.en: The office listed my passport application separately from my earlier inquiry.
examples.zh: 办事处把「护照申请」和我先前的咨询分开列出。

words.enDefinition: A booklet form of passport containing identification and travel pages

examples.en: The US form listed a passport book separately from a passport card.
examples.zh: 美国表格把「护照本」和护照卡分开列出。

examples.en: The officer pointed out the travel pages in the passport book.
examples.zh: 工作人员指出了「护照本」中的旅行记录页。

collocations: a blank page in a passport book

words.enDefinition: A wallet-sized US travel and identity document with limited travel uses

examples.en: The US guide describes a passport card in a separate section.
examples.zh: 美国指南用单独一节介绍了「美国护照卡」。

examples.en: I compared the size of a passport card with the passport booklet.
examples.zh: 我把「美国护照卡」和护照本的大小作了比较。

collocations: compare a passport card with a passport book

words.enDefinition: Picking up a passport after it has been issued or held

examples.en: The office sent a separate message about passport collection on Friday.
examples.zh: 办事处星期五另外发了一条关于「领取护照」的消息。

examples.en: I asked which part of the letter dealt with passport collection.
examples.zh: 我问信里哪一部分讲「领取护照」。

words.enDefinition: Someone who countersigns a UK passport application to confirm identity

examples.en: The UK guide defined the role of a passport countersignatory separately.
examples.zh: 英国指南单独解释了「护照申请联署人」的职责。

examples.en: The blank UK form had a separate box for the passport countersignatory.
examples.zh: 英国的空白表格有个单独的「护照申请联署人」栏。

words.enDefinition: The passport page showing the holder's photograph and personal details

examples.en: I compared my name with the spelling on the passport data page.
examples.zh: 我把姓名的拼写与「护照资料页」上的拼写核对了一遍。

examples.en: The office showed which field appeared on the passport data page in its sample.
examples.zh: 办事处指给我看，样本的「护照资料页」上有哪个字段。

collocations: details on the passport data page

words.enDefinition: The act of sending an issued passport to its recipient

examples.en: I asked whether the email referred to passport dispatch or printing.
examples.zh: 我问邮件指的是「寄出护照」还是印制护照。

examples.en: The record showed the date for passport dispatch under delivery information.
examples.zh: 记录在投递信息下显示了「寄出护照」的日期。

words.enDefinition: An official note printed in a passport about its terms or details

examples.en: I asked where the passport endorsement appeared on the sample booklet.
examples.zh: 我问「护照附注」在护照本样本的哪个位置。

examples.en: The guide gave an example of a passport endorsement on another page.
examples.zh: 指南在另一页给出了「护照附注」的示例。

words.enDefinition: A person who formally confirms an applicant's identity for passport purposes

examples.en: The Canadian form referred to a passport guarantor in a separate section.
examples.zh: 加拿大表格在单独一节提到了「护照身份担保人」。

examples.en: I asked what the office meant by a passport guarantor in its guide.
examples.zh: 我问办事处指南里的「护照身份担保人」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: An interview held in connection with an application for a passport

examples.en: I asked what the letter meant by a passport interview for applicants.
examples.zh: 我问信里提到的申请人「护照申请面谈」是什么意思。

examples.en: The clerk showed where the guide described the passport interview and location.
examples.zh: 办事员指给我看，指南哪里介绍了「护照申请面谈」及其地点。

words.enDefinition: The office responsible for officially issuing a person's passport

examples.en: I asked which passport issuing office was named at the top of the letter.
examples.zh: 我问信件抬头列出的是哪个「护照签发办事处」。

examples.en: The passport issuing office confirmed which heading described the original document.
examples.zh: 「护照签发办事处」确认了哪个标题描述的是原证件。

collocations: records from the passport issuing office

words.enDefinition: An identifier assigned to a specific passport when it is issued

examples.en: The clerk showed me where the passport number field was on the sample.
examples.zh: 办事员给我看了样本上「护照号码」栏的位置。

examples.en: I checked whether the passport number field referred to my current passport.
examples.zh: 我核对了「护照号码」栏指的是不是现在的护照。

words.enDefinition: A UK code that links an application to a digital photograph

examples.en: The UK instructions explained what a passport photo code referred to.
examples.zh: 英国说明解释了「护照照片引用码」指什么。

examples.en: I asked which label showed the passport photo code on that notice.
examples.zh: 我问告示上用哪个标签标明了「护照照片引用码」。

words.enDefinition: Obtaining a new passport when an existing one is expiring

examples.en: The passport renewal section was on the reverse of the leaflet.
examples.zh: 说明单背面有一节讲「护照换发」。

examples.en: The office explained how it labeled passport renewal on the official form.
examples.zh: 办事处解释了正式表格怎样标注「护照换发」。

words.enDefinition: The process of obtaining a substitute for an unusable or missing passport

examples.en: I asked which section discussed passport replacement after a document was lost.
examples.zh: 我问哪一部分讲遗失证件后的「护照补发」。

examples.en: The consular office described passport replacement separately from routine renewal in its guide.
examples.zh: 领事办公室在指南中把「护照补发」与常规换发分开介绍。

words.enDefinition: The part of a passport designated for the holder's signature

examples.en: The officer opened the sample booklet at the passport signature page.
examples.zh: 工作人员把样本护照本翻到了「护照签名页」。

examples.en: The sample showed a marked box on the passport signature page for reference.
examples.zh: 样本在「护照签名页」上标出了一个方框供参考。

collocations: the signature on the passport signature page

words.enDefinition: The recorded standing of a passport, such as valid or cancelled

examples.en: I asked whether the note referred to my passport status or the application.
examples.zh: 我问备注指的是我的「护照证件状态」还是申请状态。

examples.en: The officer explained what the passport status field meant on that screen.
examples.zh: 工作人员解释了那个页面的「护照证件状态」栏是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: The time during which a passport is recognized as valid

examples.en: I asked which date marked the end of my passport validity.
examples.zh: 我问哪个日期是我的「护照有效期」截止日。

examples.en: The guide explained where to check passport validity on the document.
examples.zh: 指南说明了在证件上哪里查看「护照有效期」。

words.zhGloss: 新西兰衔接课程学生签证
words.enDefinition: A New Zealand visa for a sequence of courses
acceptedZhAnswers: 新西兰衔接课程学生签证

examples.en: The New Zealand guide listed Pathway Student Visa above its example of consecutive courses.
examples.zh: 新西兰指南在连续课程的例子上方列出了「衔接课程学生签证」。

examples.en: I asked where the Pathway Student Visa name appeared on the New Zealand notice.
examples.zh: 我问新西兰通知上的「衔接课程学生签证」名称出现在什么位置。

collocations: a Pathway Student Visa offer of place
details of a Pathway Student Visa

words.enDefinition: payment due only after an application or request has been approved

examples.en: The office clarified that this service involved payment after approval of the request.
examples.zh: 办事处澄清，这项服务是「获批后付款」。

examples.en: I asked where it described payment after approval in the printed instructions.
examples.zh: 我问纸质说明里哪里讲了「获批后付款」。

words.enDefinition: payment made when an application is submitted rather than at a later stage

examples.en: The instructions listed payment at time of application under the required documents section.
examples.zh: 说明在所需材料一节列出了「递交申请时付款」。

examples.en: I asked whether the notice meant payment at time of application or later.
examples.zh: 我问通知的意思是「递交申请时付款」，还是以后再付。

collocations: require payment at time of application
accept payment at time of application
a note on payment at time of application

words.enDefinition: a UK notice that formally requires payment of a civil penalty for a listed contravention

examples.en: The penalty charge notice listed the time the car entered the bus lane.
examples.zh: 「英国民事罚款通知单」写明了这辆车驶入公交专用道的时间。

examples.en: The council withdrew the penalty charge notice after reviewing the photographs she submitted.
examples.zh: 市政部门审查她提交的照片后，撤销了「英国民事罚款通知单」。

words.enDefinition: A status meaning that confirmation of certain information remains outstanding

examples.en: The portal marked one item pending verification after I sent the letter.
examples.zh: 我发出信件后，政务平台把一项内容标为「尚待核验」。

examples.en: The officer told me which part of the file was pending verification.
examples.zh: 工作人员告诉我，案卷的哪一部分「尚待核验」。

words.enDefinition: the dates or length of time a person lived at a specified address

examples.en: The form asked for the period at this address beneath the building number.
examples.zh: 表格在楼号下方要求填写「在该住址居住的时段」。

examples.en: I used the tenancy dates to calculate the period at this address.
examples.zh: 我用租期的起止日期来计算「在该住址居住的时段」。

collocations: enter the period at this address
confirm the period at this address
give the period at this address

words.enDefinition: a stable home address used even when someone is temporarily living elsewhere

examples.en: I entered my permanent address separately from the room where I stayed during term.
examples.zh: 我把「长期固定住址」与学期内临时居住的房间地址分开填写。

examples.en: The official letter asked whether my permanent address had changed since last year.
examples.zh: 公函询问我的「长期固定住址」自去年以来是否变更。

words.enDefinition: agreement allowing a named office or person to contact someone for a specific purpose

examples.en: The office asked for permission to contact the person listed as my reference.
examples.zh: 办事处征求「允许联系的授权」，要联系名单上的证明人。

examples.en: I read what permission to contact meant before ticking the separate box.
examples.zh: 我先读了「允许联系的授权」的含义，再勾选旁边单独的框。

words.enDefinition: Official authorization to enter a country

examples.en: The officer explained where my permission to enter was recorded in my documents.
examples.zh: 工作人员解释了我的「入境许可」记录在文件的什么位置。

examples.en: I asked how the letter described permission to enter for the invited students.
examples.zh: 我问那封信是怎么说明受邀学生的「入境许可」的。

words.enDefinition: an approved change to the details or conditions of an existing permit

examples.en: We requested a permit amendment when the market moved to another street.
examples.zh: 市集迁到另一条街后，我们申请办理「许可证变更」。

examples.en: The permit amendment changed the address and left the dates as originally approved.
examples.zh: 「许可证变更」修改了地址，日期仍沿用原审批结果。

words.enDefinition: a charge for processing an application for official permission

examples.en: The council's website listed a separate permit application fee for larger events.
examples.zh: 市政部门的网站为较大型活动列出了单独的「许可证申请费」。

examples.en: She saved the receipt after paying the permit application fee through the portal.
examples.zh: 她通过门户网站支付「许可证申请费」后保存了收据。

words.enDefinition: the requirements or restrictions that apply when someone uses a permit

examples.en: The permit conditions were printed on the reverse of the notice we received.
examples.zh: 我们收到的通知在背面印了「许可附带条件」。

examples.en: I asked which permit conditions applied to the temporary event at the park.
examples.zh: 我问公园里的临时活动适用哪些「许可附带条件」。

words.enDefinition: the act of putting a permit where it can be seen during a check

examples.en: The parking office illustrated proper permit display with a picture of the windscreen.
examples.zh: 停车管理部门用一张挡风玻璃的图片说明了正确的「许可证展示」方式。

examples.en: The market handbook explained the permit display rules for shared stalls in summer.
examples.zh: 市集手册说明了夏季共用摊位的「许可证展示」规定。

words.enDefinition: the point when a permit stops being valid under its terms

examples.en: The portal displayed a reminder about permit expiry beside the account summary.
examples.zh: 门户网站在账号摘要旁显示了「许可到期」提醒。

examples.en: I asked where the permit expiry date would appear on the printed document.
examples.zh: 我问打印证件上的「许可到期」日期会显示在哪里。

words.enDefinition: the person or organization to whom a particular permit is issued

examples.en: The letter addressed the permit holder by the name on the application.
examples.zh: 信以申请表上的姓名称呼「许可证持有人」。

examples.en: I checked which details the permit holder needed to confirm on the page.
examples.zh: 我确认了「许可证持有人」需要在页面核实哪些信息。

words.enDefinition: The identifier assigned to a particular permit

examples.en: I found the permit number in the upper corner of the residence document.
examples.zh: 我在居留文件的上角找到了「许可编号」。

examples.en: The officer read the permit number back to me before updating my record.
examples.zh: 工作人员在更新我的记录前，把「许可编号」复述给我核对。

words.enDefinition: an official list recording permits issued by an authority and their relevant details

examples.en: The council added the new event approval to its online permit register.
examples.zh: 市政部门把这项新获批的活动录入了网上「许可证登记册」。

examples.en: The permit register showed a different expiry date from the copy we received.
examples.zh: 「许可证登记册」显示的到期日与我们拿到的副本不一致。

words.enDefinition: Additional notes printed on a permit

examples.en: I read the permit remarks because they appeared below the main details.
examples.zh: 看到主要信息下面还有一栏，我就读了「许可证备注」。

examples.en: The adviser asked whether the permit remarks were readable in the scanned copy.
examples.zh: 顾问问扫描件上的「许可证备注」能不能看清。

collocations: permit remarks on the original document

words.enDefinition: the formal cancellation of an existing permit by the authority that issued it

examples.en: The board recorded the permit revocation in the minutes of its monthly meeting.
examples.zh: 委员会把「撤销许可证」的决定记入了月度会议纪要。

examples.en: The letter gave the effective date of the permit revocation and a case number.
examples.zh: 信中写明了「撤销许可证」的生效日期和案件编号。

words.enDefinition: the official reassignment of an existing permit to another holder

examples.en: The buyer asked whether a permit transfer was possible before taking over the stall.
examples.zh: 买方在接手摊位前询问是否可以办理「许可证转让」。

examples.en: The office completed the permit transfer once the new holder's name was confirmed.
examples.zh: 确认新持证人姓名后，办事处办完了「许可证转让」。

words.enDefinition: a vehicle permitted to carry out an activity or use a specified place

examples.en: The form asked for the plate number of the permitted vehicle in the request.
examples.zh: 表格要求填写本次申请中「许可对应的车辆」的车牌号。

examples.en: I checked whether the permitted vehicle was the one shown in the booking.
examples.zh: 我核实「许可对应的车辆」是不是预约里显示的那辆。

words.enDefinition: Formal delivery of a document directly to its intended recipient

examples.en: The clerk explained why the record listed personal service for that notice.
examples.zh: 办事员说明了为什么记录把那份通知标为「当面送达」。

examples.en: I asked where the guide defined personal service in this context.
examples.zh: 我问指南在哪里解释了此处的「当面送达」。

words.enDefinition: registration plates displaying a permitted number or letter combination chosen by the applicant

examples.en: The website showed examples of personalised plates without listing anyone's personal details.
examples.zh: 网站展示了「个性化车牌」的示例，没有列出任何人的个人资料。

examples.en: I asked where the agency recorded the new personalised plates after approving the request.
examples.zh: 我问申请获批后，该机构会把新的「个性化车牌」记录在哪里。

words.enDefinition: a driving licence in the form of a card bearing the holder's photograph

examples.en: The example showed a photocard licence with its holder's details partly covered.
examples.zh: 示例展示了一张「带照片的卡式驾照」，遮住了持证人的部分信息。

examples.en: The desk recorded the date printed on my photocard licence before returning it.
examples.zh: 柜台记录了「带照片的卡式驾照」上的日期，然后把它还给我。

words.enDefinition: The location where a person was born, as listed in records

examples.en: The form showed my place of birth in a separate box.
examples.zh: 表格在单独的方框中列出了我的「出生地」。

examples.en: I checked how my place of birth was spelled in the old record.
examples.zh: 我核对了旧档案中我的「出生地」是怎样拼写的。

words.enDefinition: the place where a document was formally signed

examples.en: The sample showed the place of execution beside the date at the bottom.
examples.zh: 样本底部的日期旁写着「文件签署地点」。

examples.en: I asked whether the place of execution referred to the town printed in the margin.
examples.zh: 我问「文件签署地点」是不是指页边印的那座镇。

words.enDefinition: The place recorded as where an official document was issued

examples.en: I asked whether the place of issue was written on this sample.
examples.zh: 我问样本上有没有写「签发地」。

examples.en: The officer showed where the place of issue appeared in the booklet.
examples.zh: 工作人员指出了本子上「签发地」的位置。

words.enDefinition: moving a registration plate number from one vehicle or registration to another under local rules

examples.en: The agency sent a confirmation after recording the plate transfer in its system.
examples.zh: 机构在系统里登记「车牌号码转移」后发来了确认。

examples.en: I asked which number the plate transfer notice referred to on the form.
examples.zh: 我问表上的「车牌号码转移」通知指的是哪个号码。

words.enDefinition: a polite instruction asking visitors to prepare their documents before being served

examples.en: The screen said please have your documents ready as the queue advanced.
examples.zh: 队伍往前走时，屏幕提示「请备好您的材料」。

examples.en: The notice began with please have your documents ready before listing each item.
examples.zh: 通知先写「请备好您的材料」，接着逐项列出要准备什么。

collocations: please have your documents ready at the counter
please have your documents ready when called
please have your documents ready for inspection

words.enDefinition: a notice asking someone to wait until a member of staff calls them

examples.en: The kiosk displayed “Please wait to be called” after I checked in.
examples.zh: 我签到后，自助终端显示「请等待叫号」。

examples.en: I spotted the sign saying “Please wait to be called” beside the service window.
examples.zh: 我在服务窗口旁看到了写着「请等待叫号」的牌子。

collocations: a sign reading “Please wait to be called”
the notice “Please wait to be called”

words.enDefinition: A numbered mailbox rented at a postal facility

examples.en: The agency printed its PO box on the reply envelope beside the office name.
examples.zh: 机构把「邮政信箱」印在回邮信封上，紧挨着办公室名称。

examples.en: I asked whether the PO box was the same one shown in the letter.
