examples.zh: 我问信上显示的是不是同一个「邮政信箱」。

collocations: collect mail from a PO box

words.enDefinition: An official place where people enter a country

examples.en: I saw the name of the port of entry beside the date on my record.
examples.zh: 我在记录的日期旁看到了「入境口岸」的名称。

examples.en: The adviser asked which airport appeared as the port of entry on the form.
examples.zh: 顾问问，表单上列哪个机场为「入境口岸」。

collocations: the port of entry listed on a record
arrive at a port of entry

words.expression: port of entry letter of introduction
words.lemma: port of entry letter of introduction
words.zhGloss: 加拿大入境口岸介绍信
words.enDefinition: A Canadian letter recording application approval for presentation at entry
acceptedZhAnswers: 加拿大入境口岸介绍信
acceptedEnVariants: port of entry letter of introduction

examples.en: The guide used port of entry letter of introduction as the heading above the example.
examples.zh: 指南把「加拿大入境口岸介绍信」作为例子上方的标题。

examples.en: I checked the name on my port of entry letter of introduction from Canada.
examples.zh: 我核对了加拿大发来的「入境口岸介绍信」上的姓名。

collocations: receive a port of entry letter of introduction
show a port of entry letter of introduction
a copy of the port of entry letter of introduction

words.enDefinition: To send a document through the postal service

examples.en: I went to the counter to post a document for the university registry.
examples.zh: 我到柜台去「邮寄一份文件」，收件方是大学注册办公室。

examples.en: Could I post a document from this branch and get a receipt for it?
examples.zh: 我能在这个网点「邮寄一份文件」并拿到凭条吗？

collocations: post a document to an office

words.enDefinition: Postage still owed on a mailed item

examples.en: The notice showed postage due next to a reference for the official letter.
examples.zh: 通知在官方信件的编号旁标明了「待补缴的邮资」。

examples.en: I asked what postage due meant on the card from the postal operator.
examples.zh: 我问邮政运营机构卡片上写的「待补缴的邮资」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: A label showing the postage for an item

examples.en: The postal clerk printed a postage label after checking the envelope at the counter.
examples.zh: 邮局柜台工作人员核对柜台上的信封后，打印了「邮资标签」。

examples.en: I checked that the postage label was readable before handing over the document.
examples.zh: 交出文件之前，我确认了「邮资标签」能看清。

collocations: a postage label on an envelope

words.enDefinition: An envelope with postage already covered

examples.en: The letter included a postage-paid envelope for sending the form back to the office.
examples.zh: 信里附了一个「邮资已付信封」，用于把表格寄回办公室。

examples.en: I asked which marking showed it was a postage-paid envelope in the sample.
examples.zh: 我问样本上的哪个标记说明它是「邮资已付信封」。

collocations: return a form in a postage-paid envelope

words.enDefinition: A stamp affixed to mail as evidence of postage

examples.en: I picked up a postage stamp for the letter to the local office.
examples.zh: 我为寄给地方办事处的信买了一张「邮票」。

examples.en: The postal clerk pointed to where the postage stamp went on the sample envelope.
examples.zh: 邮局柜台工作人员指出了样本信封上「邮票」所贴的位置。

collocations: put a postage stamp on a letter

words.enDefinition: A worker who assists customers at a post office

examples.en: The postal clerk checked whether my envelope would fit through the size guide.
examples.zh: 「邮局柜台工作人员」检查了我的信封能不能通过尺寸测量板。

examples.en: I asked the postal clerk which part of the receipt I should keep.
examples.zh: 我问「邮局柜台工作人员」该保留凭条的哪一部分。

collocations: a receipt from the postal clerk

words.enDefinition: a code used by a postal system to identify part of an address or delivery area

examples.en: I checked the postal code on the official letter before filling in the address.
examples.zh: 填地址前，我看了公函上的「邮政编码」。

examples.en: The form accepted my postal code after I entered the letters in capitals.
examples.zh: 我把字母用大写输入后，表格接受了我的「邮政编码」。

words.enDefinition: A counter where people arrange postal services

examples.en: I took the envelope to the postal counter after my morning lecture.
examples.zh: 上午的讲座结束后，我把信封拿到了「邮政服务柜台」。

examples.en: The sign above the postal counter listed services for sending letters and official documents.
examples.zh: 「邮政服务柜台」上方的牌子列出了寄信和寄送官方文件的服务。

collocations: hand something over at the postal counter

words.enDefinition: An organization that collects and delivers mail

examples.en: The government notice named the postal operator handling the return of official documents.
examples.zh: 政府通知写明了负责寄回官方文件的「邮政运营机构」。

examples.en: I checked which postal operator had issued the receipt for the mailed letter.
examples.zh: 我查看了寄信凭条是由哪家「邮政运营机构」出具的。

collocations: a receipt from a postal operator

words.enDefinition: A receipt issued for a postal transaction

examples.en: I folded the postal receipt and put it in my document folder.
examples.zh: 我把「邮寄凭条」折好，放进文件夹。

examples.en: The postal receipt showed which service I had used for the letter.
examples.zh: 「邮寄凭条」显示了我寄信时用的是哪种服务。

collocations: a reference on the postal receipt

words.enDefinition: A scale used to weigh items for mailing

examples.en: The clerk placed my document envelope on the postal scale near the counter.
examples.zh: 工作人员把我的文件信封放到柜台旁的「邮政秤」上。

examples.en: I saw the postal scale next to the display of different envelope sizes.
examples.zh: 我在不同尺寸信封的展示台旁看到了「邮政秤」。

collocations: put a letter on a postal scale

words.enDefinition: Using postal records to check an item's progress

examples.en: The sample showed how postal tracking listed the envelope's progress through the network.
examples.zh: 样本展示了「邮政追踪查询」如何列出信封在邮政网络中的进度。

examples.en: I asked which section of the official letter referred to postal tracking.
examples.zh: 我问官方来信哪一部分提到了「邮政追踪查询」。

words.enDefinition: A postal mark recording details such as mailing date

examples.en: I checked the date visible in the postmark on the official reply.
examples.zh: 我查看了官方回信「邮戳」上的日期。

examples.en: The postmark on my envelope was clearer on the original than in the photo.
examples.zh: 我的信封上，「邮戳」在原件上比照片里清楚。

words.enDefinition: The latest acceptable date on the postal marking

examples.en: I checked the postmark deadline after reading the section about sending the form.
examples.zh: 读过寄送表格的部分后，我查了「邮戳截止日期」。

examples.en: The notice listed a postmark deadline separately from the date the office would start reviewing.
examples.zh: 通知把「邮戳截止日期」和办事处开始审核的日期分开列出。

words.enDefinition: A phrase giving the latest acceptable postmark date

examples.en: The office notice used “Postmarked by” beside the date on the instruction sheet.
examples.zh: 办事处的通知在说明单的日期旁写着「邮戳日期不得晚于」。

examples.en: I asked what “postmarked by” meant in the letter about submitting paper copies.
examples.zh: 我问关于递交纸质副本的信中，「邮戳日期不得晚于」是什么意思。

collocations: an envelope postmarked by the stated date

words.enDefinition: the language a person chooses for receiving information or communicating

examples.en: The booking page asked for my preferred language before showing the appointment times.
examples.zh: 预约页面先问了我的「首选语言」，才显示预约时间。

examples.en: I checked whether the notice would be sent in my preferred language.
examples.zh: 我查了通知是否会用我的「首选语言」发送。

collocations: send a notice in the preferred language

words.enDefinition: to show the original version of a document to another person for inspection

examples.en: The clerk asked me to present an original so she could check the seal.
examples.zh: 办事员让我「出示原件」，好核对上面的印章。

examples.en: I checked whether I would need to present an original at the appointment.
examples.zh: 我确认了预约时要不要「出示原件」。

collocations: request that someone present an original
present an original at the counter
be ready to present an original

words.enDefinition: A passport a person held before their current travel document

examples.en: The form asked for the year shown on my previous passport.
examples.zh: 表格要求填写我的「上一本护照」上显示的年份。

examples.en: I checked whether the notice referred to my previous passport or the new one.
examples.zh: 我核对了通知说的是「上一本护照」还是新护照。

collocations: a number from a previous passport

words.enDefinition: the person listed first for receiving questions or updates about a matter

examples.en: The form asked who the primary contact would be for our joint request.
examples.zh: 表格问，这次联合申请的「主要联系人」是谁。

examples.en: I checked that the letter had gone to the primary contact on the form.
examples.zh: 我确认了信已经发给表格中的「主要联系人」。

words.enDefinition: the primary person whose application is considered and to whom related applicants may be linked

examples.en: The form asked the principal applicant to review the summary before submitting it.
examples.zh: 表格请「主申请人」先查看摘要，再提交。

examples.en: I checked who was listed as the principal applicant on the confirmation notice.
examples.zh: 我查了确认通知上登记谁为「主申请人」。

words.enDefinition: to write each letter separately using clearly formed capital letters

examples.en: The paper form told me to print in block capitals in the address boxes.
examples.zh: 纸质表格要求地址各框都「用大写印刷体书写」。

examples.en: I checked the example of how to print in block capitals before filling the page.
examples.zh: 填这一页前，我看了怎样「用大写印刷体书写」的示例。

collocations: be asked to print in block capitals

words.enDefinition: a version of a document produced on paper by a printer

examples.en: I brought a printed copy of the confirmation message to the desk.
examples.zh: 我带了一份确认消息的「打印副本」到柜台。

examples.en: The adviser checked the printed copy against the information on the screen.
examples.zh: 顾问把「打印副本」和屏幕上的信息作了对照。

words.enDefinition: a form arranged for clear printing, with a layout that fits printed pages

examples.en: The agency provided a printer-friendly form with space for handwritten notes.
examples.zh: 该机构提供了「便于打印的表格」，上面留有手写备注的空间。

examples.en: I switched to the printer-friendly form after the original cut off one column.
examples.zh: 原版有一栏被截断了，我换成了「便于打印的表格」。

words.enDefinition: an appointment given earlier access or preference according to the office's rules

examples.en: The adviser checked whether a priority appointment was available at the nearby branch.
examples.zh: 顾问核实附近办事点有没有可用的「优先办理预约」。

examples.en: I asked how the office recorded a priority appointment on its booking page.
examples.zh: 我问办事处怎样在预约页面上标记「优先办理预约」。

words.zhGloss: 美国邮政优先邮件服务
words.enDefinition: A USPS service for faster delivery of mail
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国邮政优先邮件服务

examples.en: The U.S. office used a Priority Mail envelope for the printed certificate.
examples.zh: 美国办事处用「邮政优先邮件服务」的信封寄送打印好的证书。

examples.en: I checked where the Priority Mail label appeared on the envelope from America.
examples.zh: 我查看了美国寄来的信封上「邮政优先邮件服务」标签的位置。

words.enDefinition: a document or part of a form explaining how personal information is handled

examples.en: I read the privacy statement before entering my address on the form.
examples.zh: 在表格上填地址前，我读了「隐私声明」。

examples.en: The link to the privacy statement appeared below the contact information section.
examples.zh: 「隐私声明」的链接在联系方式一节下方。

collocations: a link to the privacy statement

words.zhGloss: 加拿大程序公正通知函
words.enDefinition: An IRCC letter giving a person an opportunity to address concerns
acceptedZhAnswers: 加拿大程序公正通知函

examples.en: The Canadian adviser explained what a procedural fairness letter normally addresses.
examples.zh: 加拿大顾问解释了「加拿大程序公正通知函」通常涉及哪些事项。

examples.en: The sample procedural fairness letter separated the officer's concerns into two headings.
examples.zh: 「加拿大程序公正通知函」样本用两个标题分别列出工作人员的疑问。

collocations: respond to a procedural fairness letter
concerns in a procedural fairness letter

words.enDefinition: A message advising that work on a case is taking longer

examples.en: I saved the processing delay notice with the letter from the previous week.
examples.zh: 我把「办理延误通知」与上一周收到的信放在一起保存。

examples.en: The processing delay notice had a different subject line from earlier messages.
examples.zh: 「办理延误通知」的主题与早先的消息不同。

words.enDefinition: Words indicating that work on a previously paused file has restarted

examples.en: The file timeline said processing resumed after the new notice was received.
examples.zh: 案卷时间线显示，收到新通知后「已恢复办理」。

examples.en: I saw the words processing resumed under the heading for recent activity.
examples.zh: 我在最近动态标题下看到了「已恢复办理」。

collocations: a timeline entry saying processing resumed

words.enDefinition: An official card used to show someone's age and identity

examples.en: The Australian office showed an example of a proof of age card.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚办事处展示了一张「年龄证明卡」的样本。

examples.en: I asked what information appeared on the proof of age card I saw.
examples.zh: 我问我看到的那张「年龄证明卡」上有哪些信息。

collocations: apply for a proof of age card
show a proof of age card
a valid proof of age card

words.enDefinition: a document or message establishing that someone has booked a visit

examples.en: I printed my proof of appointment before travelling to the service centre.
examples.zh: 去公共服务中心之前，我把「预约凭证」打印出来了。

examples.en: The guard asked for proof of appointment before directing me to the waiting area.
examples.zh: 门卫要求我出示「预约凭证」，然后指引我到等候区。

words.enDefinition: Evidence that an item was delivered

examples.en: I asked where the proof of delivery appeared on the postal service's website.
examples.zh: 我问邮政服务网站上哪里显示「送达证明」。

examples.en: The registration office asked for proof of delivery for the documents in my case.
examples.zh: 登记办事处请我提供本次事务相关文件的「送达证明」。

words.enDefinition: a document or other evidence showing that a general requirement does not apply

examples.en: The officer asked for proof of exemption when checking the vehicle's emissions paperwork.
examples.zh: 工作人员在核对车辆排放材料时要求出示「豁免证明」。

examples.en: She uploaded her proof of exemption in the section marked supporting documents.
examples.zh: 她在标有补充材料的栏目里上传了「豁免证明」。

words.enDefinition: Evidence of a person's recorded immigration status

examples.en: The university asked which document I was using as proof of immigration status.
examples.zh: 学校问我用哪份文件作「移民身份证明」。

examples.en: I asked how the letter described proof of immigration status during registration.
examples.zh: 我问那封信在介绍登记时是如何说明「移民身份证明」的。

words.enDefinition: Documentation showing that someone's former name has officially changed

examples.en: The officer reviewed my proof of name change alongside the old certificate.
examples.zh: 工作人员把我的「姓名变更证明材料」和原证书放在一起审核。

examples.en: The letter listed proof of name change separately from a copy of my passport.
examples.zh: 信中把「姓名变更证明材料」与我的护照复印件分开列出。

collocations: a document serving as proof of name change

words.enDefinition: Evidence that an item was handed over for posting

examples.en: I kept the proof of posting for the letter I sent to the college.
examples.zh: 我留着寄给学院那封信的「交寄凭证」。

examples.en: The office asked whether I had proof of posting when the envelope was late.
examples.zh: 信封迟到时，办事处问我有没有「交寄凭证」。

words.enDefinition: evidence, such as a certificate or electronic record, that a vehicle is registered

examples.en: The office asked to see proof of registration for the vehicle in question.
examples.zh: 办事处要求查验相关车辆的「车辆登记凭证」。

examples.en: I saved a copy of the proof of registration in the car folder.
examples.zh: 我在车辆文件夹里保存了一份「车辆登记凭证」副本。

collocations: a document accepted as proof of registration

words.enDefinition: a document or record showing that an insurance policy covers a vehicle

examples.en: The rental office asked for proof of vehicle insurance before checking the reservation.
examples.zh: 租车办事处在核查预约之前，要求提供「车辆保险凭证」。

examples.en: I checked which page of the policy could be used as proof of vehicle insurance.
examples.zh: 我查看保单的哪一页可以作为「车辆保险凭证」。

collocations: provide written proof of vehicle insurance

words.enDefinition: A Canadian province's attestation for a study permit application

examples.en: The Canadian guide explained what provincial attestation letter meant next to the document sample.
examples.zh: 加拿大指南在文件样本旁解释了「省级确认函」是什么意思。

examples.en: I asked which office was named on the provincial attestation letter in the example.
examples.zh: 我问例子里的「加拿大省级确认函」写了哪个办公室。

collocations: a copy of a provincial attestation letter

words.zhGloss: 加拿大省级照片身份证
words.enDefinition: A photo identification card issued by a Canadian provincial authority
acceptedZhAnswers: 加拿大省级照片身份证

examples.en: The Canadian guide described provincial photo ID in a separate section.
examples.zh: 加拿大指南在单独一节介绍了「加拿大省级照片身份证」。

examples.en: I asked which part of my provincial photo ID showed the issue date.
examples.zh: 我问「加拿大省级照片身份证」的哪个位置写有签发日期。

collocations: a form of provincial photo ID
a valid provincial photo ID card

words.zhGloss: 荷兰长期入境临时许可
words.enDefinition: A Dutch entry visa associated with longer stays
acceptedZhAnswers: 荷兰长期入境临时许可

examples.en: The Dutch guide described the provisional residence permit beside an image of a passport sticker.
examples.zh: 荷兰指南在护照贴签图片旁介绍了「长期入境临时许可」。

examples.en: The adviser read the words provisional residence permit from the Dutch sample document.
examples.zh: 顾问读出了荷兰样本上的「长期入境临时许可」字样。

collocations: details on a provisional residence permit

words.enDefinition: a document treated as official under the relevant rules

examples.en: The sample described the register extract as a public document in its introductory note.
examples.zh: 样本在开头的备注里把登记节录件称为「公文书」。

examples.en: The term public document appeared beside a reference to a copy of a registry entry.
examples.zh: 「公文书」这个词出现在一条关于登记条目副本的说明旁。

collocations: the origin of a public document
a certificate linked to a public document

words.enDefinition: a form members of the public can use to ask an office for information

examples.en: I used the public enquiry form to ask which branch handled certificates.
examples.zh: 我用「公众咨询表」询问哪家办事点办理证书业务。

examples.en: The public enquiry form let me select the office before writing my question.
examples.zh: 「公众咨询表」让我先选办事处，再填写问题。

words.enDefinition: a telephone number the public can use to ask an office for information

examples.en: I called the public enquiry line after receiving a letter about the office move.
examples.zh: 收到办公地点搬迁的信后，我拨了「公众咨询热线」。

examples.en: The public enquiry line was listed at the bottom of the information page.
examples.zh: 「公众咨询热线」列在信息页面的底部。

collocations: a recorded message on the public enquiry line

words.enDefinition: insurance covering certain legal liabilities for injury or property damage suffered by members of the public

examples.en: The venue asked for a certificate of public liability insurance before the festival.
examples.zh: 场地方在节日前要求提供「公众责任保险」证明。

examples.en: The club's public liability insurance policy listed the insured activities in an appendix.
examples.zh: 俱乐部的「公众责任保险」保单在附录中列出了受保活动。

words.enDefinition: the time during which an official notice must remain available to the public

examples.en: The public notice period for the proposed street closure ended on Friday.
examples.zh: 这项拟议道路封闭安排的「公示期」于周五结束。

examples.en: Residents could read the application online throughout the public notice period that spring.
examples.zh: 那年春天，居民在整个「公示期」都可以在线查看申请。

words.enDefinition: a place where members of the public can access administrative services

examples.en: The public service centre handles several kinds of applications in one building.
examples.zh: 「公共服务中心」在同一栋楼里办理好几类申请。

examples.en: I checked which buses stopped near the public service centre before leaving.
examples.zh: 动身前，我查了哪些公交车停靠「公共服务中心」附近。

collocations: an appointment at the public service centre

words.enDefinition: the reason why an application is being made

examples.en: The first section asked me to state the purpose of application in one sentence.
examples.zh: 第一部分要求用一句话写明「申请目的」。

examples.en: I asked which code matched the purpose of application described on my form.
examples.zh: 我问哪个代码和我表格里写的「申请目的」相符。

words.zhGloss: 加拿大魁北克接收证书
words.enDefinition: A Québec document recording temporary selection including for studies
acceptedZhAnswers: 加拿大魁北克接收证书

examples.en: I asked which part of the Québec Acceptance Certificate referred to the study program.
examples.zh: 我问「加拿大魁北克接收证书」的哪一部分提到了学习项目。

examples.en: The adviser showed me the title Québec Acceptance Certificate in the provincial guide.
examples.zh: 顾问指给我看省级指南里「加拿大魁北克接收证书」这个标题。

collocations: a Québec Acceptance Certificate for studies
a copy of a Québec Acceptance Certificate
details in a Québec Acceptance Certificate

words.enDefinition: a screen showing which numbers are being called and where to go

examples.en: The queue display listed two window numbers for visitors collecting certificates.
examples.zh: 「排队叫号屏」为来领取证书的访客列了两个窗口号码。

examples.en: I watched the queue display while checking my documents in the waiting area.
examples.zh: 我在等候区检查文件时看着「排队叫号屏」。

words.enDefinition: the number assigned to someone showing their place in a service queue

examples.en: I checked my queue number against the digits on the display near reception.
examples.zh: 我把自己的「排队号码」与接待处附近屏幕上的数字作了对照。

examples.en: The clerk called my queue number just as I finished the last page.
examples.zh: 我刚填完最后一页，办事员就叫到了我的「排队号码」。

words.enDefinition: a small printed slip showing a person's number or position in a queue

examples.en: I took a queue ticket near the door and waited for my number.
examples.zh: 我在门边取了张「排队号票」，等着叫号。

examples.en: The clerk kept my queue ticket after checking the appointment confirmation.
examples.zh: 办事员查看预约确认后，收走了我的「排队号票」。

words.enDefinition: a control allowing one option to be selected within a group of choices

examples.en: I selected the radio button beside my preferred way to receive the notice.
examples.zh: 我点了自己偏好的通知接收方式旁的「单选按钮」。

examples.en: The radio button changed when I chose a different answer in that group.
examples.zh: 我在那组里改选另一个答案时，「单选按钮」的选中状态变了。

words.enDefinition: to type or provide information a second time, for example after an error

examples.en: The page asked me to re-enter the information because the first entry was incomplete.
examples.zh: 页面要求我「重新输入信息」，因为第一次填得不完整。

examples.en: I had to re-enter the information after refreshing the page by mistake.
examples.zh: 我不小心刷新了页面，不得不「重新输入信息」。

collocations: ask users to re-enter the information

words.enDefinition: A document used as evidence of re-entry permission

examples.en: I saw re-entry permit printed above the reference number on the sample document.
examples.zh: 我在样本文件的编号上方看到了「再次入境许可」。

examples.en: The adviser asked whether I meant a re-entry permit or the residence card.
examples.zh: 顾问问，我说的是「再次入境许可」，还是居留卡。

words.enDefinition: To formally record a birth again with updated legal details

examples.en: I asked what it meant to re-register a birth on the office website.
examples.zh: 我问办事处网站说的「重新登记出生」是什么意思。

examples.en: The leaflet explains why a family might need to re-register a birth.
examples.zh: 说明单介绍了一个家庭为什么可能需要「重新登记出生」。

collocations: ask how to re-register a birth
a request to re-register a birth

words.enDefinition: An explanation of why an item was sent back

examples.en: The reason for return appeared on a sticker above the original postage.
examples.zh: 「退件原因」写在原邮资标记上方的贴纸上。

examples.en: I asked which section of the tracking page stated the reason for return.
examples.zh: 我问追踪页面的哪一部分写明了「退件原因」。

words.enDefinition: A notice confirming receipt of a filing by a government office

examples.en: The US office described the receipt notice separately from a decision.
examples.zh: 美国办事处把「申请收件通知」与决定分开介绍。

examples.en: I found the receipt notice in a folder with the original form.
examples.zh: 我在装有原始表格的文件夹中找到了「申请收件通知」。

collocations: the date on a receipt notice

words.enDefinition: The name of the person receiving the mail

examples.en: I checked the recipient name against the office's letter before sealing the envelope.
examples.zh: 封信前，我对照办公室的来信核对了「收件人姓名」。

examples.en: The postal receipt printed the recipient name next to the destination information.
examples.zh: 邮寄凭条在目的地信息旁边印出了「收件人姓名」。

words.enDefinition: A status saying the intended recipient was unavailable

examples.en: The update showed “Recipient unavailable” after the carrier tried to deliver the envelope.
examples.zh: 邮递员尝试送信封后，更新显示「暂时联系不到收件人」。

examples.en: I asked what “Recipient unavailable” meant on the record for the document.
examples.zh: 我问文件的记录上「暂时联系不到收件人」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: A formal request asking an authority to examine its decision again

examples.en: The agency acknowledged my reconsideration request with a separate letter.
examples.zh: 政务机构另发了一封信，确认收到了我的「重新考虑请求」。

examples.en: I checked which decision the reconsideration request referred to in the record.
examples.zh: 我核对了记录中的「重新考虑请求」涉及哪项决定。

words.enDefinition: An official change to an entry in an existing record

examples.en: I asked which document described the record amendment in the register.
examples.zh: 我问哪份文件说明了登记册中的「档案修订」。

examples.en: The office confirmed the date of the record amendment by letter.
examples.zh: 办事处通过信件确认了「档案修订」的日期。

words.enDefinition: An official document showing selected information from a register

examples.en: I checked which date the record extract listed for the birth.
examples.zh: 我核对了「登记记录摘录」所列的出生日期。

examples.en: The registrar asked which records my record extract should cover.
examples.zh: 登记员问我的「登记记录摘录」应涵盖哪些记录。

words.enDefinition: An official account of the steps and events in a case

examples.en: The clerk found the hearing entry in the record of proceedings.
examples.zh: 办事员在「审理程序记录」中找到了听证的条目。

examples.en: I compared my saved notice with the record of proceedings on file.
examples.zh: 我把自己保存的通知与归档的「审理程序记录」作了核对。

collocations: an entry in the record of proceedings

words.enDefinition: Information formally entered into an official document or register

examples.en: I noticed the recorded details differed between the two birth records.
examples.zh: 我发现两份出生记录的「登记在册的信息」不同。

examples.en: The clerk showed me where to find the recorded details on file.
examples.zh: 办事员指给我看在哪里可以找到「登记在册的信息」。

words.enDefinition: an employee who receives, organizes or retrieves official records

examples.en: The records clerk found an older copy of the document in the file.
examples.zh: 「档案办事员」在档案里找到了一份较早的文件副本。

examples.en: I asked the records clerk whether the certificate could be collected in person.
examples.zh: 我问「档案办事员」证书能不能到现场领取。

collocations: a records clerk at the office

words.enDefinition: A notice confirming that another delivery attempt is scheduled

examples.en: The redelivery confirmation listed the new date beside the reference for my letter.
examples.zh: 「再次投递确认通知」在信件编号旁列出了新的日期。

examples.en: I saved the redelivery confirmation before closing the browser on my phone.
examples.zh: 关闭手机浏览器前，我保存了「再次投递确认通知」。

words.enDefinition: The scheduled day for another delivery attempt

examples.en: I checked the redelivery date against my lecture timetable before confirming it.
examples.zh: 确认「再次投递日期」前，我对照了自己的课表。

examples.en: The redelivery date was shown above the reference on the new confirmation page.
examples.zh: 新的确认页面在编号上方显示了「再次投递日期」。

words.enDefinition: Another attempt to deliver an item

examples.en: The card gave a contact number for redelivery but also mentioned collection.
examples.zh: 通知卡给了「再次投递」的联系电话，也提到了自取。

examples.en: I asked about redelivery after finding the notice beneath the front door.
examples.zh: 在正门下面发现通知后，我问了「再次投递」的事。

words.enDefinition: a copy reproduced at smaller dimensions than the original

examples.en: The reduced-size copy fit on one sheet, but I couldn't read the stamp clearly.
examples.zh: 「缩小复印件」能放在一张纸上，但我看不清印章。

examples.en: I could see that it was a reduced-size copy by comparing the page margins.
examples.zh: 我对照了页边距，看出那是一份「缩小复印件」。

collocations: a reduced-size copy of the document

words.enDefinition: a service point that sends people to the office or specialist they need

examples.en: The reception staff sent me to the referral desk to find the right department.
examples.zh: 接待人员让我去「转介服务台」找对口部门。

examples.en: I asked the referral desk who could explain the letter I received.
examples.zh: 我到「转介服务台」询问，谁能解释我收到的那封信。

words.enDefinition: Declined after considering the substantive facts and basis of the case

examples.en: The summary said the claim was refused on the merits after examination.
examples.zh: 概要写着，这项请求已经「经实质审查后拒绝」。

examples.en: I checked how the decision used the phrase refused on the merits.
examples.zh: 我核对了决定书怎样使用「经实质审查后拒绝」这个说法。

collocations: a claim refused on the merits
an application refused on the merits
notice that a claim was refused on the merits

words.enDefinition: an office responsible for work in a particular region rather than the entire organization

examples.en: My enquiry was forwarded to the regional office after staff checked my address.
examples.zh: 工作人员核对地址后，把我的咨询转给了「地区办事处」。

examples.en: The appointment letter named a regional office on the other side of town.
examples.zh: 预约信上写明了城里另一头一家「地区办事处」。

words.enDefinition: An individual record written into an official register

examples.en: The clerk showed which register entry matched the certificate date.
examples.zh: 办事员指给我看，哪个「登记簿条目」和证书日期一致。

examples.en: I asked which details were included in the original register entry.
examples.zh: 我问原始的「登记簿条目」包含哪些信息。

collocations: a copy of a register entry

words.enDefinition: in the UK, the person recorded as keeping and being responsible for a vehicle

examples.en: The UK form asked where the registered keeper's correspondence should be sent.
examples.zh: 英国表格问「车辆登记持有人」的信件应寄到哪里。

examples.en: I checked who was named as the registered keeper in the vehicle log book.
examples.zh: 我查看了车辆登记簿上谁被列为「车辆登记持有人」。

words.enDefinition: A postal service that records an item and gives it extra security in transit

examples.en: I sent the only original by registered mail to keep a record of its journey.
examples.zh: 我把唯一的原件用「挂号邮件」寄出，以便留存寄送记录。

examples.en: The clerk kept the registered mail in a separate tray behind the counter.
examples.zh: 办事员把「挂号邮件」单独放在柜台后面的一个托盘里。

collocations: send a letter by registered mail

words.enDefinition: the person or entity recorded as owning a vehicle in the relevant registration system

examples.en: The form asked for the registered owner before requesting the vehicle's current address.
examples.zh: 表格先询问「登记车主」，然后要求填车辆目前所在的地址。

examples.en: I checked the document for the name of the registered owner before arranging collection.
examples.zh: 安排取车前，我查了文件上的「登记车主」姓名。

words.enDefinition: An official responsible for recording births and deaths in a register

examples.en: The letter was signed by the registrar of births and deaths for that district.
examples.zh: 这封信由该地区的「出生死亡登记员」签署。

examples.en: I asked which registrar of births and deaths had signed the older entry in our file.
examples.zh: 我问档案中的旧记录由哪位「出生死亡登记员」签署。

collocations: contact the registrar of births and deaths
ask the registrar of births and deaths
a notice from the registrar of births and deaths

words.enDefinition: a card or small document containing a vehicle's current registration details

examples.en: The dealer handed me a registration card with the other papers for the car.
examples.zh: 经销商把「车辆登记卡」和汽车的其他文件一起交给了我。

examples.en: I compared the registration card with the scanned copy on my phone.
examples.zh: 我把「车辆登记卡」与手机上的扫描件作了对照。

words.enDefinition: The geographic area assigned to an office for registering civil events

examples.en: The UK example showed the registration district beneath the date.
examples.zh: 英国样本把「登记辖区」列在日期下面。

examples.en: I checked which registration district the office had listed for that birth.
examples.zh: 我核对了办事处给那次出生登记写的是哪个「登记辖区」。

collocations: the name of a registration district

words.enDefinition: the date on which the current vehicle registration ceases to be valid

examples.en: I checked the registration expiration date shown in the vehicle's online record.
examples.zh: 我查看了车辆网上记录中显示的「车辆登记到期日」。

examples.en: The clerk pointed to the registration expiration date on the bottom line.
examples.zh: 办事员指给我看，最下面一行是「车辆登记到期日」。

words.enDefinition: An identifier assigned to an official registration or recorded entry

examples.en: The clerk showed the registration number separately from the certificate number.
examples.zh: 办事员指出了与证书编号分开列出的「登记编号」。

examples.en: I checked where the registration number appeared on the birth record.
examples.zh: 我查看了出生登记记录上的「登记编号」写在哪里。

words.enDefinition: the official extension of the period for which a vehicle is registered

examples.en: I saved the registration renewal confirmation with the earlier vehicle documents.
examples.zh: 我把「车辆登记续期」确认和原来的车辆文件放在一起。

examples.en: The website placed registration renewal under a separate menu for existing vehicles.
examples.zh: 网站把「车辆登记续期」放在现有车辆的独立菜单下。

words.enDefinition: a message telling a keeper or owner about renewal of the vehicle's registration

examples.en: The registration renewal notice arrived in an envelope from the licensing office.
examples.zh: 「车辆登记续期通知」装在许可业务办公室寄来的信封里。

examples.en: I checked the date on my registration renewal notice after moving to campus.
examples.zh: 搬到学校后，我核对了「车辆登记续期通知」上的日期。

words.enDefinition: a sticker indicating a vehicle's registration or its validity period in some systems

examples.en: The US clerk placed the registration sticker next to the other documents.
examples.zh: 美国的办事员把「车辆登记贴纸」放在其他文件旁。

examples.en: I checked the registration sticker on the plate when reading the example.
examples.zh: 看示例时，我查看了车牌上的「车辆登记贴纸」。

words.expression: Registry of Births, Deaths and Marriages
words.lemma: registry of births, deaths and marriages
words.enDefinition: An Australian state office responsible for recording civil life events
acceptedEnVariants: Registry of Births, Deaths and Marriages

examples.en: The Victorian letter named the Registry of Births, Deaths and Marriages at the top.
examples.zh: 维多利亚州的信在抬头列了「出生死亡婚姻登记处」。

examples.en: I asked which records the Registry of Births, Deaths and Marriages kept for that area.
examples.zh: 我问当地的「出生死亡婚姻登记处」保管哪些记录。

collocations: contact the Registry of Births, Deaths and Marriages
records from the Registry of Births, Deaths and Marriages
visit the Registry of Births, Deaths and Marriages

words.enDefinition: Restoration of U.S. F-1 status through a formal process

examples.en: The glossary defined reinstatement to F-1 status in a separate section about U.S. records.
examples.zh: 术语表在介绍美国记录的独立章节里定义了「恢复F-1学生身份」。

examples.en: I asked my U.S. adviser what reinstatement to F-1 status meant in this letter.
examples.zh: 我问美国的顾问，信里的「恢复F-1学生身份」是什么意思。

collocations: a request for reinstatement to F-1 status
guidance on reinstatement to F-1 status
a decision on reinstatement to F-1 status

words.enDefinition: Declined at intake because items needed for processing were missing

examples.en: The office marked the file rejected as incomplete before it reached the reviewer.
examples.zh: 案卷进入审理前，办事处已将其标为「因材料不全被退回」。

examples.en: I asked which package the portal showed as rejected as incomplete.
examples.zh: 我问平台显示哪一份材料包「因材料不全被退回」。

collocations: a notice saying rejected as incomplete

words.enDefinition: a label asking what connection another person has to the person applying

examples.en: I filled in relationship to applicant after writing the other person's name.
examples.zh: 我写好对方姓名以后，填了「与申请人的关系」。

examples.en: The form showed relationship to applicant beside the box for the contact's number.
examples.zh: 表格把「与申请人的关系」放在联系人的号码框旁。

collocations: the section marked relationship to applicant

words.enDefinition: to make a group of times newly available for booking

examples.en: The office will release appointment slots for next month on Friday afternoon.
examples.zh: 办事处将于周五下午「放出」下个月的可预约时段。

examples.en: They usually release appointment slots in batches, so I checked again after class.
examples.zh: 他们通常分批「放出可预约时段」，于是下课后我又查了一次。

collocations: release appointment slots for next week

words.enDefinition: To send a case back to the responsible body for reconsideration

examples.en: The Australian guide used remit the matter for one type of outcome.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚指南用「把案件发回重审」描述一种结果。

examples.en: The tribunal decided to remit the matter to the original agency.
examples.zh: 审裁机构决定「把案件发回原政务机构重审」。

collocations: an order to remit the matter

words.enDefinition: notarization carried out at a distance using live audio and video

examples.en: The Florida guide used remote online notarization to describe the service conducted by video.
examples.zh: 佛罗里达的指南用「远程在线公证」来描述通过视频进行的服务。

examples.en: I saw remote online notarization listed separately from appointments at the provider's office.
examples.zh: 我看到「远程在线公证」和到服务机构办公室现场办理的预约分开列出。

collocations: a record of remote online notarization
an explanation of remote online notarization

words.enDefinition: To obtain a residence permit for another period

examples.en: I need to renew a residence permit that expires just before my exams.
examples.zh: 我得「续办一份居留许可」，它刚好在考试前到期。

examples.en: Two students asked where they could renew a residence permit after changing universities.
examples.zh: 两名学生问，转学后可以在哪里「续办居留许可」。

collocations: need to renew a residence permit
apply to renew a residence permit
documents needed to renew a residence permit

words.enDefinition: Opened again after closing so the agency can examine it

examples.en: The agency said our file was reopened for review after the correction.
examples.zh: 政务机构说，更正之后我们的案卷「已重新开启审查」。

examples.en: The earlier case was marked reopened for review on my dashboard.
examples.zh: 案件总览页面中，较早的案件被标为「已重新开启审查」。

collocations: notice that a file was reopened for review

words.enDefinition: A new identity card issued in place of an earlier card

examples.en: I asked where the office kept the replacement ID card for collection.
examples.zh: 我问办事处把待领的「补发的身份证件」放在哪里。

examples.en: The notice showed when my replacement ID card was ready for pickup.
examples.zh: 告示上写明我的「补发的身份证件」什么时候可以领取。

words.enDefinition: a new driving licence issued in place of one that is lost, damaged or otherwise needs replacing

examples.en: The email confirmed that my replacement licence had been sent to the correct address.
examples.zh: 邮件确认，我「补发的驾驶执照」已经寄往正确的地址。

examples.en: I asked whether I could collect the replacement licence at the local office.
examples.zh: 我问能不能去本地办事处领「补发的驾驶执照」。

words.enDefinition: new registration plates issued to replace missing, damaged or unusable plates

examples.en: The agency sent a message confirming that the replacement number plates were ready.
examples.zh: 该机构发消息确认，「补换车牌」已经备好。

examples.en: I checked the collection address for the replacement number plates before leaving.
examples.zh: 出发前，我查了「补换车牌」的领取地址。

words.enDefinition: A new document issued in place of an earlier permit

examples.en: The replacement permit arrived separately from the letter confirming my recorded details.
examples.zh: 「补发的许可证」和用于确认我登记信息的信是分开寄来的。

examples.en: I compared the replacement permit with the scan I had saved before.
examples.zh: 我把「补发的许可证」和之前保存的扫描件作了对比。

words.enDefinition: To send a written response instead of giving it orally

examples.en: The clerk explained whom to contact if I wanted to reply in writing.
examples.zh: 办事员解释了如果我想「以书面形式答复」，应联系谁。

examples.en: The agency invited us to reply in writing with comments on the summary.
examples.zh: 政务机构邀请我们就概要「以书面形式答复」，提出意见。

collocations: ask someone to reply in writing
be told to reply in writing

words.enDefinition: To send a response using the agency's online system

examples.en: The notice said I could reply through the portal if I preferred writing.
examples.zh: 通知上说，我更愿意用文字答复的话，可以「通过政务平台回复」。

examples.en: I checked whether we could reply through the portal with a short question.
examples.zh: 我核对了能不能「通过政务平台回复」，简短问个问题。

collocations: ask whether to reply through the portal
an option to reply through the portal
be able to reply through the portal

words.enDefinition: To inform the relevant authority that your passport is missing

examples.en: I asked which office I should contact to report a lost passport abroad.
examples.zh: 我问在国外「报告护照遗失」要联系哪个办公室。

examples.en: The website listed a section for people who need to report a lost passport.
examples.zh: 网站列了一个供需要「报告护照遗失」的人查阅的栏目。

collocations: ask how to report a lost passport
a form to report a lost passport
contact the office to report a lost passport

words.enDefinition: information identifying and providing a way to contact a designated representative

examples.en: I completed representative details only after receiving the other person's permission to act.
examples.zh: 在对方同意担任代理后，我才填写「代理人资料」。

examples.en: The form placed representative details after the section about the applicant's address.
examples.zh: 表格把「代理人资料」放在申请人地址一节的后面。

words.enDefinition: to ask to speak with a person who oversees the staff or service

examples.en: I chose to request a supervisor after receiving two different answers at the counter.
examples.zh: 在柜台听到两种不同答复后，我选择「要求与主管交谈」。

examples.en: The clerk said I could request a supervisor if I needed further clarification.
examples.zh: 办事员说，如果需要更进一步的解释，可以「要求与主管交谈」。

collocations: ask how to request a supervisor
request a supervisor at a service desk

words.enDefinition: To ask to receive an item through the mail

examples.en: The form let me request delivery by post rather than collect the certificate in person.
examples.zh: 表格让我可以「要求邮寄送达」证书，不用亲自去取。

examples.en: Can I request delivery by post after the office has printed the document?
examples.zh: 办事处把文件打印出来以后，我还可以「要求邮寄送达」吗？

collocations: choose to request delivery by post
be able to request delivery by post
a form to request delivery by post

words.enDefinition: A formal request to explain an unclear statement or detail

examples.en: The agency sent a request for clarification about one sentence in my statement.
examples.zh: 政务机构就我声明中的一句话发来了「澄清说明请求」。

examples.en: I read the request for clarification before comparing the two records again.
examples.zh: 我先读了「澄清说明请求」，然后再次比较两份记录。

words.enDefinition: A USCIS notice asking for more evidence while a case is pending

examples.en: The US guide showed where a Request for Evidence listed the items needed.
examples.zh: 美国指南指出了「美国移民局补证通知」在哪一栏列出所需材料。

examples.en: My adviser explained the heading on the Request for Evidence in the sample.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了样本中「美国移民局补证通知」的标题。

collocations: respond to a Request for Evidence
a Request for Evidence from USCIS

words.enDefinition: to ask for someone to interpret spoken communication during a service or meeting

examples.en: I asked where to request interpreter assistance when booking an in-person appointment.
examples.zh: 我预约现场办理时，问可以在哪里「申请口译协助」。

examples.en: The letter explains how visitors can request interpreter assistance for their scheduled visit.
examples.zh: 信上说明了访客怎样为预约的办理时段「申请口译协助」。

collocations: request interpreter assistance ahead of a visit
request interpreter assistance at the desk

words.enDefinition: Words saying a person formally took back an earlier request

examples.en: The notice said the request was withdrawn before a decision was made.
examples.zh: 通知说，作出决定前「请求已撤回」。

examples.en: The officer confirmed the request was withdrawn and listed the recorded date.
examples.zh: 工作人员确认「请求已撤回」，并列出了记录日期。

collocations: a note saying the request was withdrawn
record that the request was withdrawn

words.enDefinition: A physical card recording a person's residence authorization

examples.en: I took my residence card to the student office to update my records.
examples.zh: 我带着「居留卡」去学生办公室更新记录。

examples.en: The adviser showed me where my name appeared on the residence card.
examples.zh: 顾问指给我看我的名字印在「居留卡」的什么位置。

collocations: the number on a residence card

words.enDefinition: Official authorization to live in a country

examples.en: I checked the number on my residence permit against the copy in my university file.
examples.zh: 我把「居留许可」上的号码和学校档案里的副本核对了一下。

examples.en: The adviser asked to see my residence permit during the registration appointment.
examples.zh: 登记预约时，顾问请我出示「居留许可」。

words.enDefinition: German residence authorization for study purposes
acceptedEnVariants: residence permit for the purpose of full-time studies

examples.en: The Berlin guide had a page about a residence permit for study at a university.
examples.zh: 柏林指南有一页介绍在大学就读的「学习居留许可」。

examples.en: The adviser pointed to residence permit for study on the German example shown in class.
examples.zh: 顾问指出了课堂德国例子里的「学习居留许可」字样。

collocations: a German residence permit for study
details on a residence permit for study
a residence permit for study purposes

words.enDefinition: A status confirming that an office received a reply

examples.en: My portal showed response received next to the date of my letter.
examples.zh: 政务平台在我的信件日期旁显示「答复已收到」。

examples.en: I saved a copy of the screen marked response received for my file.
examples.zh: 我保存了一张标记为「答复已收到」的页面截图归档。

words.enDefinition: an aim for how quickly a service should respond to a request

examples.en: The office published a response target at the bottom of its enquiry page.
examples.zh: 办事处在咨询页面底部公布了「回复时限目标」。

examples.en: I asked whether the page's response target applied to telephone enquiries as well.
examples.zh: 我问页面上的「回复时限目标」是否也适用于电话咨询。

collocations: aim to meet a response target

words.zhGloss: 恢复加拿大临时居民身份
words.enDefinition: A Canadian process to recover lost temporary resident status
acceptedZhAnswers: 恢复加拿大临时居民身份

examples.en: The Canadian guide explained restoration of status in a section about study permits.
examples.zh: 加拿大指南在学习许可章节中解释了「恢复临时居民身份」。

examples.en: I asked what restoration of status meant in the Canadian letter that I received.
examples.zh: 我问收到的加拿大来信中「恢复临时居民身份」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: a code identifying a particular limit on the holder's driving permissions

examples.en: The clerk explained which restriction code applied to the automatic class on my licence.
examples.zh: 办事员解释了我的驾照上自动挡类别对应哪个「驾照限制条件代码」。

examples.en: I checked the restriction code listed next to the category on the card.
examples.zh: 我查看了卡片上车型类别旁的「驾照限制条件代码」。

words.enDefinition: to keep one copy of a document or record for later use

examples.en: The guidance notes say to retain a copy of the submitted form.
examples.zh: 填写指导说明说，要把提交的表格「留存一份副本」。

examples.en: I decided to retain a copy after handing over the original documents.
examples.zh: 交出文件原件后，我决定「留存一份副本」。

collocations: retain a copy for your records
retain a copy of the form

words.enDefinition: The address where undeliverable mail can be sent back

examples.en: The campus mailroom asked me to put a return address on the envelope.
examples.zh: 校园邮件收发室请我在信封上写「退件地址」。

examples.en: I checked that the return address still showed my current campus residence.
examples.zh: 我确认了「退件地址」仍写的是我现在的学生宿舍。

collocations: the return address on an envelope

words.enDefinition: to send documents back to their owner or sender using a postal service

examples.en: The office offered to return documents by mail after checking the original certificates.
examples.zh: 办事处表示，查验原件后可以「将文件邮寄退回」。

examples.en: I asked whether the office would return documents by mail to my new address.
examples.zh: 我问办事处会不会「将文件邮寄退回」，并寄到我的新地址。

collocations: offer to return documents by mail
agree to return documents by mail
return documents by mail after reviewing them

words.enDefinition: An envelope supplied for sending a reply back

examples.en: I found the return envelope behind the letter about my registration documents.
examples.zh: 我在谈到登记文件的那封信后面找到了「回邮信封」。

examples.en: The return envelope was wide enough for the document without another fold.
examples.zh: 「回邮信封」够宽，文件不用再折一道。

words.enDefinition: The act of sending or handing back a previous passport

examples.en: I asked which notice described the return of the old passport after the application.
examples.zh: 我问哪份通知说明申请后会「退回旧护照」。

examples.en: The office answered my question about the return of the old passport this morning.
examples.zh: 办事处今天上午回答了我关于「退回旧护照」的问题。

collocations: confirm return of the old passport
ask about return of the old passport
a notice about return of the old passport

words.zhGloss: 寄回寄件人的签收回执
words.enDefinition: A signed delivery record sent back to the sender
acceptedZhAnswers: 寄回寄件人的签收回执

examples.en: My return receipt showed that someone at the admissions desk had signed for the envelope.
examples.zh: 我的「签收回执」显示，招生处前台有人签收了信封。

examples.en: We filed the return receipt beside the copy of the letter we had mailed.
examples.zh: 我们把「签收回执」和寄出信函的副本一起存档。

words.enDefinition: A direction or status indicating mail is going back

examples.en: The label said “Return to sender” beneath the address on the envelope.
examples.zh: 标签在信封地址下方写着「退回寄件人」。

examples.en: I checked what “Return to sender” meant for the document listed in the notice.
examples.zh: 我核实了通知里那份文件标为「退回寄件人」的含义。

words.enDefinition: An envelope sent back to the original sender

examples.en: I brought the returned envelope to the office to ask about its label.
examples.zh: 我带着「退回的信封」去办事处，询问上面的标签。

examples.en: The returned envelope was attached to the file with a note from the clerk.
examples.zh: 「退回的信封」连同工作人员的便条附在档案上。

collocations: a label on the returned envelope

words.enDefinition: Sent back before an authority processed the submission

examples.en: The envelope said the documents were returned without processing by the office.
examples.zh: 信封上的说明写着，办事处将这些文件「未受理即退回」。

examples.en: I asked why my package was marked returned without processing in the record.
examples.zh: 我问记录为何把我的材料包标为「未受理即退回」。

collocations: a notice saying returned without processing

words.enDefinition: A review based on written documents without an oral hearing

examples.en: The Australian guide described a review on the papers as one possible format.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚指南把「仅凭书面材料复核」介绍为一种可能的形式。

examples.en: I asked what the notice meant by a review on the papers.
examples.zh: 我问通知里说的「仅凭书面材料复核」指什么。

collocations: conduct a review on the papers
a decision after a review on the papers
a notice about a review on the papers

words.enDefinition: an instruction to read and verify your answers before a form is finalized

examples.en: The final page asks you to review your responses before sending the form.
examples.zh: 最后一页提醒，交表前要「核对你填写的答案」。

examples.en: There is a link to review your responses after finishing the last section.
examples.zh: 填完最后一部分后，有个链接可以「核对你填写的答案」。

collocations: take time to review your responses
ask applicants to review their responses

words.enDefinition: A decision within the scope of a specified review process

examples.en: The Australian guide explained what a reviewable decision meant in that context.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚指南说明了那个语境下「可予复核的决定」是什么意思。

examples.en: I asked which part of the letter identified the reviewable decision.
examples.zh: 我问信里哪一部分说明了哪个是「可予复核的决定」。

collocations: a notice of a reviewable decision

words.enDefinition: A recognized entitlement to challenge a decision through an appeal

examples.en: I asked where the notice discussed a possible right of appeal.
examples.zh: 我问通知在哪儿提到了可能适用的「申诉权」。

examples.en: The guide used right of appeal in a separate section about decisions.
examples.zh: 指南在讲决定的部分另设一节，介绍「申诉权」。

collocations: information about a right of appeal

words.enDefinition: Stiff packaging that helps keep mailed items flat

examples.en: I used a rigid mailer to send the certificate without folding it.
examples.zh: 我用「硬质邮寄封套」寄证书，这样不用把证书折起来。

examples.en: The clerk showed me a rigid mailer that was wider than the document.
examples.zh: 工作人员给我看了一个比文件更宽的「硬质邮寄封套」。

collocations: a certificate in a rigid mailer

words.enDefinition: official permission for an organizer to close a road to traffic for a specified time

examples.en: The council issued a road closure permit for the weekend parade.
examples.zh: 市政部门为周末的游行发放了「道路封闭许可」。

examples.en: The organizers included the road closure permit number on their printed notices.
examples.zh: 组织者在印发的通知上写明了「道路封闭许可」的编号。

collocations: apply for a road closure permit

words.enDefinition: a document showing that a vehicle met applicable roadworthiness standards in an inspection

examples.en: The registration office asked whether the roadworthiness certificate showed the same vehicle model.
examples.zh: 登记办事处问「车辆适行证明」上显示的是不是同一个车型。

examples.en: I checked the issue date printed near the top of the roadworthiness certificate.
examples.zh: 我在「车辆适行证明」顶部附近核对了签发日期。

words.enDefinition: a written form expressed in the Latin alphabet

examples.en: The Romanized spelling was different on two documents, so I asked about the difference.
examples.zh: 两份文件上的「罗马字母拼写」不同，我就问了这个差异。

examples.en: I compared the Romanized spelling with the characters shown in the left column.
examples.zh: 我把「罗马字母拼写」和左栏里的原文字作了比对。

collocations: the Romanized spelling of a name

words.zhGloss: 英国皇家邮政签收服务
words.enDefinition: A Royal Mail service that records a delivery signature
acceptedZhAnswers: 英国皇家邮政签收服务

examples.en: The UK post office receipt listed Royal Mail Signed For below the date.
examples.zh: 英国邮局的凭条在日期下面列出了「皇家邮政签收服务」。

examples.en: I asked where Royal Mail Signed For appeared on the receipt from the counter.
examples.zh: 我问柜台给的凭条上哪里写了「英国皇家邮政签收服务」。

a Royal Mail Signed For item
a Royal Mail Signed For receipt

words.zhGloss: 英国皇家邮政限时保障寄递
words.enDefinition: A named Royal Mail service for timed delivery
acceptedZhAnswers: 英国皇家邮政限时保障寄递

examples.en: The handbook showed Royal Mail Special Delivery Guaranteed on the UK postal options page.
examples.zh: 手册在英国邮寄选项的页面上列出了「皇家邮政限时保障寄递」。

examples.en: I recognized Royal Mail Special Delivery Guaranteed on the envelope from the British office.
examples.zh: 我在英国办事处寄来的信封上认出了「皇家邮政限时保障寄递」的标记。

collocations: a Royal Mail Special Delivery Guaranteed label
a Royal Mail Special Delivery Guaranteed receipt
send by Royal Mail Special Delivery Guaranteed

words.enDefinition: a form option that stores current entries so the user can resume later

examples.en: I clicked save and continue later because one document was still missing.
examples.zh: 还缺一份材料，我就点了「保存以便稍后继续」。

examples.en: The page offered save and continue later before I reached the last section.
examples.zh: 我还没填到最后一部分，页面就提供了「保存以便稍后继续」的选项。

collocations: offer a save and continue later option

words.enDefinition: To arrange a time for another delivery attempt

examples.en: The postal website showed where I could schedule a redelivery for the envelope.
examples.zh: 邮政网站显示，我可以在哪里为信封「预约再次投递」。

examples.en: Can I schedule a redelivery for a day when someone is at reception?
examples.zh: 我能选接待处有人的一天「预约再次投递」吗？

collocations: ask how to schedule a redelivery
a link to schedule a redelivery

words.enDefinition: a note indicating that a seal has been applied to something

examples.en: The note said 'Seal affixed' on the reverse, where the raised mark could be seen.
examples.zh: 备注写着背面「已盖印章」，在那里能看到凸起的印痕。

examples.en: I asked why seal affixed appeared next to the date on the separate sheet.
examples.zh: 我问为什么单独那张纸的日期旁写着「已盖印章」。

words.enDefinition: To close an envelope with its adhesive or seal

examples.en: The postal clerk showed me a table where I could seal an envelope.
examples.zh: 邮局柜台工作人员指给我看，有张桌子可以用来「封好信封」。

examples.en: I checked both pages before asking where I could seal an envelope at the counter.
examples.zh: 我先核对了信的两页内容，再问柜台哪里可以「封好信封」。

collocations: take a moment to seal an envelope
use adhesive to seal an envelope

words.enDefinition: the mark left by a seal on a document

examples.en: The seal impression was still visible where the paper had been folded over for mailing.
examples.zh: 纸张寄出时折过的地方，还能看到「印章印痕」。

examples.en: I compared the two copies because the seal impression was much clearer on the second.
examples.zh: 我把两份副本作了对照，因为第二份的「印章印痕」清楚得多。

words.enDefinition: an envelope whose opening has been closed and secured

examples.en: The records office handed me a sealed envelope with the name of the department on it.
examples.zh: 档案室递给我一个「已封口的信封」，上面写了院系的名字。

examples.en: I noticed a handwritten reference on the outside of the sealed envelope that arrived yesterday.
examples.zh: 我注意到昨天送来的「已封口的信封」外面有个手写参考编号。

collocations: place a letter in a sealed envelope

words.enDefinition: Royal Mail's second-class service for UK mail

examples.en: The clerk showed me where second-class post appeared on the UK service chart.
examples.zh: 工作人员指给我看，英国邮寄服务表上哪里写着「二类邮件服务」。

examples.en: I found a receipt for second-class post beneath my other letters from Britain.
examples.zh: 我在其他英国来信下面找到了一张「二类邮件服务」的凭条。

collocations: send a letter by second-class post

words.enDefinition: A protected online area for exchanging messages with an agency

examples.en: I found the notice in the secure message centre after signing in.
examples.zh: 登录后，我在「安全消息中心」找到了通知。

examples.en: The agency confirmed that my response was in the secure message centre.
examples.zh: 政务机构确认，我的答复在「安全消息中心」里。

collocations: reply in the secure message centre
a message in the secure message centre

words.enDefinition: An envelope designed to obscure its contents

examples.en: The notice arrived in a security envelope with a patterned lining inside.
examples.zh: 通知装在一个内层印有图案的「防透视信封」里寄到。

examples.en: I asked for a security envelope before mailing the document from campus.
examples.zh: 我从学校寄文件前，要了一个「防透视信封」。

collocations: mail a document in a security envelope

words.enDefinition: paper made with features intended to deter copying or alteration

examples.en: The record described the original certificate as a document issued on security paper.
examples.zh: 记录说，原件证书是用「防伪纸」出具的文件。

examples.en: I asked whether the page on security paper was the one mentioned in the letter.
examples.zh: 我问用「防伪纸」印的那一页是不是信里提到的那一页。

words.enDefinition: an instruction to choose exactly one item from a set of alternatives

examples.en: The page said select one option beside the three available delivery methods.
examples.zh: 页面在三种可用的配送方式旁写着「请选择一项」。

examples.en: I saw select one option before choosing how to receive the document.
examples.zh: 我看到「请选择一项」，然后选了接收文件的方式。

collocations: ask users to select one option
select one option from the list

words.enDefinition: the answer someone has marked or chosen from a set of options

examples.en: I checked the selected answer after the application showed a preview page.
examples.zh: 申请系统显示预览页后，我核对了「已选定的答案」。

examples.en: The blue border showed which option was the selected answer on screen.
examples.zh: 蓝边框标出了屏幕上哪一项是「已选定的答案」。

words.enDefinition: An envelope addressed to oneself for a reply

examples.en: The form's cover page mentioned a self-addressed envelope among the enclosed items.
examples.zh: 表格封面在随附物品中提到了一个「写好自己地址的信封」。

examples.en: I asked whether the self-addressed envelope should carry my current student residence details.
examples.zh: 我问「写好自己地址的信封」要不要用现在的学生宿舍信息。

collocations: write your name on a self-addressed envelope
a self-addressed envelope for a reply

words.zhGloss: 贴好邮票的自址回邮信封
words.enDefinition: An envelope with your address and a stamp
acceptedZhAnswers: 贴好邮票的自址回邮信封

examples.en: I enclosed a self-addressed stamped envelope so the office could return my original document.
examples.zh: 我随信附上一个「贴好邮票的自址回邮信封」，方便办事处寄回我的文件原件。

examples.en: The self-addressed stamped envelope already had my new flat number written on it.
examples.zh: 「贴好邮票的自址回邮信封」上已经写了我的新公寓门牌号。

collocations: a reply in a self-addressed stamped envelope

words.enDefinition: An envelope with its own adhesive seal

examples.en: I chose a self-seal envelope from the shelf at the postal counter.
examples.zh: 我从邮政服务柜台的货架上挑了一个「自封式信封」。

examples.en: The clerk showed me a self-seal envelope in a size that fit my letter.
examples.zh: 工作人员给我看了一个大小适合装我那封信的「自封式信封」。

words.enDefinition: The copy of a mailing document the sender keeps

examples.en: I saved the sender's copy of the mailing form with my other paperwork.
examples.zh: 我把邮寄单的「寄件人留存联」和其他手续文件一起保存。

examples.en: The postal clerk pointed out the sender's copy on the printed form.
examples.zh: 邮局柜台工作人员指出了打印表格上的「寄件人留存联」。

words.enDefinition: a scheduled visit to obtain a service from a public office or similar organization

examples.en: I booked a service appointment before making the trip to the regional office.
examples.zh: 出发去地区办事处之前，我约了一个「办理业务的预约」。

examples.en: The service appointment covered both the document check and a short interview.
examples.zh: 「办理业务的预约」包括查验文件和一次简短面谈。

words.enDefinition: a geographic area for which an office or service is responsible

examples.en: I checked whether my new address was in the office's service area.
examples.zh: 我查了新地址是不是在办事处的「服务辖区」内。

examples.en: The map showed the service area with its boundaries shaded in green.
examples.zh: 地图用绿色标出了「服务辖区」的边界。

words.enDefinition: a published list of charges for different services

examples.en: I read the service fee schedule before printing the application for my visit.
examples.zh: 打印这次要带去的申请表之前，我看了「服务收费表」。

examples.en: The office kept a service fee schedule beside the main information board.
examples.zh: 办事处在主信息牌旁放了一份「服务收费表」。

words.enDefinition: a stated level or commitment for how a public service should be delivered

examples.en: The agency's service standard described how quickly it aimed to acknowledge enquiries.
examples.zh: 该机构的「服务标准」写明了它希望在多长时间内确认收到咨询。

examples.en: I compared the service standard with the information shown in the leaflet.
examples.zh: 我把「服务标准」和宣传单显示的信息作了对照。

words.enDefinition: an opening or numbered station where staff receive documents and help visitors

examples.en: I took my folder to the service window when my number appeared.
examples.zh: 号码显示出来后，我拿着文件夹去了「办事窗口」。

examples.en: The service window beside the entrance was closed for the afternoon.
examples.zh: 入口旁的「办事窗口」当天下午关着。

words.enDefinition: To remove the legal effect of an earlier decision

examples.en: The Australian decision summary explained what it meant to set aside the decision.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚的决定概要解释了「撤销该项决定」是什么意思。

examples.en: The order recorded the panel's decision to set aside the decision that afternoon.
examples.zh: 命令记录了小组当天下午决定「撤销该项决定」。

collocations: decide to set aside the decision
an order to set aside the decision
a tribunal may set aside the decision

words.zhGloss: 美国学生与交流访客信息系统
words.enDefinition: A U.S. system for student and exchange visitor records
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国学生与交流访客信息系统
acceptedEnVariants: Student and Exchange Visitor Information System

examples.en: The U.S. university's orientation explained where student records were kept in SEVIS.
examples.zh: 美国大学的迎新活动解释了学生记录保存在「美国学生与交流访客信息系统」的哪里。

examples.en: The adviser said the program name was recorded in SEVIS alongside my details.
examples.zh: 顾问说，项目名称和我的个人信息一起记录在「美国学生与交流访客信息系统」里。

words.zhGloss: 美国学生与交流访客系统编号
words.enDefinition: An identifier for a U.S. SEVIS record
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国学生与交流访客系统编号

examples.en: The adviser showed me where my SEVIS ID appeared on my U.S. student document.
examples.zh: 顾问指给我看，美国学生文件的哪里显示了「美国学生与交流访客系统编号」。

examples.en: I checked that the SEVIS ID on the receipt matched the one on my record.
examples.zh: 我比对了凭据和记录上的「美国学生与交流访客系统编号」是否一致。

collocations: the SEVIS ID on the form

words.zhGloss: 美国学生系统记录转移
words.enDefinition: Moving a U.S. SEVIS record between schools
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国学生系统记录转移

examples.en: The adviser explained where the SEVIS transfer was shown in the U.S. university's record.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了美国大学的记录在哪儿显示「学生系统记录转移」。

examples.en: I asked what SEVIS transfer meant in the note I'd received from my school.
examples.zh: 我问学校通知里的「美国学生系统记录转移」是什么意思。

collocations: the date of a SEVIS transfer

words.enDefinition: An official change to the sex designation recorded on a document

examples.en: The form listed a sex designation change separately from corrections to names.
examples.zh: 表格把「证件性别标记变更」和姓名更正分开列出。

examples.en: I asked which heading referred to a sex designation change in the booklet.
examples.zh: 我问手册中哪个标题指的是「证件性别标记变更」。

collocations: a notice of sex designation change

words.enDefinition: The field recording a sex designation in an identity document

examples.en: I asked where the sex marker appeared on the sample card.
examples.zh: 我问卡片样本上的「性别标记」写在哪里。

examples.en: The office explained what it called the sex marker on its form.
examples.zh: 办事处解释了他们的表格怎样称呼「性别标记」。

collocations: a change to a sex marker

words.enDefinition: A UK code for sharing specified immigration information

examples.en: The student office asked for a share code to check my UK status.
examples.zh: 学生办公室请我提供「英国移民身份分享码」，以核对我在英国的身份。

examples.en: I asked which share code the UK registration team meant in its message.
examples.zh: 我问英国的注册团队在消息中指的是哪个「移民身份分享码」。

collocations: check someone's status with a share code

words.enDefinition: An abbreviated certificate containing selected details from a birth record

examples.en: The guide showed a sample short-form birth certificate next to the fuller version.
examples.zh: 指南把「简版出生证明」的样本放在详细版旁边。

examples.en: I asked which information my short-form birth certificate included on the front.
examples.zh: 我问「简版出生证明」正面印了哪些信息。

collocations: details on a short-form birth certificate

words.enDefinition: A UK visa for short English language study

examples.en: The guide showed a sample notice for a UK Short-term study visa.
examples.zh: 指南展示了一份「英国短期学习签证」的通知样本。

examples.en: I asked where the Short-term study visa was named in the British course guide.
examples.zh: 我问英国课程指南哪里提到了「短期学习签证」。

words.zhGloss: 在表格上签名并写日期
words.enDefinition: to add both a signature and a date to a form where required
acceptedZhAnswers: 在表格上签名并写日期

examples.en: The clerk asked me to sign and date the form at the bottom.
examples.zh: 办事员请我「在表格底部签名并写日期」。

examples.en: I remembered to sign and date the form before taking it to the office.
examples.zh: 我记得去办事处之前先「在表格上签名并写日期」。

collocations: please sign and date the form
sign and date the form before submission
ask applicants to sign and date the form

words.enDefinition: to record your arrival when you reach a place for a visit

examples.en: The door notice asked visitors to sign in on arrival at reception.
examples.zh: 门上的通知请访客在接待处「到场时签到」。

examples.en: I remembered to sign in on arrival before taking a seat upstairs.
examples.zh: 我记得先「到场时签到」，再去楼上找座位。

collocations: ask visitors to sign in on arrival
remember to sign in on arrival
require visitors to sign in on arrival

words.enDefinition: a bordered space in a form set aside for a person's signature

examples.en: The signature box was just below the statement on the last page.
examples.zh: 「签名框」就在最后一页声明的下方。

examples.en: I left the signature box empty until I could confirm the details.
examples.zh: 我先把「签名框」留空，等核实细节后再签。

words.enDefinition: a line on a document indicating where a person should sign

examples.en: The form showed my printed name just below the signature line.
examples.zh: 表格把我的印刷体姓名放在「签名线」正下方。

examples.en: I checked that the signature line was visible after printing the page.
examples.zh: 打印这一页后，我确认「签名线」清楚可见。

words.enDefinition: A notice that delivery requires a signature

examples.en: The label said “Signature required” next to the reference for the document.
examples.zh: 标签在文件编号旁写着「需要签收」。

examples.en: I saw “Signature required” on the envelope from the local government office.
examples.zh: 我在地方政府办事处寄来的信封上看到了「需要签收」。

words.enDefinition: A tracking label introducing the recorded signer

examples.en: The delivery record showed “Signed by” beside the receptionist's initials on the screen.
examples.zh: 屏幕上的投递记录在接待员姓名首字母旁写着「签收人为」。

examples.en: I asked whether the name after “Signed by” belonged to the front desk worker.
examples.zh: 我问「签收人为」后面的姓名是不是前台工作人员的。

words.enDefinition: Delivery that records a signature when mail is handed over

examples.en: The letter mentioned signed-for delivery in the section about returning the certificate.
examples.zh: 信在介绍寄回证书的部分提到了「签收投递」。

examples.en: I asked which option on the board was for signed-for delivery at this branch.
examples.zh: 我问这个网点的牌子上哪个选项是「签收投递」。

words.enDefinition: says the witness was present and observed the signing

examples.en: The note said 'Signed in my presence' and gave the witness's name below it.
examples.zh: 备注写着「在本人见证下签署」，下面列了见证人的名字。

examples.en: I read 'Signed in my presence' on the line directly above the embossed seal.
examples.zh: 我在凸纹印章正上方的一行读到了「在本人见证下签署」。

collocations: a note reading signed in my presence
a clause saying signed in my presence
the words signed in my presence

words.enDefinition: A Canadian letter confirming the recipient's Social Insurance Number

examples.en: The Canadian clerk explained how the SIN confirmation letter was titled.
examples.zh: 加拿大的办事员说明了「加拿大社保号确认信」的标题是什么。

examples.en: I asked which page described the SIN confirmation letter in the guide.
examples.zh: 我问指南哪一页介绍了「加拿大社保号确认信」。

collocations: information on a SIN confirmation letter

words.enDefinition: A visa designated for a single entry

examples.en: The words single-entry visa appeared in the heading of the sample notice.
examples.zh: 样本通知的标题里出现了「单次入境签证」。

examples.en: I asked which part of the label showed that it was a single-entry visa.
examples.zh: 我问标签哪一部分显示它是「单次入境签证」。

words.enDefinition: a drawing showing the layout of a site and where a proposed activity will take place

examples.en: The site plan showed the position of the stalls and the public entrance.
examples.zh: 「场地平面图」标出了各摊位和公众入口的位置。

examples.en: The organizer submitted a revised site plan when the performance area moved indoors.
examples.zh: 表演区移到室内后，组织者提交了修改后的「场地平面图」。

words.enDefinition: A Canadian identifier used for work and access to certain government programs

examples.en: The Canadian guide explained the purpose of a Social Insurance Number.
examples.zh: 加拿大指南解释了「加拿大社会保险号码」的用途。

examples.en: I recognized the initials SIN when the guide named the Social Insurance Number.
examples.zh: 指南提到「加拿大社会保险号码」时，我认出了缩写 SIN。

collocations: documents about a Social Insurance Number

words.enDefinition: A US card from the Social Security Administration displaying someone's name and number

examples.en: The guide distinguishes a Social Security card from state photo identification.
examples.zh: 指南区分了「美国社会安全号码卡」和州签发的照片身份证件。

examples.en: The clerk showed which field contained the name on a Social Security card.
examples.zh: 办事员指给我们看「美国社会安全号码卡」上姓名在哪一栏。

collocations: name on a Social Security card

words.enDefinition: A US identifier used for Social Security, earnings, and other records

examples.en: The US letter referred to my Social Security number without printing it.
examples.zh: 美国的信里提到了我的「美国社会安全号码」，没有印出号码。

examples.en: The handbook used Social Security number as the heading for this section.
examples.zh: 手册用「美国社会安全号码」作这一节的标题。

collocations: records linked to a Social Security number

words.enDefinition: a formal promise of truthfulness made without swearing an oath

examples.en: The sample showed a solemn affirmation under a heading separate from the printed oath.
examples.zh: 样本把「正式确认属实的声明」列在一个单独的标题下，和印出的誓词分开。

examples.en: I asked what the solemn affirmation referred to in the notes attached to the form.
examples.zh: 我问表格附注里，「正式确认属实的声明」指的是什么。

collocations: a statement made by solemn affirmation

words.enDefinition: state formally that the information you give is true

examples.en: The words solemnly declare appeared at the start of the example we were reading.
examples.zh: 我们读的样本一开头就用了「郑重声明」。

examples.en: I asked what solemnly declare meant in the first sentence of the Australian form.
examples.zh: 我问澳大利亚表格第一句话里的「郑重声明」是什么意思。

collocations: solemnly declare something to be true
a statement beginning I solemnly declare

words.enDefinition: the language in which the text being translated was written

examples.en: The translator identified the source language next to the title of the original statement.
examples.zh: 译员在原声明标题旁边注明了「源语」。

examples.en: I checked which source language the note referred to because the document was bilingual.
examples.zh: 文件用了两种语言，我就核对了备注里指的是哪一种「源语」。

collocations: a document in the source language

words.enDefinition: an area in a form or document set aside for written comments

examples.en: The form had space for notes under the question about previous addresses.
examples.zh: 表格在询问旧住址的题目下设有「备注栏」。

examples.en: I used the space for notes to explain why the two dates differed.
examples.zh: 我在「备注栏」里说明了两个日期为什么不一样。

words.enDefinition: to talk with a person who helps explain services, choices or requirements

examples.en: I waited to speak to an adviser about which branch handled the document.
examples.zh: 我等着「与办事顾问交谈」，问哪个办事点处理这份文件。

examples.en: The website gave a number to call to speak to an adviser.
examples.zh: 网站给出一个电话，可以打去「与办事顾问交谈」。

collocations: call to speak to an adviser
ask to speak to an adviser
arrange to speak to an adviser

words.enDefinition: characters such as symbols or punctuation, often outside ordinary letters and numbers

examples.en: The form rejected special characters in the short reference code I entered.
examples.zh: 我填的短查询编号包含「特殊字符」，表格没有接受。

examples.en: I checked the instructions to see which special characters the field supported.

words.enDefinition: An Irish permission category including certain graduate permissions

examples.zh: 我在一张爱尔兰毕业生登记卡样本上找「1G号居留许可」的标注。

words.zhGloss: 爱尔兰2号学习居留许可
words.enDefinition: Irish student permission for eligible full-time programmes

examples.zh: 我在爱尔兰卡片样本的许可详情旁看到了「2号学习居留许可」。

examples.zh: 顾问指出「2号学习居留许可」在爱尔兰大学所用指南中的位置。

words.zhGloss: 爱尔兰2A号学习居留许可
words.enDefinition: Irish student permission for certain programmes outside the main list
acceptedZhAnswers: 爱尔兰2A号学习居留许可

examples.en: The sample letter named Stamp 2A in the section on Irish student permissions.
examples.zh: 信件样本在爱尔兰学生许可部分写明了「2A号学习居留许可」。

examples.en: My classmate asked where Stamp 2A appeared in the example from the Irish office.
examples.zh: 同学问爱尔兰办事处的例子在哪儿显示了「2A号学习居留许可」。

words.enDefinition: to put an official stamp on a receipt to mark it as received or issued

examples.en: The clerk stopped to stamp a receipt after taking my completed forms.
examples.zh: 办事员收下我填好的表格后，停下来「在收据上盖章」。

examples.zh: 我看着柜台人员「在收据上盖章」，然后把副本交还给我。

ask the clerk to stamp a receipt
stamp a receipt before issuing it

words.enDefinition: a stamp mark on the back of the document

examples.en: I noticed a stamp on the reverse when I removed the pages from the envelope.
examples.zh: 我从信封里抽出这些页时，注意到「背面盖的章」。

examples.en: The clerk asked me which name was written under the stamp on the reverse.
examples.zh: 工作人员问，「背面盖的章」下面写的是哪个名字。

collocations: look for a stamp on the reverse
read the stamp on the reverse
a faint stamp on the reverse

words.enDefinition: A regular postal service without special handling

examples.en: I asked how standard mail was named on the form at the counter.
examples.zh: 我问柜台的表格用什么名称标示「普通邮件服务」。

examples.en: The office sent the notice by standard mail in the example we discussed.
examples.zh: 在我们讨论的例子里，办事处用「普通邮件服务」寄出了通知。

words.enDefinition: document authentication handled by a state authority in the United States

examples.en: The American example used state authentication to identify which office had issued the certificate.
examples.zh: 美国的样本用「州级文书认证」说明证书是哪个办公室出具的。

examples.en: I asked what state authentication meant in the note beside the printed seal.
examples.zh: 我问印着的印章旁边那条备注里，「美国州级文书认证」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: A US state-issued card showing identity without serving as a driving licence

examples.en: The US clerk showed an example of a state ID card.
examples.zh: 美国的办事员展示了一张「美国州身份证」样本。

examples.en: I asked which details appeared on a sample state ID card.
examples.zh: 我问「美国州身份证」样本上印有哪些信息。

collocations: apply for a state ID card

words.enDefinition: a form label asking for the relevant regional division of a country

examples.en: I chose the state or province from a list after entering my country.
examples.zh: 填完国家后，我从列表里选了「州或省」。

examples.en: The clerk showed me which part of the address was the state or province.
examples.zh: 办事员给我看了地址哪部分是「州或省」。

collocations: the field for state or province

words.enDefinition: An Ontario form recording information for registering a live birth

examples.en: The Ontario guide showed the statement of live birth separately from the certificate.
examples.zh: 安大略指南把「活产出生登记表」与证书分开展示。

examples.en: I asked what details the statement of live birth recorded for the registration.
examples.zh: 我问「活产出生登记表」记了哪些登记信息。

collocations: complete a statement of live birth
information on the statement of live birth
a copy of the statement of live birth

words.enDefinition: A formal explanation of the basis for an official decision

examples.en: The statement of reasons referred to documents listed earlier in the file.
examples.zh: 「决定理由说明」提到了案卷前面列出的文件。

examples.en: I asked which page contained the statement of reasons for this decision.
examples.zh: 我问这一决定的「决定理由说明」在哪一页。

words.enDefinition: a formal written statement declared to be true under applicable law

examples.en: The Australian form used 'Statutory declaration' as its heading above the first numbered section.
examples.zh: 这份澳大利亚表格在第一个编号部分上方用「法定声明」作标题。

examples.en: I asked which attachment was the statutory declaration mentioned in the letter from the office.
examples.zh: 我问哪个附件是办事处信里提到的「法定声明」。

words.enDefinition: a formal UK notification that a vehicle is being kept off public roads

examples.en: The UK service listed Statutory Off Road Notification beside information about vehicle tax.
examples.zh: 英国政务服务把「英国车辆停驶申报」列在机动车税信息旁。

examples.en: I asked what Statutory Off Road Notification meant in the document shown in class.
examples.zh: 我问课堂所展示文件里的「英国车辆停驶申报」是什么意思。

collocations: make a Statutory Off Road Notification
record a Statutory Off Road Notification
a Statutory Off Road Notification confirmation

words.enDefinition: local permission to collect charitable donations from people in a public place

examples.en: The charity included its street collection permit in the volunteer information pack.
examples.zh: 慈善机构把「街头募捐许可证」放进了志愿者资料包。

examples.en: Their street collection permit covered the town square during the winter fair.
examples.zh: 他们的「街头募捐许可证」适用于冬季市集举办期间的镇广场。

words.enDefinition: the official name of a street used as part of an address

examples.en: I wrote the street name as it appeared on the tenancy agreement.
examples.zh: 我按租约上的写法填了「街道名称」。

examples.zh: 地址表格把「街道名称」放在了一个独立的输入框里。

words.enDefinition: a local licence that allows a trader to sell goods in approved public places

examples.en: The vendor displayed her street trading licence beside the menu every morning.
examples.zh: 摊主每天早上都把「街头经营许可证」摆在菜单旁。

examples.en: His street trading licence named the exact pitch where he could sell coffee.
examples.zh: 他的「街头经营许可证」标明了他可以售卖咖啡的具体摊位。

words.enDefinition: permission to occupy part of a public street for a specified activity

examples.en: The restaurant obtained a street use permit for tables on the sidewalk.
examples.zh: 餐厅取得了「街道使用许可」，可以在人行道上摆桌。

examples.en: The street use permit showed how much space the equipment could occupy.
examples.zh: 「街道使用许可」上标明了设备可以占用多少空间。

words.enDefinition: official permission to carry out specified work on a street during an approved period

examples.en: The contractor checked the street works permit before confirming the repair dates.
examples.zh: 承包商在确认维修日期前查看了「道路施工许可」。

examples.en: The approved street works permit covered the short section outside the library.
examples.zh: 获批的「道路施工许可」涵盖图书馆外的一小段道路。

collocations: apply for a street works permit

words.enDefinition: to put a line through incorrect written information so it can be replaced

examples.en: I checked whether I should strike through an error or start again.
examples.zh: 我核实了应该「用线划掉错处」，还是重填一张。

ask someone to strike through an error

words.zhGloss: 澳大利亚学生监护人签证

examples.zh: 澳大利亚指南单独一页解释了「学生监护人签证」。

examples.en: I asked which heading on the Australian page referred to the Student Guardian visa.
examples.zh: 我问澳大利亚网页上的哪个标题指的是「学生监护人签证」。

words.enDefinition: The UK immigration route for most international students

examples.en: The university placed the Student route guide alongside the general admission information.
examples.zh: 学校把「英国学生签证类别」指南放在了普通录取信息旁边。

examples.en: I asked which section of my notice described the Student route in Britain.
examples.zh: 我问通知的哪一部分介绍了「英国学生签证类别」。

words.zhGloss: 英国学生签证担保机构

acceptedZhAnswers: 英国学生签证担保机构

examples.en: I checked whether the British university was listed as my Student sponsor.
examples.zh: 我查看这所英国大学是不是被列为我的「学生签证担保机构」。

examples.en: The letter identified the Student sponsor in the section below my course dates.
examples.zh: 这封信在课程日期下面的一栏写明了「英国学生签证担保机构」。

words.enDefinition: Australia's subclass for student visas
