examples.zh: 澳大利亚大学指南在注册栏目旁列出了「500类学生签证」。

examples.en: I saw Student visa (subclass 500) at the top of the Australian sample notice.
examples.zh: 我在澳大利亚通知样本的顶部看到了「500类学生签证」。

words.enDefinition: Canadian authorization to study as a foreign national

examples.zh: 我和加拿大大学的学生办公室核对了「学习许可」上的信息。

examples.en: The Canadian guide showed where the program name appeared on the study permit.
examples.zh: 加拿大指南标出了「学习许可」上项目名称所在的位置。

examples.en: The letter identified a study permit amendment in the heading above my reference number.

examples.zh: 我问加拿大样例中的「学习许可更正」涉及哪些字段。

examples.en: The Canadian adviser pointed out the study permit conditions beneath my study details.
examples.zh: 加拿大的顾问指给我看学习信息下方的「学习许可所附条件」。

examples.en: I asked where the study permit conditions were listed on this sample document.
examples.zh: 我问这份样本文件在哪儿列出了「加拿大学习许可所附条件」。

words.enDefinition: An extension of the period covered by a Canadian study permit

examples.en: I asked which page described a study permit extension in the Canadian guide.
examples.zh: 我问加拿大指南哪一页介绍了「学习许可延期」。

examples.en: The portal showed a separate entry about my study permit extension beside earlier records.
examples.zh: 门户在较早的记录旁单独列出了我的「加拿大学习许可延期」事项。

examples.zh: 我把「学习许可编号」和加拿大留学生档案里的副本核对了一下。

examples.zh: 顾问指给我们看课堂样本上的「加拿大学习许可编号」。

examples.zh: 我把文件夹里的材料和办事处的「提交材料检查清单」作了对照。

examples.zh: 门户网站在说明第一页提供了「提交材料检查清单」。

examples.zh: 更正其中一个日期后，我回到了「提交页面」。

examples.zh: 案件概要在较早的陈述后面列出了「回应对方的陈述材料」。

examples.zh: 我核对了我方的「回应对方的陈述材料」在哪一页。

words.enDefinition: to hand over a document at a staffed desk for formal receipt

examples.zh: 我打算「在柜台递交」，所以先填好了表格。

documents you can submit at the counter

examples.zh: 如果表格原件本身就是纸质的，我可以「通过邮寄递交」吗？

collocations: be allowed to submit by post

examples.zh: 我找到正确的办公地点地址之后，才「提交填写完成的表格」。

examples.en: The instructions explain where to submit the completed form and supporting documents.
examples.zh: 说明写明到哪里「提交填写完成的表格」和证明材料。

examples.zh: 宣誓签署公证证明在官员姓名上方一行使用了「已签署并宣誓」。

examples.zh: 在对照这份美国文件的两个版本时，我给「已签署并宣誓」画了下划线。

a statement marked subscribed and sworn

words.enDefinition: An Australian visa in an ordinary category such as student

examples.zh: 澳大利亚术语表用「实质性签证」来说明例子里所示的类别。

examples.en: I asked what substantive visa meant in the letter from the Australian office.
examples.zh: 我问澳大利亚办事处来信里「实质性签证」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: To place a new decision in place of the earlier one

examples.zh: 指南展示了复核时怎样通过一项命令「改作一项新决定」。

examples.zh: 我问通知为什么说小组将「改作一项新决定」。

choose to substitute a new decision
a tribunal may substitute a new decision

words.enDefinition: Further material provided in addition to the evidence already available

examples.en: The clerk sent my supplementary evidence to the team handling my file.
examples.zh: 办事员把我的「补充证据」转交给了办理团队。

examples.en: I kept the supplementary evidence separate from the documents I sent first.
examples.zh: 我将「补充证据」与最初寄出的文件分开保存。

words.enDefinition: an additional translation provided for material not covered earlier

examples.en: The supplementary translation covered the handwritten note that was not in the first version.
examples.zh: 「补充译文」译了第一版里没译的手写备注。

examples.en: I received a supplementary translation for the stamp on the reverse of the document.
examples.zh: 文件背面的印章，我收到了一份「补充译文」。

words.enDefinition: Additional documents used to support someone's identity in an application

examples.zh: 我问指南哪个标题下面列出了「辅助身份材料」。

examples.en: The clerk placed my supporting identity documents beside the main certificate.
examples.zh: 办事员把「辅助身份材料」放在主要证明文件旁边。

collocations: a list of supporting identity documents

words.enDefinition: details provided to help explain, confirm or substantiate a response or application

examples.en: I added supporting information explaining why the dates appeared in two different formats.
examples.zh: 我加了「辅助说明资料」，解释日期为什么用了两种不同格式。

examples.en: The clerk showed me where to attach supporting information for the first answer.
examples.zh: 办事员给我看了第一道题的「辅助说明资料」附在哪里。

collocations: include supporting information with an application

words.enDefinition: to formally give a licence back to the authority that issued or administers it

examples.en: I asked whether the notice required me to surrender a licence after it was replaced.
examples.zh: 我问那份通知是不是要求在换发后「交回驾驶执照」。

examples.en: The example showed where to send documents if someone needed to surrender a licence.
examples.zh: 示例注明，需要「交回驾驶执照」时应该把文件寄到哪里。

collocations: be asked to surrender a licence

words.enDefinition: To formally hand a passport over to a relevant authority

examples.en: I asked what it meant to surrender a passport in that notice.
examples.zh: 我询问了那份告示中的「交回护照」指什么。

examples.en: The clerk explained that the letter used the phrase surrender a passport.
examples.zh: 办事员说明了信里用了「交回护照」这个说法。

collocations: ask what it means to surrender a passport
a notice to surrender a passport
a requirement to surrender a passport

words.enDefinition: to formally return a vehicle's registration plates to the relevant authority

examples.en: I asked which office would accept the plates if I needed to surrender number plates.

examples.en: The instructions explained where to surrender number plates after the vehicle was deregistered.
examples.zh: 说明写明车辆注销登记后，可以去哪里「交回车牌」。

collocations: be asked to surrender number plates
decide whether to surrender number plates

words.enDefinition: make an oath that the contents of a document are true

examples.zh: 工作人员解释了对声明「宣誓确认内容属实」是什么意思。

examples.en: The note said the person agreed to swear to the contents of the attached document.
examples.zh: 备注说，那个人同意对所附文件「宣誓确认内容属实」。

collocations: ask someone to swear to the contents
swear to the contents of a statement
prepared to swear to the contents

words.enDefinition: records that someone made an oath before the official writing it

examples.en: The phrase 'Sworn before me' appeared between the name and date in the certificate.
examples.zh: 证明书里的姓名和日期之间写着「在本人面前宣誓」。

examples.en: I asked who the word me referred to in the phrase sworn before me.
examples.zh: 我问「在本人面前宣誓」里的“本人”指谁。

collocations: a clause beginning sworn before me

words.enDefinition: a translator formally sworn or appointed under a local system

examples.zh: 法国指南在介绍当地翻译服务时用了「宣誓译员」。

examples.en: The seal on my translation identified a sworn translator and showed the language pair.
examples.zh: 我那份译文上的印章列出了一位「宣誓译员」，还注明了翻译的语种组合。

words.enDefinition: A notification produced automatically by an agency's computer system

examples.en: An adviser explained the heading on the system-generated notice I received.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了我收到的「系统自动生成的通知」上的标题。

words.enDefinition: make a formal promise of truthfulness

examples.en: The meeting record said the person agreed to take an oath before confirming the statement.
examples.zh: 会面记录说，那个人同意在确认声明之前「作出宣誓」。

examples.en: I asked what it meant to take an oath in the example we were reading.
examples.zh: 我问正在读的样本里，「作出宣誓」是什么意思。

collocations: take an oath before an officer
be asked to take an oath

words.enDefinition: the language into which the text is translated

examples.en: The target language was printed beside the name of the translation agency on my copy.
examples.zh: 我那份副本上，「目标语」印在翻译机构名称旁边。

examples.en: I checked which target language was listed before comparing the two attachments in my email.
examples.zh: 对照邮件里的两个附件前，我查了列出的是哪种「目标语」。

examples.zh: 我问办事员，「车辆税类别」显示在网上记录的哪个位置。

words.enDefinition: An Australian identifier used in tax and superannuation records

examples.en: The Australian form used tax file number as the heading for that section.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚表格把「澳大利亚税务档案号」用作那一节的标题。

examples.en: The guide used TFN as short for tax file number in the sample.
examples.zh: 指南在样表里用 TFN 表示「澳大利亚税务档案号」。

collocations: records linked to a tax file number

words.enDefinition: An Australian form supplying employment information relevant to tax withholding

examples.en: The Australian office listed the Tax file number declaration with the employment forms.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚办事处把「澳大利亚税号申报表」和用工表格一起列出。

examples.en: The guide showed a blank Tax file number declaration beside the example letter.
examples.zh: 指南在示例信旁放了一张空白「澳大利亚税号申报表」。

collocations: read a Tax file number declaration
complete a Tax file number declaration
details on a Tax file number declaration

words.enDefinition: an official permission to drive for a limited interim period under stated conditions

examples.en: The agency labelled the paper as a temporary driving permit under local rules.
examples.zh: 该机构按当地用语，把那份纸质文件标为「短期驾驶许可证」。

examples.en: I checked the end date on the temporary driving permit issued by the office.
examples.zh: 我核对了办事处签发的「短期驾驶许可证」的结束日期。

words.enDefinition: Forwarding mail to another address for a limited period

examples.en: The postal guide listed temporary mail forwarding in a section for people relocating briefly.
examples.zh: 邮政指南在介绍短期搬迁的章节里列出了「临时邮件改寄」。

examples.en: I asked whether the notice referred to temporary mail forwarding or a permanent address update.
examples.zh: 我问通知指的是「临时邮件改寄」，还是永久性地址更新。

words.enDefinition: a limited period during which an office is not open for normal services

examples.en: The site announced a temporary office closure while the entrance was being repaired.
examples.zh: 网站宣布，入口维修期间「办事处临时关闭」。

examples.en: I moved my appointment after seeing the notice of a temporary office closure.
examples.zh: 看到「办事处临时关闭」的通知后，我改了预约。

collocations: a notice of temporary office closure
reschedule after a temporary office closure

words.enDefinition: a permit allowing parking for a stated short period under designated conditions

examples.en: The office issued a temporary parking permit for our moving day.
examples.zh: 办事处给我们搬家当天发了「临时停车许可证」。

examples.en: I checked the dates printed on the temporary parking permit before packing it.
examples.zh: 装进行李之前，我核对了「临时停车许可证」上印的日期。

collocations: a temporary parking permit for visitors

words.enDefinition: a limited-duration official registration record for a vehicle under a particular system

examples.en: The agency described the document as temporary registration in the confirmation email.
examples.zh: 机构在确认邮件中把该文件称为「临时车辆登记」。

examples.en: I checked when the temporary registration shown on the paper would end.
examples.zh: 我查看了纸上显示的「临时车辆登记」什么时候结束。

words.enDefinition: Permission to reside for a limited period

examples.en: The student adviser checked the temporary residence permit against the name in my file.
examples.zh: 学生顾问将「临时居留许可」上的姓名和我档案里的姓名作了核对。

examples.en: I asked which date on my temporary residence permit appeared in the university records.
examples.zh: 我问学校记录里登记的是「临时居留许可」上的哪个日期。

collocations: a copy of a temporary residence permit
the expiry of a temporary residence permit

words.enDefinition: A Canadian visa used to seek entry as a temporary resident

examples.en: The Canadian handout showed where temporary resident visa appeared above the sample passport label.
examples.zh: 加拿大讲义指出，护照贴签样本上方哪里写着「临时居民签证」。

examples.en: I asked whether the Canadian letter mentioned a temporary resident visa by name.
examples.zh: 我问加拿大的信是否明确提到了「临时居民签证」一词。

collocations: details on a temporary resident visa

words.enDefinition: a UK administrative order allowing temporary changes or restrictions on traffic under stated conditions

examples.en: The council leaflet mentioned a temporary traffic regulation order for the street event.
examples.zh: 地方议会宣传单提到，该街头活动有一份「临时交通管制令」。

examples.en: I checked which roads were named in the temporary traffic regulation order.
examples.zh: 我查看了「临时交通管制令」列明了哪些道路。

collocations: issue a temporary traffic regulation order
read a temporary traffic regulation order
a temporary traffic regulation order for road works

words.enDefinition: A Canadian territory's attestation for a study permit application

examples.en: The Canadian guide showed a territorial attestation letter alongside a sample from a province.
examples.zh: 加拿大指南把一份「地区级确认函」和一份省级函件样本并列展示。

examples.en: I checked the territory's name on the sample territorial attestation letter in the classroom.
examples.zh: 我核对了课堂样本「加拿大地区级确认函」上的地区名称。

collocations: a copy of a territorial attestation letter

words.enDefinition: a document confirming that a person passed a driving test

examples.en: The driving examiner handed me a test pass certificate after our appointment.
examples.zh: 考试结束后，驾驶考官给了我一份「驾考合格证明」。

examples.en: I kept the test pass certificate with my driving documents while waiting for the licence.
examples.zh: 等驾照寄到期间，我把「驾考合格证明」和驾驶材料放在一起。

words.enDefinition: an area on a digital form where a user types text or numbers

examples.en: The text field accepted only the first line of my long address.
examples.zh: 「文本输入框」只接收了我那一长串地址的第一行。

examples.en: I clicked the text field before pasting the name of the office.
examples.zh: 我先点了「文本输入框」，再粘贴办事处的名称。

words.enDefinition: Words introducing when a formal decision begins to apply

examples.en: I checked when the decision takes effect in the sample notice.
examples.zh: 我查了通知样本里写的「决定开始生效」时间。

examples.en: The letter gave a separate date for when the decision takes effect.
examples.zh: 信件单独列出了「决定开始生效」的日期。

collocations: the decision takes effect on the date stated
confirm when the decision takes effect

words.enDefinition: records that the person who signed appeared before the certifying officer

examples.en: The certificate said 'The signer appeared before me' next to the space for the date.
examples.zh: 证明的日期栏旁边写着「签署人已到本人面前」。

examples.en: I found 'The signer appeared before me' in the sample certificate below the county name.
examples.zh: 我在证明样本的县名下方看到了「签署人已到本人面前」。

collocations: a clause saying the signer appeared before me
a note reading the signer appeared before me
the words the signer appeared before me

words.enDefinition: a message indicating that a field must contain an answer before submission

examples.en: The page showed “This field is required” beneath the empty address box.
examples.zh: 页面在空白的地址框下方显示「此字段为必填项」。

examples.en: I saw “This field is required” after accidentally clearing my contact phone number.
examples.zh: 我不小心删掉联系电话后，看到了「此字段为必填项」。

collocations: a message saying “This field is required”
show “This field is required” beneath the box
an error saying “This field is required”

words.enDefinition: to mark or select a square box on a form

examples.en: I had to tick a box to indicate that I had enclosed the original.
examples.zh: 我得「在方框内打勾」，注明已经附上原件。

examples.en: The clerk showed me where to tick a box for the preferred contact method.
examples.zh: 办事员给我看了应该在哪里「打勾」，选择想用的联系方式。

collocations: tick a box on the form
ask someone to tick a box

words.enDefinition: a request to have a government authority issue or update a vehicle title

examples.en: The clerk returned the title application because one signature was missing.
examples.zh: 办事员因缺一个签名，退回了「车辆权属凭证申请」。

examples.en: I checked which page of the title application needed the vehicle's identification details.
examples.zh: 我查了「车辆权属凭证申请」哪一页需要车辆识别信息。

words.enDefinition: the process of updating a vehicle title to show a different owner

examples.en: The US form gave a separate section for information about the title transfer.
examples.zh: 那份美国表格为「车辆所有权过户」信息划了单独一节。

examples.en: I asked whether the title transfer had appeared in the agency's online account.
examples.zh: 我问机构的在线账号里是否已经显示「车辆所有权过户」。

words.enDefinition: a form field for the end date of a period

examples.en: The form flagged the “To date” field because it came before the start date.
examples.zh: 「结束日期栏」里所填的日期早于开始日期，系统因此标记了这一栏。

examples.en: I left the “To date” field blank after reading the example for current addresses.
examples.zh: 我看过现住址的例子后，把「结束日期栏」留空了。

words.expression: to the best of my knowledge
words.lemma: to the best of my knowledge
words.enDefinition: used to qualify a statement as correct as far as the speaker knows
acceptedEnVariants: to the best of my knowledge

examples.en: I wrote that the dates were correct to the best of my knowledge.
examples.zh: 我写明，「据我所知」这些日期都正确。

examples.en: The declaration used “to the best of my knowledge” just before the signature.
examples.zh: 声明在签名处之前用了「据我所知」。

collocations: correct to the best of my knowledge
complete to the best of my knowledge
declare to the best of my knowledge

words.enDefinition: To follow a letter's progress using tracking records

examples.en: Can I track a letter sent to the registration office from this branch?
examples.zh: 从这个网点寄给登记办事处的信，我能「查询信件投递进度」吗？

examples.en: The receipt showed which reference I could use to track a letter online.
examples.zh: 凭条显示了我可以用哪个编号在线「查询信件投递进度」。

collocations: use a reference to track a letter
ask how to track a letter

words.enDefinition: Mail whose progress can be checked through tracking records

examples.en: I chose tracked mail for the document the agency was expecting from me.
examples.zh: 为了寄送机构等着收的文件，我选了「可追踪邮件」。

examples.en: The office gave me a code for tracked mail in its dispatch message.
examples.zh: 办事处在寄出通知中给了我一个「可追踪邮件」的查询编号。

words.enDefinition: A barcode used to identify an item for tracking

examples.en: The clerk scanned the tracking barcode after placing my envelope on the counter.
examples.zh: 工作人员把信封放上柜台后，扫描了「邮件追踪条码」。

examples.en: The tracking barcode was still readable even though the corner had been folded.
examples.zh: 虽然有个角被折了起来，「邮件追踪条码」还是能看清。

collocations: a tracking barcode on a label

words.enDefinition: A list of past tracking updates for mail

examples.en: I looked through the tracking history to see when the envelope was accepted.
examples.zh: 我查阅了「邮件追踪记录」，看信封什么时候被收寄。

examples.en: The tracking history showed two earlier updates below the latest entry.
examples.zh: 「邮件追踪记录」在最新一条记录下面列了两条较早的更新。

collocations: an entry in the tracking history

words.enDefinition: A page showing the progress of a mailed item

examples.en: I opened the tracking page after receiving the message from the registration office.
examples.zh: 收到登记办事处发来的消息后，我打开了「邮件追踪页面」。

examples.en: The tracking page displayed the dates of each update for my document envelope.
examples.zh: 「邮件追踪页面」显示了我文件信封每次状态更新的日期。

collocations: a link to the tracking page

words.enDefinition: A recorded scan updating an item's progress

examples.en: The tracking scan showed that the envelope had reached a sorting facility.
examples.zh: 「邮件追踪扫描记录」显示，信封已到达分拣设施。

examples.en: I checked where the most recent tracking scan was listed on the page.
examples.zh: 我查看了页面上最新一条「邮件追踪扫描记录」的位置。

words.zhGloss: 澳大利亚签证申请交易编号
words.enDefinition: An Australian reference number identifying a visa application
acceptedZhAnswers: 澳大利亚签证申请交易编号

examples.en: The Australian confirmation listed a Transaction Reference Number at the top of the page.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚确认页在顶部列了一个「签证申请交易编号」。

examples.en: I compared the Transaction Reference Number on the Australian message with the one in my file.
examples.zh: 我核对了澳大利亚消息和档案里的「签证申请交易编号」是否一致。

words.enDefinition: Moved to a different office for handling or a decision

examples.en: I learned my case had been transferred to another office after checking the portal.
examples.zh: 查看平台后，我得知我的案件「已转交另一个办事处」。

examples.en: The letter explained why the file was transferred to another office last month.
examples.zh: 信件解释了案卷上个月为何「已转交另一个办事处」。

collocations: a case transferred to another office
a file transferred to another office
confirmation that it was transferred to another office

words.enDefinition: a small printed or digital information sheet provided in another language

examples.en: The clerk handed me a translated leaflet describing services at the office.
examples.zh: 办事员递给我一份介绍办事处业务的「译文宣传单」。

examples.en: I found the translated leaflet beside the forms near the entrance.
examples.zh: 我在入口附近的表格旁找到了「译文宣传单」。

words.enDefinition: a business that arranges or provides translation services

examples.en: The translation agency sent a separate note explaining how it had written the place names.
examples.zh: 「翻译机构」另发了一份备注，说明地名是怎么写的。

examples.en: I contacted the translation agency when I noticed a sentence missing from the final page.
examples.zh: 我发现最后一页少了一句话，就联系了「翻译机构」。

collocations: a letter from a translation agency

words.enDefinition: the date recorded for the completion or issue of a translation

examples.en: The translation date appeared below the language pair on the cover sheet from the agency.
examples.zh: 「翻译日期」在翻译机构提供的封面页上，位于语种组合下方。

examples.en: I compared the translation date with the older date shown on the original document.
examples.zh: 我把「翻译日期」和原件上更早的日期作了对照。

collocations: the field for the translation date

words.enDefinition: a statement sworn by a translator about the accuracy of a translation

examples.en: The Canadian example had a translator's affidavit on a different page from the translated record.
examples.zh: 在加拿大的样例里，「译员宣誓书」和译好的记录分开排在不同的页。

examples.en: The clerk pointed out the translator's affidavit while referring to the separate witnessing statement.
examples.zh: 工作人员在提到单独的见证声明时，指出了「译员宣誓书」的位置。

collocations: a translator's affidavit attached to a translation

words.enDefinition: information for reaching the person who made the translation

examples.en: The translator's contact details were printed beside the date on the final page.
examples.zh: 「译员联系资料」印在最后一页的日期旁边。

examples.en: I checked whether the translator's contact details were visible in the file I received.
examples.zh: 我查了收到的文件里能不能看清「译员联系资料」。

collocations: a line for the translator's contact details

words.enDefinition: a translator's written statement about the accuracy of a translation

examples.en: The translator's declaration was attached as a final page after the translated text.
examples.zh: 「译员声明」放在译文后面，作为最后一页。

examples.en: I checked whether the translator's declaration referred to all three documents in my folder.
examples.zh: 我核对了「译员声明」是否涵盖我文件夹里的三份文件。

words.enDefinition: an explanation added by the translator about a specific detail

examples.en: A translator's note explained why part of the official mark was shown in brackets.
examples.zh: 「译者注」解释了为什么官方标记的一部分写在括号里。

examples.en: I found a translator's note beside the name that was spelled two different ways.
examples.zh: 我在那个有两种拼法的名字旁边发现了一条「译者注」。

words.enDefinition: the signature by which the translator signs the translated record or statement

examples.en: I found the translator's signature below the statement describing the scope of the work.
examples.zh: 我在说明翻译范围的声明下面找到了「译员签名」。

examples.en: The translator's signature appeared next to an ink stamp at the bottom of the page.
examples.zh: 页底的油墨印章旁边有「译员签名」。

collocations: a page bearing the translator's signature

words.enDefinition: representing text from one writing system in the characters of another

examples.en: The transliteration of my name appeared next to its original characters on the translation.
examples.zh: 译文里的「姓名转写」和原来的汉字写在一起。

examples.en: I compared the transliteration with the spelling I usually use for my name abroad.
examples.zh: 我把「文字转写」和自己在国外通常用的姓名拼法作了比对。

words.zhGloss: 新西兰签证出入境条件
words.enDefinition: New Zealand visa terms about travel and re-entry
acceptedZhAnswers: 新西兰签证出入境条件

examples.en: The New Zealand eVisa had a travel conditions section below the main dates.
examples.zh: 新西兰电子签证在主要日期下面设了「签证出入境条件」一栏。

examples.en: I asked where the number of entries appeared under travel conditions in the example.
examples.zh: 我问例子中「新西兰签证出入境条件」哪儿列了入境次数。

words.enDefinition: A school signature on U.S. student travel paperwork

examples.en: I asked the U.S. adviser where the travel endorsement appeared on my Form I-20.
examples.zh: 我问美国的顾问，「学生旅行签注」在 I-20 表上的什么地方。

examples.en: The travel endorsement section was below the program information on that sample.
examples.zh: 那个样本的「美国学生旅行签注」一栏在项目信息下方。

collocations: a travel endorsement on Form I-20

words.enDefinition: A record or list of previous journeys across borders

examples.en: My travel history showed the two trips I had made during the academic year.
examples.zh: 我的「出入境历史」显示了我那个学年的两次出行。

examples.en: The adviser asked which dates in my travel history matched the previous semester.
examples.zh: 顾问问我的「出入境历史」里哪些日期对应上学期。

words.enDefinition: An administrative office that maintains records for a tribunal

examples.en: The tribunal registry confirmed it had received the document that morning.
examples.zh: 「审裁机构登记处」确认，当天上午已收到文件。

examples.en: I asked which part of the letter came from the tribunal registry.
examples.zh: 我问信中哪一部分来自「审裁机构登记处」。

collocations: a letter from the tribunal registry
records held by the tribunal registry

words.enDefinition: accurate in what it says and including all information that is asked for

examples.en: The form asked me to confirm that the information was true and complete.
examples.zh: 表格请我确认信息「真实且完整」。

examples.en: I read the details again to check they were true and complete.
examples.zh: 我又读了一遍这些细节，确认它们「真实且完整」。

collocations: confirm information is true and complete
declare a statement true and complete
ensure entries are true and complete

words.enDefinition: an instruction to type the answer or write it in clear separate letters

examples.en: The form said “Type or print clearly” at the start of the instructions.
examples.zh: 表格说明一开头写了「请打字或工整手写」。

examples.en: I read “Type or print clearly” before completing the address on paper.
examples.zh: 我在纸上填写地址前看到了「请打字或工整手写」。

collocations: ask people to type or print clearly
an instruction to type or print clearly

words.zhGloss: 英国移民身份核验应用
words.enDefinition: A UK app used for immigration identity checks
acceptedZhAnswers: 英国移民身份核验应用

examples.en: I asked whether UK Immigration: ID Check was the app named in my letter.
examples.zh: 我问信里提到的是不是「英国移民身份核验应用」。

examples.en: The university guide listed UK Immigration: ID Check beside its explanation of identity checks.
examples.zh: 学校指南在身份核验说明旁列出了「英国移民身份核验应用」。

collocations: the UK Immigration: ID Check app
a guide to UK Immigration: ID Check

words.enDefinition: An account for UK Visas and Immigration services

examples.en: I signed into my UKVI account to read the immigration record on screen.
examples.zh: 我登录「英国签证移民局账户」，在屏幕上查看移民记录。

examples.en: The adviser asked which document I had linked to my UKVI account.
examples.zh: 顾问问我把哪份证件关联到了「英国签证移民局账户」。

collocations: sign in to a UKVI account

words.enDefinition: a status or message showing a form could not be sent successfully

examples.en: The screen showed unable to submit after the connection stopped for a moment.
examples.zh: 网络断了一会儿后，屏幕显示「无法提交」。

examples.en: I took a screenshot of unable to submit to show the help desk.
examples.zh: 我把「无法提交」截了图，准备给帮助台看。

words.enDefinition: a copy without formal confirmation that it matches the original

examples.en: I kept an uncertified copy in my folder to use when taking notes.
examples.zh: 我在文件夹里放了份「未经认证的副本」，记笔记时用。

examples.en: The file marked uncertified copy looked nearly identical to the one with the stamp.
examples.zh: 标着「未经认证的副本」的文件看起来和有盖章的那份几乎一样。

collocations: compare an uncertified copy with the original

words.enDefinition: Mail not collected by the intended recipient

examples.en: The delivery office kept a record of unclaimed mail for the previous week.
examples.zh: 投递办事点保存了上一周「无人领取的邮件」的记录。

examples.en: I saw a section about unclaimed mail on the back of the notice.
examples.zh: 我在通知背面看到了一栏介绍「无人领取的邮件」。

words.enDefinition: Mail that cannot be delivered as addressed

examples.en: The report listed undeliverable mail separately from letters still on their way.
examples.zh: 报告把「无法投递的邮件」和仍在运送途中的信件分开列出。

examples.en: I saw an explanation for undeliverable mail on the back of the notice.
examples.zh: 我在通知背面看到了对「无法投递的邮件」的说明。

words.enDefinition: the particular document to which an attached certificate refers

examples.en: The certificate was attached to the underlying document in the folder I received.
examples.zh: 我收到的文件夹里，证书附在它「所对应的文书」上。

examples.en: I checked which underlying document matched the number printed on the certificate's front page.
examples.zh: 我核对了哪一份「证明书所对应的文书」和证书首页印的编号相符。

words.enDefinition: a number identifying a particular unit within a building or address

examples.en: The form asked for a unit number below the street address.
examples.zh: 表格在街道地址下方要求填写「单元或房间编号」。

examples.en: I found the unit number on the sign beside my apartment door.
examples.zh: 我在公寓门旁的牌子上找到了「单元或房间编号」。

words.enDefinition: a translation produced without formal certification or official issue

examples.en: I made an unofficial translation to understand what the notice said about my appointment.
examples.zh: 我自己翻译了一份「未经正式认证的译文」，好理解通知里关于预约的内容。

examples.en: The page called the English text an unofficial translation of the short letter attached.
examples.zh: 该页把英语文本称为所附短信的「未经正式认证的译文」。

words.enDefinition: a vehicle that is not registered in the relevant system at a given time

examples.en: The notice described the stored car as an unregistered vehicle under the local rules.
examples.zh: 通知按当地规定，把存放中的汽车称为「未登记的车辆」。

examples.en: I asked what the label unregistered vehicle meant on the sample record.
examples.zh: 我问样本记录中「未登记的车辆」这个标记是什么意思。

collocations: a notice about an unregistered vehicle

words.enDefinition: a form that does not yet carry a required or expected signature

examples.en: The clerk returned the unsigned form to my folder with a short note.
examples.zh: 办事员把「未签名的表格」放回我的文件夹，并附了条简短说明。

examples.en: I realized the unsigned form was the older copy I had printed that morning.
examples.zh: 我发现「未签名的表格」是那天早上打印的较旧版本。

words.enDefinition: an original seal whose wording is absent from the translated version

examples.en: I noticed an untranslated seal beside the date and asked about its wording.
examples.zh: 我发现日期旁边有个「未翻译文字的印章」，就问它写的是什么。

examples.en: The review listed the untranslated seal separately from the other text in the attachment.
examples.zh: 审核记录把「未翻译文字的印章」和附件里的其他文字分开列了。

collocations: a comment about an untranslated seal

words.enDefinition: To bring official details identifying you into line with changes

examples.en: The guide explains where to ask about how to update your identity records.
examples.zh: 指南说明了去哪里咨询怎样「更新个人身份记录」。

examples.en: The clerk can explain which office you contact to update your identity records.
examples.zh: 办事员可以说明，要联系哪个办公室「更新个人身份记录」。

collocations: ask how to update your identity records
choose to update your identity records
documents to update your identity records

words.enDefinition: To change the address recorded for receiving mail

examples.en: The letter explained where you could update your mailing address in the agency's records.
examples.zh: 信中说明了可以在哪里「更新机构记录中的邮寄地址」。

examples.en: Can you update your mailing address after moving to another student residence?
examples.zh: 搬到另一处学生宿舍后，你能「更新邮寄地址」吗？

collocations: ask how to update your mailing address
need to update your mailing address
a form to update your mailing address

words.enDefinition: a request to have an appointment arranged quickly because the matter cannot wait

examples.en: The clerk called to discuss my urgent appointment request the following morning.
examples.zh: 第二天上午，办事员打电话来谈我的「紧急预约申请」。

examples.en: The office asked me to explain the timing in my urgent appointment request.
examples.zh: 办事处请我在「紧急预约申请」中说明时间上的紧迫性。

collocations: a form for an urgent appointment request

words.enDefinition: an instruction to put extra information on another sheet of paper

examples.en: The note says to use a separate sheet if the space is too small.
examples.zh: 说明写着，如果地方不够，「请另用一张纸」。

examples.en: I was told to use a separate sheet for the remaining dates.
examples.zh: 有人告诉我，把剩下的日期「另用一张纸」填写。

collocations: use a separate sheet for details
ask someone to use a separate sheet

words.enDefinition: an instruction to complete a paper form using black ink rather than another colour

examples.en: The paper form said to use black ink for all handwritten entries.
examples.zh: 纸质表格说，所有手写项都要「用黑色墨水填写」。

examples.en: I noticed the request to use black ink before signing the page.
examples.zh: 我在页上签字前，注意到了「请用黑色墨水填写」的要求。

collocations: an instruction to use black ink

words.enDefinition: an instruction to enter information in the same pattern as the displayed example

examples.en: The message said to use the format shown beneath the box for my date.
examples.zh: 提示要求填写日期时「按所示格式填写」，格式见输入框下方。

examples.en: I learned to use the format shown after the shorter date was rejected.
examples.zh: 较短的日期写法被拒绝后，我才知道要「按所示格式填写」。

collocations: remember to use the format shown
use the format shown beneath the field

words.enDefinition: an arrangement of date components accepted by a particular form or system

examples.en: I checked the example of a valid date format before submitting the form.
examples.zh: 交表前，我照着「有效日期格式」的示例核对了一遍。

examples.en: The message showed the valid date format beside the field I had completed.
examples.zh: 提示在我已填完的字段旁显示了「有效日期格式」。

words.enDefinition: A passport that remains valid and has not been cancelled

examples.en: The clerk asked which document was my current valid passport on file.
examples.zh: 办事员问档案中的哪份证件是我目前的「有效护照」。

examples.en: The office checked the dates on the valid passport I brought.
examples.zh: 办事处核对了我带来的「有效护照」上的日期。

words.enDefinition: A change to selected conditions of a New Zealand visa

examples.en: I read variation of conditions in the guide from Immigration New Zealand.
examples.zh: 我在新西兰移民局的指南里读到了「签证条件变更」。

examples.en: The adviser pointed out variation of conditions in the New Zealand letter's heading.
examples.zh: 顾问指出新西兰来信的标题里写着「签证条件变更」。

collocations: a decision on variation of conditions

words.enDefinition: To change part of an earlier decision during review

examples.en: The example showed a tribunal deciding to vary the decision on review.
examples.zh: 示例中，审裁机构在复核时决定「变更部分决定内容」。

examples.en: I asked what the guide meant by choosing to vary the decision.
examples.zh: 我问指南所说的决定「变更部分决定内容」是什么意思。

collocations: an order to vary the decision

words.enDefinition: a code assigned to identify a specific vehicle

examples.en: The form requested the vehicle identification number in a separate field from the plate.
examples.zh: 表格单设了「车辆识别代码」字段，和车牌号分开。

examples.en: I checked the vehicle identification number against the code on the registration document.
examples.zh: 我用登记文件上的代码核对了「车辆识别代码」。

words.enDefinition: an appointment reserved for officials or an approved inspector to inspect a vehicle

examples.en: The garage emailed the vehicle inspection booking details to the new owner.
examples.zh: 修理厂把「车辆检验预约」的详情发邮件给了新车主。

examples.en: I changed the vehicle inspection booking because the car was still being repaired.
examples.zh: 车还在维修，我就改了「车辆检验预约」的时间。

words.enDefinition: a record of the findings of a vehicle examination by an inspector

examples.en: The vehicle inspection report listed the items that had been checked that morning.
examples.zh: 「车辆检查报告」列出了那天上午核查的项目。

examples.en: I compared the vehicle inspection report with the summary sent by the authority.
examples.zh: 我把「车辆检查报告」和主管机关发来的摘要作了对照。

collocations: a copy of the vehicle inspection report

words.enDefinition: the UK vehicle registration certificate known as the V5C, which records the vehicle and keeper

examples.en: I found the vehicle log book in the envelope from the UK licensing agency.
examples.zh: 我在英国车辆管理机构寄来的信封里找到了「英国车辆登记证」。

examples.en: The adviser explained which part of the vehicle log book showed the keeper.
examples.zh: 顾问指出了「英国车辆登记证」上写登记持有人的位置。

collocations: a copy of the vehicle log book

words.enDefinition: an official document confirming and detailing a vehicle's registration

examples.en: The officer checked the vehicle registration certificate before scanning the copy I provided.
examples.zh: 办事员先核查了「车辆登记证明」，再扫描我提供的副本。

examples.en: I found the vehicle registration certificate in the folder with the other car documents.
examples.zh: 我在和其他汽车文件放一起的文件夹里找到了「车辆登记证明」。

words.enDefinition: a check of official information about a vehicle's current registration

examples.en: I used a vehicle registration check to compare the details with the paper record.
examples.zh: 我通过「车辆登记查询」把信息与纸质记录作了比对。

examples.en: The service explained what information a vehicle registration check could show in that region.
examples.zh: 该服务说明了当地「车辆登记查询」能显示哪些信息。

collocations: the results of a vehicle registration check

words.enDefinition: a tax charged in connection with keeping or using a vehicle under a local tax system

examples.en: The UK guide placed vehicle tax under a different heading from registration.
examples.zh: 英国指南把「机动车税」和车辆登记放在不同的标题下。

examples.en: The reminder told me where the vehicle tax amount appeared in the account.
examples.zh: 提醒注明，账号里哪里显示「机动车税」金额。

words.enDefinition: a notice reminding a vehicle keeper about a vehicle tax action or due date

examples.en: I found a vehicle tax reminder in the correspondence from the licensing agency.
examples.zh: 我在许可机关来信中找到了一封「机动车税办理提醒」。

examples.en: The vehicle tax reminder had a reference field near the top of the page.
examples.zh: 「机动车税办理提醒」在页首附近有一个编号字段。

words.enDefinition: an official document or electronic record identifying ownership and relevant interests in a vehicle

examples.en: The US seller showed the vehicle title before we discussed collection arrangements.
examples.zh: 在商量什么时候取车之前，美国卖家出示了「车辆所有权凭证」。

examples.en: I checked whether the vehicle title included the same identification number as the registration.
examples.zh: 我核对了「车辆所有权凭证」的识别号码是否与登记文件一致。

words.enDefinition: an administrative charge for recording a vehicle ownership or registration transfer

examples.en: The confirmation listed a vehicle transfer fee separately from the amount paid to the seller.
examples.zh: 确认单把「车辆过户费」和付给卖家的钱分开列了。

examples.en: I asked whether the vehicle transfer fee was included in the agency's receipt.
examples.zh: 我问机构的回执里是否包含「车辆过户费」。

words.enDefinition: an electronic link to a page that can verify a record

examples.en: The verification link led to a page showing the certificate number from my copy.
examples.zh: 「查验链接」打开的是一个显示我那份副本上证书编号的页面。

examples.en: I asked whether the verification link in the notice was for the attached certificate.
examples.zh: 我问通知里的「查验链接」是不是对应所附证书。

collocations: a verification link for a certificate

words.zhGloss: 加拿大移民状态核实文件
words.enDefinition: A Canadian document confirming information from immigration records
acceptedZhAnswers: 加拿大移民状态核实文件

examples.en: The Canadian guide gave a sample document under the heading Verification of Status.
examples.zh: 加拿大指南在「移民状态核实文件」标题下放了一个文件样本。

examples.en: I checked what information the Verification of Status document showed in our class example.
examples.zh: 我查看了课堂例子中「加拿大移民状态核实文件」显示了什么信息。

collocations: information on a Verification of Status document

words.enDefinition: check whether an authority issued the specified apostille

examples.en: The page offered an option to verify an apostille attached to the sample statement.
examples.zh: 页面提供了「查验附加证明书」的选项，针对样本声明所附的那张。

examples.en: I asked what it meant to verify an apostille in the attached guidance notes.
examples.zh: 我问附上的说明里，「查验附加证明书」是什么意思。

collocations: a tool to verify an apostille
ask how to verify an apostille
the option to verify an apostille

words.enDefinition: an inspection that checks a vehicle's VIN against its documents or records

examples.en: The office scheduled a VIN inspection before completing the registration review.
examples.zh: 办事处先安排了「车辆识别代码查验」，之后才完成登记审核。

examples.en: I asked which vehicle documents were mentioned in the VIN inspection notice.
examples.zh: 我问「车辆识别代码查验」通知提到了哪些车辆文件。

words.enDefinition: an appointment held remotely through a video, phone or online service

examples.en: I chose a virtual appointment because the office was far from campus.
examples.zh: 办事处离学校很远，所以我选了「远程预约会面」。

examples.en: The virtual appointment started after I opened the link in the email.
examples.zh: 我打开邮件里的链接后，「远程预约会面」就开始了。

collocations: an invitation to a virtual appointment

words.enDefinition: An office that handles parts of the visa application process

examples.en: I checked the address of the visa application centre against the address in my email.
examples.zh: 我把「签证申请中心」的地址和邮件里的地址核对了一下。

examples.en: The sign near the lift pointed to the visa application centre upstairs.
examples.zh: 电梯旁的指示牌指向楼上的「签证申请中心」。

collocations: an appointment at a visa application centre
the address of a visa application centre

words.enDefinition: A classification of visas by their purpose

examples.en: The notice stated the visa category near the top of the first page.
examples.zh: 通知在第一页上方写明了「签证类别」。

examples.en: I asked whether the term in my file referred to the visa category.
examples.zh: 我问档案里的这个术语是不是指「签证类别」。

words.enDefinition: Requirements or restrictions attached to a visa

examples.en: I compared the visa conditions in my notice with the list in my account.
examples.zh: 我对照了通知中的「签证所附条件」和账户里列出的条件。

examples.en: The adviser asked me to read the section headed visa conditions on the sample.
examples.zh: 顾问让我阅读样本里标题是「签证所附条件」的部分。

words.zhGloss: 澳大利亚签证信息在线核验系统
words.enDefinition: Australia's service for checking visa details and conditions
acceptedZhAnswers: 澳大利亚签证信息在线核验系统

examples.en: The Australian guide introduced Visa Entitlement Verification Online in the section on digital records.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚指南在介绍电子记录的章节中介绍了「签证信息在线核验系统」。

examples.en: I saw Visa Entitlement Verification Online named in the Australian university's orientation materials.
examples.zh: 我在澳大利亚大学的迎新材料里看到了「签证信息在线核验系统」这个名称。

collocations: details from Visa Entitlement Verification Online

words.enDefinition: An official exception to a visa requirement

examples.en: The university guide explained the term visa exemption in its glossary for visiting students.
examples.zh: 学校给访学学生的指南在术语表里解释了「签证豁免」。

examples.en: I asked which part of the notice referred to the visa exemption in the example.
examples.zh: 我问通知的哪一部分提到了例子里的「签证豁免」。

collocations: a visa exemption mentioned in a notice

words.enDefinition: The date on which a visa expires

examples.en: I read the visa expiry date from the screen while the adviser checked my file.
examples.zh: 顾问核对我的档案时，我从屏幕上读出了「签证到期日」。

examples.en: The letter printed the visa expiry date on a different line from the issue date.
examples.zh: 那封信把「签证到期日」和签发日期列在不同行。

collocations: the visa expiry date on a document

words.enDefinition: An extension of the period covered by a visa

examples.en: The adviser explained what visa extension meant on the information sheet for students.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了学生说明单上「签证延期」是什么意思。

examples.en: I asked whether the second date referred to a visa extension in my file.
examples.zh: 我问第二个日期是不是指我档案里的「签证延期」。

words.zhGloss: 澳大利亚签证获批通知
words.enDefinition: Australia's notice stating that a visa was granted
acceptedZhAnswers: 澳大利亚签证获批通知

examples.en: I read the visa grant notification from Australia beside the copy of my application.
examples.zh: 读澳大利亚的「签证获批通知」时，我把申请副本放在旁边。

examples.en: The adviser showed me the reference number on the Australian visa grant notification.
examples.zh: 顾问指给我看了「澳大利亚签证获批通知」上的编号。

collocations: details in a visa grant notification

words.zhGloss: 澳大利亚签证获批编号
words.enDefinition: A number identifying a granted Australian visa
acceptedZhAnswers: 澳大利亚签证获批编号

examples.en: I checked the visa grant number against the Australian notice I had saved.
examples.zh: 我用保存的澳大利亚通知核对了「签证获批编号」。

examples.en: The example showed where the visa grant number appeared on the Australian record.
examples.zh: 例子展示了「签证获批编号」在澳大利亚记录上的位置。

collocations: a visa grant number on a notice

words.enDefinition: The person to whom a visa was issued

examples.en: The electronic record showed the name of the visa holder above the reference.
examples.zh: 电子记录在编号上方显示了「签证持有人」的姓名。

examples.en: The adviser checked whether the visa holder and student listed were the same person.
examples.zh: 顾问核对了「签证持有人」和名单上的学生是不是同一个人。

words.enDefinition: An interview held as part of a visa application

examples.en: The message described where the visa interview would take place that morning.
examples.zh: 消息写明了那天早上「签证面谈」会在哪里举行。

examples.en: I wrote down the reference number from the notice about my visa interview.
examples.zh: 我把「签证面谈」通知里的编号记了下来。

words.enDefinition: An identifying number associated with a particular visa

examples.en: I found the visa number on the document beneath the name of the holder.
examples.zh: 我在文件上持有人姓名下方找到了「签证号码」。

examples.en: The adviser checked the visa number against the number recorded in my student file.
examples.zh: 顾问对照学生档案里记录的号码核对了「签证号码」。

collocations: the visa number on the document

words.enDefinition: A visa label placed inside a passport

examples.en: I showed the adviser the visa sticker on the page next to my photo.
examples.zh: 我给顾问看了照片页旁边那一页上的「签证贴纸」。

examples.en: The sample passport had a visa sticker with the category printed near the top.
examples.zh: 样本护照上有张「签证贴纸」，靠上位置印着签证类别。

collocations: a visa sticker in a passport

words.enDefinition: The period for which a visa is valid

examples.en: I checked the visa validity period against the dates printed on the notice.
examples.zh: 我将「签证有效期」和通知上印的日期核对了一下。

examples.en: The adviser showed me where the visa validity period appeared on the digital record.
examples.zh: 顾问指给我看电子记录上的「签证有效期」在哪里。

collocations: the start of the visa validity period

words.enDefinition: Immigration New Zealand's service for checking visa details

examples.en: The university guide named the Visa Verification Service on its page about New Zealand records.
examples.zh: 大学指南在介绍新西兰记录的页面提到了「签证核验服务」。

examples.en: The adviser showed us where Immigration New Zealand described the Visa Verification Service online.
examples.zh: 顾问指给我们看，新西兰移民局在网上哪里介绍了「签证核验服务」。

collocations: details from the Visa Verification Service
information about the Visa Verification Service

words.enDefinition: permission for a visitor's vehicle to park in a designated area

examples.en: I requested a visitor parking permit when a friend came to see the campus.
examples.zh: 朋友来看学校时，我申请了「访客停车许可证」。

examples.en: The map showed which streets accepted a visitor parking permit for that neighbourhood.
examples.zh: 地图标明那个街区哪些街道接受「访客停车许可证」。

collocations: apply for a visitor parking permit

words.enDefinition: A Canadian document recording a visitor's authorized stay

examples.en: I read the term visitor record in the Canadian guide about immigration documents.
examples.zh: 我在加拿大的移民文件指南里读到了「访客停留记录」一词。

examples.en: The adviser compared the name on the visitor record with the name in the file.
examples.zh: 顾问对照了档案与「加拿大访客停留记录」上的姓名。

collocations: the date on a visitor record
a copy of a visitor record

words.enDefinition: a record of people who enter a site as visitors

examples.en: The clerk checked the visitor register before handing me a temporary badge.
examples.zh: 办事员先查看了「访客登记簿」，再递给我一枚临时胸牌。

examples.en: I entered the arrival time in the visitor register beside the reception desk.
examples.zh: 我在接待台旁的「访客登记簿」上写了到达时间。

words.zhGloss: 出生、死亡与婚姻等登记记录
words.enDefinition: Official records of events such as births, deaths, and marriages
acceptedZhAnswers: 出生、死亡与婚姻等登记记录

examples.en: The US website explained which agency kept vital records for people born in the county.
examples.zh: 美国的这个网站说明了哪个机构保管当地出生人员的「出生、死亡与婚姻等登记记录」。

examples.en: My aunt requested vital records when she was tracing our family's history.
examples.zh: 姨妈追溯我们家的历史时，申请查阅了「出生、死亡与婚姻等登记记录」。

words.enDefinition: A US office that maintains official birth and similar records

examples.en: The vital records office mailed a copy of my birth certificate on Friday.
examples.zh: 「民事登记档案办公室」周五寄出了我的出生证明副本。

examples.en: I called the vital records office to check the spelling in my father's record.
examples.zh: 我打电话到「民事登记档案办公室」，核对我父亲档案中的姓名拼写。

collocations: records from a vital records office

words.zhGloss: 法国长期居留等效签证登记确认
words.enDefinition: Official confirmation of a French VLS-TS after arrival
acceptedZhAnswers: 法国长期居留等效签证登记确认

examples.en: The French guide placed the VLS-TS validation heading next to the sample confirmation page.
examples.zh: 法国指南把「长期居留等效签证登记确认」的标题放在确认页样本旁。

examples.en: I found the VLS-TS validation reference in the French message about my record.
examples.zh: 我在法国办事处发来的档案消息里找到了「长期居留等效签证登记确认」的编号。

words.enDefinition: someone who comes to submit an application without booking a time first

examples.en: The walk-in applicant waited near the entrance until a member of staff was free.
examples.zh: 「未预约到场的申请人」在入口附近等有工作人员空出来。

examples.en: I asked which counter would take a walk-in applicant on Friday morning.
examples.zh: 我问周五上午哪个柜台会接待「未预约到场的申请人」。

collocations: direct a walk-in applicant to the counter

words.enDefinition: a line for visitors who have come to a service without an appointment

examples.en: The sign pointed to a walk-in queue beside the second entrance door.
examples.zh: 牌子指向第二个入口门旁的「未预约人员等候队伍」。

examples.en: I joined the walk-in queue while my friend waited for her scheduled visit.
examples.zh: 朋友等按时赴约，我排进了「未预约人员等候队伍」。

words.enDefinition: a service people can use in person without booking a time in advance

examples.en: The office offered walk-in service for simple questions on Wednesday morning.
examples.zh: 办事处周三上午提供「无需预约的现场服务」，解答简单问题。

examples.en: I checked whether walk-in service was available before making the trip downtown.
examples.zh: 动身去市中心前，我确认了有没有「无需预约的现场服务」。

words.enDefinition: a faint design included in paper or a document for identification

examples.en: I could see a faint watermark on the record when I moved it near the window.
examples.zh: 我把文件移到窗边时，能看到一道浅浅的「文件水印」。

examples.en: The scan kept the text clear, but the watermark was difficult to make out.
examples.zh: 扫描件的文字很清楚，但「文件水印」很难辨认。

words.enDefinition: To measure how heavy a mailing envelope is

examples.en: Can I weigh an envelope at this counter before choosing a postal service?
examples.zh: 我可以先在这个柜台「给信封称重」，再选邮寄服务吗？

examples.en: The clerk showed me where I could weigh an envelope before buying postage.
examples.zh: 工作人员指给我看在哪里可以先「给信封称重」，再买邮资。

collocations: use a postal scale to weigh an envelope
ask where to weigh an envelope
weigh an envelope at the counter

words.enDefinition: An envelope with a clear address window

examples.en: I could see the university office name through the window envelope on my desk.
examples.zh: 我透过桌上「开窗信封」的透明窗口，看到了大学办事处的名称。

examples.en: The letter was folded so the address showed through the window envelope.
examples.zh: 信纸折好后，地址正好能从「开窗信封」的窗口露出来。

collocations: send a letter in a window envelope

words.enDefinition: the number identifying a particular service window in an office

examples.en: The screen showed my ticket number next to the window number for my appointment.
examples.zh: 屏幕把我的取号号码显示在这次预约的「窗口号码」旁边。

examples.en: I missed the window number because I was still looking for the document.
examples.zh: 我还在找材料，没看见「窗口号码」。

words.enDefinition: With formal permission granted by the body hearing a case

examples.en: The example said a late document was accepted with leave of the tribunal.
examples.zh: 示例说明，那份晚交的文件「经审裁机构许可」被接收。

examples.en: I asked what the phrase with leave of the tribunal meant in the directions.
examples.zh: 我问程序指示中的「经审裁机构许可」是什么意思。

collocations: file a document with leave of the tribunal
proceed with leave of the tribunal
be allowed with leave of the tribunal

words.enDefinition: a section recording that an act was witnessed and by whom

examples.en: The witnessing clause appeared below the text of the declaration on a separate line.
examples.zh: 「见证条款」在声明正文下面，单独占一行。

examples.en: I asked which person the witnessing clause identified on the final page of the document.
examples.zh: 我问文件最后一页的「见证条款」列出了哪位人员。

words.enDefinition: an instruction to keep all handwritten text inside the provided boxes

examples.en: The clerk reminded us to write within the boxes on each page.
examples.zh: 办事员提醒我们，每页都要「在方框内填写」。

examples.en: I tried to write within the boxes even when the address was long.
examples.zh: 即使地址很长，我也尽量「在方框内填写」。

collocations: be asked to write within the boxes

words.enDefinition: a question sent to an organization in a written form such as a letter or email

examples.en: I submitted a written enquiry so I could keep a copy of my question.
examples.zh: 我提交了「书面咨询」，这样能留一份问题的副本。

examples.en: The response to my written enquiry arrived while I was in the library.
examples.zh: 我在图书馆时，收到了「书面咨询」的答复。

collocations: a response to a written enquiry

words.enDefinition: Written statements from a party setting out views or arguments

examples.en: The tribunal listed the written submissions it had received from both sides.
examples.zh: 审裁机构列出了从双方收到的「书面陈述材料」。

examples.en: I saved the written submissions in a separate folder from the evidence.
examples.zh: 我把「书面陈述材料」和证据分开放在两个文件夹里。

words.enDefinition: A named Canada Post service for expedited delivery

examples.en: The Canadian receipt showed Xpresspost above the reference for the document envelope.
examples.zh: 加拿大邮政凭条在文件信封编号上方印了「特快寄递」。

examples.en: I asked whether Xpresspost was the service named on the Canada Post label.
examples.zh: 我问加拿大邮政标签上写的服务是不是「特快寄递」。

words.enDefinition: the calendar year in which a person first arrived for the purpose being asked about

examples.en: I found the year of arrival in my notes before completing the form.
examples.zh: 填表前，我在笔记里找到了「抵达年份」。

examples.en: The field for year of arrival appeared after the country name on the page.
examples.zh: 页面在国家名称后面显示了「抵达年份」的字段。

words.zhGloss: 要求回答是或否的问题
words.enDefinition: a question that asks the reader to choose yes or no
acceptedZhAnswers: 要求回答是或否的问题

examples.en: The form began with a yes-or-no question about a previous application.
examples.zh: 表格先用一道「要求回答是或否的问题」问以前有没有申请过。

examples.en: I needed more information before I could answer the yes-or-no question.
examples.zh: 我还需要更多信息，才能回答这道「要求回答是或否的问题」。
